description:

title: Team Lead-Food and Nutrition - Evening Shift
description:
Details: This position is full-time, evening shift. The hours are 12:00pm until 8:30pm. Team member will be required to work rotating weekends and holidays. This position is eligible for shift pay differentials.

Location: IU Health Methodist Hospital

Position Summary:

Provides non-supervisory leadership and frontline support to Food and Nutrition team members. Assists with coordinating daily task assignments, training and onboarding new team members, ensuring readiness of supplies and equipment, and supporting performance standards through quality checks and peer coaching. Acts as a role model for quality, safety, and accountability, supporting a positive team culture and the consistent execution of departmental policies and procedures. Assists in coordinating daily work assignments and coverage plans to ensure consistent service delivery. Leads or supports team huddles, shift briefings, and ongoing communication across the Food and Nutrition Services team. Participates in inventory management, supply readiness, and organization of equipment or materials. Serves as a peer role model in high-pressure, complex, or sensitive care areas, demonstrating professionalism and attention to detail. Conducts quality checks and performance audits and supports correction of issues in real time and escalates concerns when necessary.

  • High school diploma, GED or equivalent experience is preferred.
  • Requires 3-5 years of relevant experience.
  • Requires ServSafe Manager Certification within 6 months of hire.
  • Requires the ability to operate kitchen equipment.
  • Requires basic computer skills.
  • Must be able to wear protective equipment/clothing required by the environment or government regulations such as gowns, gloves, goggles, rubber-soled closed-toe footwear, etc.
  • Requires adherence to local health regulations and safety requirements to produce safe food for consumption.
  • Requires the ability to climb ladders.
  • Physical requirements to include: reaching, standing for long periods of time, squatting, bending, carrying and/or lifting supplies and equipment weighing 35 lbs. or more, up to 80% of the time.

title: Candidate Experience Specialist
description:
At NBCUniversal, we believe the candidate experience is a reflection of our culture—innovative, collaborative, and inclusive. As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you’ll be the face of NBCU for prospective talent, ensuring every interaction is seamless, professional, and memorable. In this role, you’ll serve as both a trusted advisor and a hands-on executor—providing consultative guidance to recruiters and hiring teams while confidently taking action within established processes to deliver an exceptional interview and candidate experience. This role is all about creating a world-class experience that mirrors the energy and creativity of our brand.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver Exceptional Candidate Experiences:
    • Serve as the primary strategic partner for hiring teams; you’ll have ownership over the end‑to‑end candidate interview journey and be the primary point of contact for candidates
    • You’ll independently shape communication approaches, set clear expectations, and ensure every interaction reflects NBCU’s commitment to transparency, professionalism, and brand alignment.
  • Interview Logistics:
    • Architect interview processes across time zones and platforms, determining the ideal structure, sequencing, and format (panel, 1:1, virtual, onsite).
    • Provide informed recommendations to guide hiring teams and secure alignment on the optimal plan before execution.
    • Secure and prepare onsite spaces that ensure a welcome environment.
  • Manage Travel & Onsite Details:
    • Oversee and direct the full candidate travel and onsite experience, designing itineraries that anticipate potential challenges and proactively solving issues before they arise.
    • Manage all onsite elements from technology readiness to hospitality, to deliver a polished, stress‑free experience end‑to‑end.
  • Partner Across Teams:
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers, offering perspective on best practices, accessibility considerations, and candidate engagement strategies.
    • Lead alignment across stakeholders and intervene to resolve conflicts with a solutions‑first mindset.
  • Champion Process Excellence:
    • Uphold confidentiality and compliance standards.
    • Communicate and maintain clear process guidelines and escalation paths that enable candidate care issues to be resolved confidently and consistently.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years in talent acquisition, guest relations, or similar role within Human Resources or Hospitality.
  • Ability to make autonomous, well-informed decisions based on established processes and protocols
  • Strong situational awareness and intuitive problem-solving skills
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous situations with confidence
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in scheduling tools, Microsoft Office Suite; ATS experience preferred.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $65,000 - $75,000

title: Product Management Intern - MBA (Summer 2027)
description:
Position Summary

The Product Management MBA Intern will support Vertiv's Power Solutions & Distribution (PSD) business by assisting with product strategy, portfolio management, market analysis, and growth initiatives. The intern will work closely with the Product Management team on strategic projects and recommendations that support business growth, profitability, and new product development efforts. The internship provides hands-on experience in managing a global technology product portfolio serving the data center and critical infrastructure markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, competitive, and customer research to identify growth opportunities and product strategy recommendations.

  • Analyze product portfolio performance, revenue trends, and profitability drivers.

  • Support evaluation of emerging technologies and new market opportunities.

  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for new product or feature investments.

  • Assist Product Managers with product roadmap development and portfolio planning activities.

  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify unmet needs and product improvement opportunities.

  • Create executive-level presentations and recommendations for business leaders.

  • Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on portfolio expansion, market share growth, and profitability improvement.

  • Support analysis and recommendations related to product positioning, pricing, and competitive differentiation.

Potential Project Areas

  • Data center power distribution market analysis

  • Competitive benchmarking and teardown assessments

  • New technology evaluation, including next-generation power architectures such as 800V DC data center power systems

  • Pricing and profitability analysis

  • Voice-of-customer research and customer segmentation

  • Product roadmap development

  • Commercial launch planning

  • Portfolio rationalization and lifecycle management

  • AI and digital tool opportunities to improve product management effectiveness

  • Growth strategy development for existing and emerging product lines

  • Research and analysis of industry trends impacting data center infrastructure

Qualifications

Required

  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program with expected graduation within 12-24 months.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize data into actionable business recommendations.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Undergraduate degree in engineering, business, computer science, or a related technical field.

  • Prior experience in product management, strategy, consulting, engineering, operations, or technology industries.

  • Interest in data center infrastructure, power systems, electrical equipment, industrial technology, or AI-related markets.

  • Experience with market research, business case development, product strategy, or data analytics.

Learning Opportunities

  • Exposure to global product management processes and best practices.

  • Experience working on strategic growth initiatives within a market-leading technology company.

  • Opportunity to influence business decisions through research, analysis, and recommendations.

  • Understanding of data center power infrastructure, critical digital infrastructure, and emerging industry trends.

  • Exposure to portfolio management, market strategy, product roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.

  • Direct engagement with Product Management leaders and visibility into strategic planning activities.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Intellectual curiosity and a passion for solving complex business problems.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Self-motivated with a bias toward action and ownership.

  • Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • No special physical requirements.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • None required

title: Extension Educator, Associate - Extension Volunteer Specialist
description:
Join Our Campus Community!

Thank you for your interest in joining the University of Wyoming. Our community thrives on the contributions of talented and driven individuals who share in our mission, vision, and values. If your expertise and experience align with the goals of our institution, we would be thrilled to hear from you. We encourage you to apply and become a valued member of our vibrant campus community today!

Why Choose Us?

At the University of Wyoming, we value our employees and invest in their success. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Benefits include:

  • Generous Retirement Contributions: The State contributes over 15% of your gross salary. With your mandatory employee contribution, the total contribution toward your retirement plan exceeds 19%.
  • Exceptional Health & Prescription Coverage: Enjoy access to medical, dental, and vision insurance with competitive employer contributions, that include 4 deductible options to suit your needs.
  • Paid Time Off: Benefit from ample vacation, sick leave, paid holidays, and paid winter closure.
  • Tuition Waiver: Employees and eligible dependents can take advantage of tuition waivers, supporting continuous education and professional growth.
  • Wellness and Employee Assistance Programs: Stay healthy with wellness initiatives, counseling services, and mental health resources.

At the University of Wyoming, we are committed to creating a supportive and enriching workplace. To learn more about what we offer, please refer to UW’s Benefits Summary.

JOB TITLE:

Associate University Extension Educator, Extension Volunteer Development Specialist

JOB PURPOSE:

The individual in this position will provide leadership, guidance, organization, management, and educational opportunities to support volunteer development as part of the UW Extension 4-H Youth Development team. This position will also be called upon to consult with, or provide volunteer training for, other Extension programs, such as Master Gardeners, as appropriate. This individual needs expertise in principles of volunteer program management, positive youth development, conflict management, background screening, training development, and overall risk management with application to participant safety.

The individual in this position works under the guidance and supervision of the UW Extension, 4-H Program Leader with input from the UW Extension Director/Associate Dean for the College of Agriculture, Life Sciences, and Natural Resources (CALSNR) and the UW Extension Associate Director supervising the 4-H program.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop volunteer leadership best practices, curricula, training opportunities, and professional development for UW Extension.
  • Lead the development of, and provide updates to, a volunteer management monitoring system to streamline required documentation and coordinate risk management efforts, including background checks for volunteers.
  • Work cohesively with state level program area specialists to implement a statewide volunteer committee, conference, and other efforts as needed.
  • Regularly review and revise volunteer policies and procedures for 4-H and other extension programs.
  • Provide statewide leadership for volunteer education and recognition as well as the support of county extension professionals in the recruitment of engaged volunteers.
  • Develop and implement training for support staff with volunteer management responsibilities.
  • Lead professional development and enrichment experiences for volunteers.
  • Evaluate and communicate the impacts of the UW Extension volunteer program at local, regional, state, and federal levels.
  • Provide feedback and coaching to volunteers and UW Extension educators in order to ensure volunteer code of conduct and policies are followed. This includes overseeing any volunteer corrective actions, in coordination with UW Extension educators and the Wyoming State 4-H Program Leader.
  • Engage with other offices at the University of Wyoming, as needed and including but not limited to, Human Resources, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Equal Employment Opportunity, etc.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Completed master’s degree. Conferred degree must be in volunteer development, youth development, agriculture education, extension education, K-12 education, or a closely related field.
  • 5+ years professional experience relevant to the Essential Job Duties (below) of this position.
  • Coursework and/or professional experience must provide a broad and significant understanding of volunteer development, youth development, educational leadership, extension education, risk management, human resources, and/or community vitality, along with a high degree of subject matter competence in these areas.
  • Valid driver's license with a motor vehicle record (MVR) compliant with the Driving for University Business SAP.

title: Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPM)
description:
Description: The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13-213, Airfield Driving. The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13-204 and DAFI 13-213. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have a *7-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
  • Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
  • Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
  • Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US CENTCOM Medical Exam

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
  • Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
  • Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
  • Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
  • Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
  • Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13-213 and local directives.
  • Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
  • Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
  • Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
  • Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.

title: Cyber Incident Response Analyst
description:
Cyber Incident Response Analyst II

Location: Cleveland, OH, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Overview

The Cyber Security Incident Response II is responsible for detecting, analyzing, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats and incidents across the enterprise. This role performs advanced threat detection, incident triage, forensic analysis, containment, and recovery activities coordinated across internal and external stakeholders.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in cyber security incident response, digital forensics, detection capabilities, and stakeholder engagement. This position requires the ability to independently manage complex cybersecurity incidents, collaborate effectively with business and technical teams, influence decision-making through risk-based recommendations, and perform successfully in time-sensitive and high-pressure environments.

This role partners with third-party service providers, vendors, infrastructure teams, and security engineering and architecture teams to strengthen the organization's security posture and improve incident response capabilities. The candidate will maintain a strong understanding of AmTrust's mission, vision, and values while upholding the highest standards of professionalism and service.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate security alerts, suspicious activity, and cybersecurity incidents to determine scope, impact, root cause, and remediation actions.
  • Lead the analysis and response efforts for medium- to high-complexity security incidents, ensuring timely containment, eradication, recovery, and documentation.
  • Perform digital forensics, log analysis, artifact collection and preservation, and host and network investigations using enterprise security monitoring and endpoint detection tools.
  • Analyze indicators of compromise (IOCs), tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and threat intelligence to support investigations.
  • Utilize SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence, cloud security, and case management platforms to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  • Develop and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, analytics, and response playbooks to improve detection and response capabilities.
  • Document investigation findings, incident timelines, root cause analysis, and lessons learned in accordance with established procedures.
  • Collaborate with IT, Security, Legal, Risk, HR, and Compliance teams as required during incident investigations.
  • Participate in tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and post-incident reviews to validate and improve response readiness.
  • Recommend improvements to security controls, detection content, monitoring coverage, and response processes based on investigative findings.
  • Participate in on-call and after-hours incident response support as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in cyber security incident response, digital forensics, security operations, threat hunting, or related cyber security disciplines.
  • Experience investigating and responding to security incidents in enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures, cyber attack methodologies, and incident response frameworks.
  • Experience working with security monitoring technologies, including SIEM, EDR/XDR, email security, identity security, and cloud security platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple investigations while maintaining attention to detail and documentation quality.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical findings and risk-based recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

Preferred:

  • Industry certifications such as Security+, CySA+, SecurityX (formerly CASP+) GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GNFA, CISSP, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications.
  • Experience investigating incidents across hybrid environments.
  • Experience conducting malware analysis, memory analysis, and digital forensic investigations.
  • Knowledge of scripting, automation, and query languages such as PowerShell, Python, KQL, SPL, or similar languages.
  • Experience operating in highly regulated industries and familiarity with applicable cybersecurity regulatory requirements.

What We Offer

AmTrust Financial Services offers a competitive compensation package and excellent career advancement opportunities. Our benefits include: Medical & Dental Plans, Life Insurance, including eligible spouses & children, Health Care Flexible Spending, Dependent Care, 401k Savings Plans, Paid Time Off.

AmTrust strives to create a diverse and inclusive culture where thoughts and ideas of all employees are appreciated and respected. This concept encompasses but is not limited to human differences with regard to race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, culture, religion or disabilities.

AmTrust values excellence and recognizes that by embracing the diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives of its workforce, it will sustain a competitive advantage and remain an employer of choice. Diversity is a business imperative, enabling us to attract, retain and develop the best talent available. We see diversity as more than just policies and practices. It is an integral part of who we are as a company, how we operate and how we see our future.

title: Senior Manager - Store Design
location: USCA > USA > California > Costa Mesa HQ - VAN
description:
At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture - visit VF Careers or .

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Senior Manager, Store Design at VF looks a little like this.

As a cross-brand Store Design leader on the VF Real Estate and Construction team, you will translate brand-led creative direction into scalable, buildable, and commercially relevant retail environments across VF’s portfolio. This role is accountable for executional design leadership, technical design development, and project-level delivery in partnership with Real Estate, Construction, Visual Merchandising, Merchandising, Operations, external agencies, vendors, and construction partners.

The strategy, consumer narrative, brand voice, and creative guardrails sit with each brand and the Brand Creative leader under the CMO organization. This role partners closely with those brand and creative leaders to ensure every store, fixture program, environmental element, and physical retail expression is executed with fidelity to the approved brand strategy while meeting construction, budget, schedule, operational, and scalability requirements.

This is a cross-brand role, not a role dedicated to one brand. The Senior Manager will flex across assigned VF brands and formats, bringing strong retail design judgment, disciplined execution, and a practical understanding of how concepts move from creative intent to physical space.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

  • Translate brand-led creative strategy, design principles, and consumer experience direction into executable retail design solutions across assigned VF brands.
  • Partner with brand leadership and Brand Creative leaders under the CMO organization to understand the intended consumer narrative, brand voice, creative guardrails, and priorities for each concept or project.
  • Lead design development and execution strategies in partnership with Real Estate and Construction, ensuring concepts can be delivered within approved scope, budget, timing, lease conditions, code requirements, and field realities.
  • Create, review, and refine architectural plans, space plans, fixture plans, reflected ceiling plans, interior elevations, material palettes, environmental graphics, and related design documentation.
  • Manage the handoff from approved brand direction to project execution, ensuring the final built environment reflects the approved brand intent without shifting strategic ownership away from the brand.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Visual Merchandising, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Real Estate, Construction, vendors, and external design partners to support aligned project delivery.
  • Prepare design presentations, regional store guidelines, fixture packages, project briefs, and approval materials that help leaders and partners make clear decisions.
  • Support prototype development, remodels, refreshes, shop-in-shops, partner retail concepts, fixture programs, value engineering, and scalable rollout solutions across brands and retail formats.
  • Act as the design execution liaison between brand creative teams, Real Estate, Construction, vendors, fabricators, agencies, and subcontractors, including site and vendor visits as needed to review fabrication, installation, and quality.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, cost pressures, timeline concerns, and execution gaps early, then partner with the appropriate functional owners to resolve them.
  • Champion consistency, quality, sustainability-minded solutions, and operational practicality in physical retail environments while respecting each brand’s distinct creative identity.
  • Maintain a current understanding of retail design, materials, fixtures, customer experience, culture, product storytelling, and competitive retail environments to inform strong executional recommendations.

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundational skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. While a formal architectural education and applicable undergraduate or architecture degree are nice to have, we are most interested in 7+ years of technically progressive experience designing and delivering retail environments, with demonstrated experience translating brand identity, storytelling, and consumer experience direction into built retail spaces.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, technical design development, built outcomes, and the ability to translate brand identity into physical retail environments.
  • Proven 2D and 3D concept visualization expertise, from hand sketching through polished presentation renderings and technical documentation.
  • Experience working in a cross-brand, matrixed, or multi-stakeholder environment where strategy and execution are owned by different teams.
  • Strong understanding of retail architecture, interiors, fixtures, materials, lighting, environmental graphics, fabrication, installation, and construction coordination.
  • Ability to partner effectively with brand creative teams while maintaining practical discipline around budget, schedule, scope, code, operations, and constructability.
  • Comfort using design and technical software tools such as Rhino, Enscape, VRay, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, Keynote, and related platforms. Grasshopper, Unreal, or AR/VR/XR experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated success supporting retail concept rollouts, store remodels, refresh programs, fixture prototypes, partner retail environments, and value-engineering efforts.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate tradeoffs clearly to brand, creative, construction, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize resources across multiple brands, projects, and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to move quickly, efficiently, and accurately from concept through execution.
  • A genuine interest in footwear, apparel, equipment, lifestyle, performance products, and how product storytelling translates into physical retail experiences.
  • A strong awareness of contemporary culture, design, retail experience, and customer behavior across multiple consumer segments.
  • Location requirement: Timberland HQ, Stratham, NH or Vans HQ, Costa Mesa, CA

title: Kosmetologi
description:
Kauneuskeskus Pinjami etsii kosmetologia osaksi tiimiään

Kauneuskeskus Pinjami on hämeenlinnalainen kauneushoitola, jossa korkea laatu, ammattitaito ja asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoitokokemuksen varmistaminen ovat toiminnan ydintä.

Haemme nyt tiimiimme omalla toiminimellä työskentelevää kosmetologia, jolle hoitolatyö on jo jonkin verran tuttua. Pääset työskentelemään itsenäisenä yrittäjänä osana hyväntuulista ja kokenutta tiimiä, jossa saat tukea, mahdollisuuden oppia uutta sekä kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

Meille tärkeintä ei ole kokemusvuosiesi määrä, vaan hyvä asenne. Arvostamme erityisesti, että sinulla on:

  • ammattiylpeyttä ja halua tehdä laadukasta työtä

  • aitoa kiinnostusta asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisesta hyvinvoinnista

  • yrittäjähenkinen ote tekemiseen

  • positiivinen tekemisen meininki ja halu kehittää itseäsi jatkuvasti

Millainen tuleva työpaikkasi on?

Kauneuskeskus Pinjami on palvellut asiakkaitaan Hämeenlinnassa jo yli 25 vuoden ajan. Pinjamin suosio on vuosien varrella rakentunut laadukkaasta työstä, henkilökohtaisesta palvelusta ja asiakkaiden luottamuksesta – samoista arvoista, joiden toivomme näkyvän myös uudessa tiimikaverissamme.

description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

EMV Chip Product Specialist

What does a great EMV Chip Product Specialist at Fiserv do?

Fiserv is seeking an experienced payment card professional to lead the evolution of our EMV chip product portfolio supporting banks, credit unions, fintechs, and commercial issuers across the United States.

As an EMV Chip Product SME, you will serve as a trusted advisor and product expert responsible for the development, implementation, and lifecycle management of payment chip products. You will work closely with issuing clients, card networks, chip manufacturers, card personalization partners, and internal product teams to deliver secure, complaint, and innovative payment solutions.

This position combines product ownership, industry expertise, and client engagement. The ideal candidate understands the business, technical, operational, and regulatory aspects of EMV chip programs and can translate market requirements into scalable product solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Own and manage the lifecycle of EMV chip products across debit, credit, prepaid, commercial, and emerging payment programs
  • Define product requirements, roadmap priorities, and enhancement opportunities for EMV chip technologies
  • Monitor industry trends, network mandates, and technology changes related to contactless payments, digital authentication, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) cryptography, and EMVCo specifications
  • Partner with cross-functional product, technology, operations, and client teams to develop business cases and prioritize investments
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to issuing banks, credit unions, fintech issuers, and strategic clients on chip strategy, migration planning, personalization requirements, and industry changes
  • Lead implementation and maintenance of EMV chip profiles, application configurations, personalization standards, and risk management parameters
  • Collaborate with chip manufacturers, card personalization bureaus, and technology vendors to evaluate capabilities, support sourcing activities, and manage ongoing relationships
  • Track compliance requirements and readiness activities related to Mastercard, Visa, American Express, Discover, EMVCo specifications, and future payment technology initiatives

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in the payment card industry supporting issuer, processor, network, or card manufacturing environments
  • 5+ years of experience with EMV chip products, payment card personalization, card manufacturing, issuer processing, or payment network technologies
  • 6+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving product, technology, operations, and client stakeholders
  • Experience working with EMV contact and contactless payment technologies, chip profile configuration, network certification requirements, and payment card personalization standards
  • Experience using ticketing, monitoring, and reporting tools to track incidents, service requests, and system performance
  • Ability to analyze transaction flows, interpret system behavior, and communicate technical findings to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience supporting EMV product ownership at a bank, credit union, fintech, processor, or other issuer organization
  • Experience with card personalization, chip data preparation, chip script configuration, or card issuance solutions
  • Knowledge of network chip frameworks and certification processes including Mastercard M/Chip, Visa VSDC, Discover D-PAS, American Express AEIPS, and EMVCo specifications
  • Experience with emerging payment technologies such as contactless-only products, tokenization, mobile wallet enablement, FIDO authentication, secure element technologies, or digital credential solutions

description:

About the Role:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Business Applications Analyst to drive and manage cross-functional transformation initiatives that align with our company’s strategic objectives. This role requires a dynamic leader with a proven ability to transform business processes and functions through effective cross-functional teaming, rigorous program management, and exceptional communication. The ideal candidate will serve as a thought leader and change agent, driving innovation and operational excellence across the enterprise.

Responsibilities include:

  • Thought Leadership: Recommend creative and innovative solutions to strategic business problems leveraging industry best practices and insights from the analysis of internal and external data.
  • Operational Improvements: Identify inefficiencies and lead efforts to streamline operations and improve productivity.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with Business Leads to support the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Lead teams across departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations, Product, Technology) to ensure seamless integration and execution of transformation efforts.
  • Program Management: Create project plans, manage timelines, budgets, risks, and resources, and ensure successful delivery of transformation projects.
  • Change Management: Design and implement change management strategies to support adoption and sustainability of new processes and technologies.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels to ensure transparency, alignment, and buy-in.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track metrics that will monitor the success of transformation initiatives; adjust strategies based on performance data.
  • Communication & Reporting: Prepare and deliver clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership. Create visualizations and presentations to communicate project status, risks, and recommendations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in program management, business transformation, or strategic operations.
  • Proven track record for partnering with cross-functional teams and delivering significant business impact (e.g., Finance, Sales, Operations, Product Development, Customer Experience, Customer Success or Cloud), with a strong understanding of their KPIs and operational models.
  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma) strongly preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise project management tools (e.g., Asana, MS Project, Smartsheet). Service Now SPM a plus.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable improvements in operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback and high adoption rates of new processes or systems.
  • Timely and on-budget delivery of transformation projects.

title: Analytics Scientist I

title: Customs Broker Administrator
description:
Job Description

Join us to create change and have an impact in homes around the world.

At Electrolux, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people, and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

All about the role:

This position will have responsibility for preparing, reviewing, and submitting U.S. Customs entries to ensure compliant and timely importation of goods. This role supports licensed Customs Brokers by handling entry documentation, tariff classification, data accuracy, and coordination with government agencies, while ensuring compliance with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) regulations and other Participating Government Agencies (PGAs).

Where you’ll be:

This position will be based El Paso, TX.

What you’ll do:

  • Prepare, review, and transmit high‑volume land border customs entries (01, 03) through ACE in compliance with CBP regulations.

  • Verify the accuracy of the information declared on the Customs Entry Summary (CF 7501) including the Harmonized Tariff Schedule number, description, importer of record number, country of origin, duty rate, AD/CVD case numbers, Special Program Indicator (SPI) and entered value and work with the Customshouse Broker and the Customs Specialist to facilitate corrections as needed.

  • Process truck and FAST lane entries, ensuring timely clearance to minimize border delays

  • Accurately classify imported merchandise using the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTSUS

  • Review commercial invoices, packing lists, transportation documents, and ACE data for accuracy and compliance

  • Monitor and respond to CBP holds, secondary inspections, and X‑ray examinations.

  • Process shipments subject to Participating Government Agency (PGA) requirements, including FDA, USDA, EPA, FCC, and DOT. Communicate professionally with CBP officers and Port personnel to

  • resolve entry discrepancies or delays.

  • Assist with post‑entry corrections, amendments, and compliance reviews.

  • Maintain complete and accurate records in accordance with CBP recordkeeping requirements.

  • Identify potential compliance risks common to border operations and escalate concerns to the Licensed Customs Broker.

  • Meet strict deadlines in a fast‑paced, high‑volume border environment, including same‑day clearances.

  • Support C‑TPAT, FAST, and Trusted Trader Program requirements when applicable.

  • Maintain confidentiality of client and proprietary information.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support brokerage operations.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma required.

  • Minimum 1 year import/export experience preferred.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and Word.

  • Fluent in English and Spanish written and oral communication.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Knowledge of how organizations function and how to get things done through formal and informal channels.

Benefits highlights:

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.

  • Competitive holiday and vacation time off program.

  • Retirement Savings Plan (401(k)) with relevant company contribution

  • Discounted products and an EAP upon hire and tuition reimbursement after 12 months of service.

Please be advised that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon 1P Credito, Payments
description:
Are you excited about building the future of digital lending at massive scale? Do you want to design and build systems that power credit experiences for millions of customers in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing fintech markets?

The Credit & Lending team at Amazon Pay is building Amazon's next-generation lending platform to enable seamless credit experiences for millions of customers across Latin America. We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer to join our Brazil engineering team and build highly scalable, resilient lending systems from the ground up.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You'll design and deliver critical components of the lending platform including underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, regulatory reporting, and customer-facing experiences. You'll work with latest fintech challenges: real-time decisioning, payment orchestration, compliance automation, and financial data integrity at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants deep ownership, loves solving hard technical problems, and is energized by the ambiguity and pace of building something new in a regulated, high-stakes domain.

What You'll Do
Design and build core services for the 1P Lending platform in Brazil—spanning underwriting, servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Write high-quality, production-ready code for backend and Frontend services, with a focus on reliability, testability, and operational excellence.
Own system architecture decisions for your area—API design, data modeling, event-driven flows, and integration patterns with internal and external partners.
Build for compliance—implement systems that meet Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank reporting, PIX, Open Finance) with auditability and data integrity baked in.
Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.
Solve ambiguous problems—break down complex business and regulatory requirements into clean, extensible technical solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.
Contribute to platform reuse—build shared libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns that enable scaling across LATAM markets.
Raise the bar—participate actively in code reviews, design reviews, and hiring. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Integrate new payment methods (e.g. local credit/debit cards, digital wallets, bank transfers) into the Amazon platform
- Enhance existing payment flows to optimize conversion, reduce friction, and improve reliability
- Ensure payment systems are highly available, secure, and able to handle growing transaction volumes
- Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment processes to maintain quality
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and technical debt

A day in the life
Own a critical product pillar of the 1P Lending platform in Brazil (define the product vision, technical strategy, and execution roadmap.
Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).
Establish operational excellence—own system availability, latency, monitoring, alarming, on-call processes, and incident management for your product area.
Influence the broader platform by contributing reusable components, shared libraries, and cross-market architectural patterns.

About the team
The Brazil Payments team is responsible for enabling a wide range of payment options for Amazon customers in Brazil. We work to continuously improve the payment experience, increase conversion, and support the growth of Amazon's business in the region. Our team is known for its technical expertise, customer-obsession, and ability to deliver innovative payment solutions.

title: Tech Lead Product Manager
description:
About the Role

The Loyalty Lead Product Manager is the product owner for Williams-Sonoma, Inc.’s customer loyalty domain. This role owns the strategy, roadmap, requirements, delivery, and operational health of experiences spanning loyalty enrollment and account creation, loyalty-aware order placement, earning and redemption, and the generation and delivery of rewards and certificates. The role serves as the primary product authority for loyalty capabilities across digital and store journeys and translates customer, business, and partner needs into clear technology priorities.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Loyalty Experience

• Own the product experience for loyalty account creation, member identification, order placement, earning, reward and certificate delivery, redemption, returns, and servicing.

• Provide product consultation, requirements guidance, and sign-off for loyalty-related capabilities across PIP, Cart, Checkout, account/rewards experiences, and store journeys.

• Ensure customer-facing messaging, business rules, eligibility, identity and account-linking requirements, and exception paths are clearly defined and consistently implemented.

• Partner with UX and research teams to simplify complex loyalty concepts and create intuitive, accessible customer experiences.

Delivery and Integration Leadership

• Lead product discovery and delivery from problem definition through requirements, design, build, testing, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Define and approve product requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and release-readiness expectations.

• Manage dependencies across eCommerce, stores, order management, customer identity/profile, payments, finance and reporting, marketing technology, and loyalty platforms.

• Partner with Engineering, UX, PMO, Site Management, Quality Engineering, and operational teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.

• Provide direction and approval for loyalty integration and implementation decisions involving external loyalty, credit-card, and platform partners, as applicable.

Production and Operational Leadership

• Lead product assessment and decision-making for loyalty production issues, balancing customer impact, revenue risk, program commitments, operational effort, and long-term product health.

• Coordinate Production Support, Engineering, Loyalty Operations, Store Operations, Customer Care, Finance, and business teams through triage, resolution, communication, and follow-up.

• Establish operational readiness for launches, including monitoring, support processes, escalation paths, business validation, and stakeholder communications.

• Identify recurring issues and convert root causes into durable product, process, or platform improvements.

Stakeholder Leadership and Governance

• Represent the loyalty product domain in Loyalty Business meetings, and internal product and technology forums.

• Build alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, PMO, Marketing, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Site Management, Store Operations, Customer Care, and executive stakeholders.

• Communicate product decisions, priorities, risks, trade-offs, milestones, and outcomes with clarity and appropriate executive-level context.

• Create strong working relationships with internal teams and external partners while maintaining clear ownership, accountability, and decision rights.

Product Strategy and Portfolio Planning

• Develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for loyalty capabilities.

• Play a leading role in annual Marketing Product portfolio planning by identifying customer pain points, business opportunities, platform needs, and investment priorities.

• Translate opportunities into well-defined initiatives with clear outcomes, scope, assumptions, dependencies, and success measures.

• Use customer insights, operational data, financial impact, and program performance to make roadmap trade-offs and sequencing decisions.

Criteria

• 8 + years of product management experience owning complex, customer-facing platforms or end-to-end journeys in retail, eCommerce, or a comparable digital environment.

• 5+ years of direct loyalty-program experience, including member enrollment, accrue and redeem points/rewards certificates, and partner integrations.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent work experience.

• Proven ability to translate business strategy and customer needs into product roadmaps, requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable delivery plans.

• Strong systems thinking and technical fluency across APIs and integrations, data flows, customer identity and account linking, order lifecycle, and operational support.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority in a matrixed organization.

• Strong product judgment, analytical problem-solving, and executive communication, and the ability to make timely decisions in ambiguous or high-impact situations.

• Experience with Agile product delivery practices and close partnership with Engineering, UX, QA, PMO, and business teams.

• Multi-brand, omnichannel retail experience spanning both digital and store journeys preferred.

• Experience with co-branded or private-label credit-card programs and financial-services partners preferred.

• Experience with enterprise loyalty platforms such as Kobie, Salesforce Loyalty Management, or a comparable solution preferred.

• Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, and complex third-party dependencies preferred.

• This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco, CA office Monday through Thursday.

Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

  • A generous discount on all WSI brands

  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, NA Supply Chain Execution- Production Planning Team
description:
Amazon's North America Supply Chain moves millions of packages every day through a network of over 300 fulfillment and sort centers. The Production Planning team is responsible for deciding how many people we need, where we need them, and when — across every site, every shift, every week. Getting this right means customers get packages on time. Getting it wrong means millions in wasted labor or missed delivery promises.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer who will build the analytics backbone that powers these planning decisions. You will not just write queries and build dashboards. You will own the data infrastructure that hundreds of planners and operators rely on every single week to make headcount and capacity decisions across the network. Your work will directly influence how Amazon allocates tens of thousands of labor hours and millions of dollars in workforce spend.

This is a high ownership role. You will take ambiguous business questions, figure out where the data lives, build the pipeline to transform it, deliver it in a format stakeholders can act on, and then measure whether it actually drove better decisions. You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, business intelligence, and operational planning at a scale few companies can offer.

Key job responsibilities
Own the development and maintenance of dashboards and automated reports that surface critical production planning metrics to stakeholders across the NASC network.

Collaborate with cross functional business teams including NASC Operations, Workforce Staffing, Network Design and Planning, and Regional Planning to translate workforce planning questions into analytical frameworks and deliver actionable insights that drive real decisions.

Design, build, and deploy data pipelines using Python, SQL, AWS Lambda, Athena, and Redshift. Monitor pipeline health proactively. Ensure reliable and timely data delivery aligned to weekly planning cadences where a one day delay means planners are flying blind.

Build and maintain curated datasets that serve as the single source of truth for capacity planning across the network. This includes a centralized data lake with well defined schemas, partition strategies, lineage documentation, and freshness SLAs that multiple downstream consumers depend on.

Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual data processing. Every hour a planner spends pulling data manually is an hour they are not spending on strategic planning decisions. Your job is to eliminate that waste through scalable self service solutions.

Maintain clear documentation of data sources, business logic, transformation rules, and dataset schemas.

A day in the life
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you'll monitor pipeline health and resolve data quality issues to keep analytics reliable. You'll partner with operations leadership to scope new requests, translating business questions into analytical solutions. You'll design and refine data products: dashboards, models, and self-service tools while iterating quickly on stakeholder feedback. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate the datasets that power planning decisions, ensuring accuracy and trust. And you'll continuously improve your work by documenting transformation logic, automating manual processes, and proactively surfacing recommendations that help business leaders make confident, data-driven decisions.

About the team
The PPT BI team is the analytics function within North America Supply Chain's production planning organization. We build data pipelines, automated reports, and self service dashboards that help planners and operations leaders make workforce and capacity decisions across a large network of fulfillment and sort centers. We are a small team with high ownership where you operate end to end — from requirements to production. You will partner with operations, staffing, network design, and regional planning teams on work that directly influences how labor is allocated across the network.

The ideal candidate will have effective communication skills across multiple platforms (phone, email, in-person, virtual), as well as the ability to organize, manage, and track multiple, detailed tasks and assignments with frequently changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, task-oriented work environment. title: Sr Analyst, Strategic Finance
description:
Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.


About the Team:
You will join UKG’s Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis team within Strategic Finance. Our team sits at the center of some of the company’s most important decisions, helping translate strategy into disciplined financial choices and measurable outcomes. We partner closely with senior leaders across finance and the business to evaluate investments, assess performance, support mergers and acquisitions, and guide capital allocation across the portfolio. This is a team for people who want to combine rigorous analysis with real influence.
About the Role:
As a Sr Financial Analyst – Strategic Finance, you will help drive UKG’s most important strategic and financial decisions. You will develop insights, models, and recommendations that shape long-range planning, value creation, investment prioritization, and executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who is highly analytical, commercially minded, and excited to work on complex, high-impact questions across the business.
• You will translate UKG’s long-term strategy into robust financial plans, including business cases, investment requirements, operational milestones, and expected returns.
• You will assess performance against value creation objectives, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend actions to improve outcomes.
• You will support mergers and acquisitions by evaluating valuation assumptions, synergy opportunities, and execution feasibility in partnership with corporate development and operating leaders.
• You will help guide capital allocation by comparing investment opportunities across the company and identifying where resources can generate the highest return.
• You will analyze pricing, customer economics, and cost structure drivers to uncover opportunities to accelerate growth and expand profitability.
• You will monitor competitor results, market signals, and public company disclosures to identify shifts in strategy, spending, and performance that should inform UKG’s decisions.
• You will prepare clear, executive-ready analyses and recommendations for senior finance leaders, including support for ad hoc strategic questions.
About You:
Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
• Experience in strategic finance, financial planning and analysis, investment banking, consulting, corporate development, or a related analytical role.
• Experience building complex financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses in Microsoft Excel.
• Experience communicating analytical findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders through presentations, written materials, and discussions.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience supporting long-range planning, portfolio decision-making, or enterprise investment strategy.
• Experience evaluating mergers and acquisitions, including synergy analysis, diligence support, and scenario modeling.
• Experience identifying performance improvement opportunities through pricing, customer economics, or cost structure analysis.
• Experience working in a public company, software company, or other fast-paced, data-rich environment.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. title: Doctoral Researcher in Simulation of Variable Speed Electric Machines with Advanced Magnetic Material
description:
Aalto University is where science and art meet technology and business. We shape a sustainable future by making research breakthroughs in and across our disciplines, sparking the game changers of tomorrow and creating novel solutions to major global challenges. Our community is made up of 120 nationalities, 16 000 students, 446 professors and 5200 employees working on our dynamic campus in Espoo, Greater Helsinki, Finland. Diversity is part of who we are, and we actively work to ensure our community’s diversity and inclusiveness. This is why we warmly encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to join our community.

We are currently seeking one highly motivated doctoral researcher to join the Department of Electrical Engineering and Automation at Aalto University, Finland, within a project focused on implementing advanced models of soft magnetic materials in accurate simulation software. The developed laminated‑steel models will be evaluated using an experimental setup equipped with variable‑speed electric machines. The objective of this evaluation is to determine whether the proposed model improves the prediction of additional losses introduced by the manufacturing process.

The successful candidate will contribute to research on generalizing some advanced magnetic material model developed at Aalto University. The focus on anisotropy and punching deterioration will enable the effective incorporation of detailed material models in design tools for the next-generation variable-speed electric machines feed by frequency converters. The development and implementation of the magnetic model into a finite-element-based software toolbox will be at Aalto University. The experimental validation will include sample-level characterizations as well as measurements on electric machines of varying power rating and machine topologies. The machine-level studies will be carried out in cooperation with ABB Corporate Research Sweden, Västerås.

Research Focus

The doctoral researcher will focus on topics including (but not limited to):

  • Experimental characterization of several grades of laminated steels for electric machines whose magnetic properties are subjected to manufacturing-related degradation (e.g., mechanical stresses due to punching)

  • Generalizing the model of magnetic deterioration to account for the residual mechanical stresses due to the punching process on electric steels of different grades and thicknesses.

  • Contribute to the implementation of the dynamic vector models in the finite element code

  • Numerical analysis of additional losses in the operating conditions of simulated variable-speed electric machines

  • Validate the developed simulation models by experimental evaluation of the additional losses in the variable-speed electric machines

Requirements

Eligible candidates should have

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, materials sciences, or a closely related field

  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a research team

If you are chosen for this position, you will apply for the study right in doctoral studies at Aalto University School of Electrical Engineering. Thus, please see the student information and admission criteria at .

Desired background

We are looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following areas:

  • Modelling and simulation of variable speed electric machines

  • Numerical methods for finite element simulations

  • Magnetism in polycrystalline microstructures

  • Magneto-mechanical interaction in ferromagnetism

Experience or strong interest in the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Programming skills (MATLAB, Python, or C/C++)

  • Real-time and instrumentation platform (dSpace, LabView)

  • Microscopic measurements (X-Ray, EBSD)

What we offer

  • Fully funded doctoral researcher’s position at Aalto University, which is consistently ranked among the top universities in Europe.The work is done in close cooperation with ABB Västerås, worldwide industry leader in electric motor and drives.

  • The position is fixed term and follows Aalto's standard 2+2 model. It will be made initially for two years, with a six-month probationary period, and extended by two further years after a successful mid-term review, giving a total duration of four years.

  • The position starts in November 2026 or as mutually agreed

  • The salary will be based on both the job requirements and the employee’s personal performance in accordance with the salary system of Finnish universities. The starting salary for a doctoral researcher is 3143 €/month.

  • Opportunity to work in a high-impact industrial research project with leading academic and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art laboratories for magnetic characterization and motor drive testing.

  • A stimulating international research environment.

  • An opportunity to transpose academic research into the industrial perspective.

Ready to apply?

If you want to join our community, please submit your application through our recruitment site (”Apply now!” at the bottom of the page) by 1 October 2026.

To apply, please share the following application materials in English and in pdf-format with us:

  • Motivation letter

  • CV including information of at least two referees.

  • Copy of your academic transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees.

Please note: Aalto University’s employees should apply for the position via our internal HR system Workday (Internal Jobs) by using their existing Workday user account (not via the external webpage for open positions). If you are a student or visitor at Aalto University, please apply with your personal email address (not aalto.fi) via Aalto University open positions.

If you wish to hear more about the position, you can reach out to Doctor Floran Martin (floran.martin@aalto.fi), or Professor Anouar Belahcen (anouar.belahcen@aalto.fi) from Aalto University. Feel free to contact Doctor Marco Biasion (marco.biasion@se.abb.com) or Doctor David Lindell (david.lindell@se.abb.com). title: IT Scrum Master IRES - SSFB/HSV
description:
Position Title: IT Scrum Master

Location: Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO or Redstone Arsenal, Huntsville, AL

Relocation Assistance: None available at this time

Remote/Telework: NO - Not available for this position

Clearance Type: DoW Secret

Shift: Day shift

Travel Required: Up to 10% of the time

Description of Duties:

The IT Scrum Master supports the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract. The candidate will:

The IT Scrum Master supports the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract. The candidate will work in close partnership with the Release Train Engineer (RTE). Because our technical teams are geographically dispersed, this position will operate in an onsite, hybrid environment, facilitating collaboration across a mix of in-person and virtual team members in both Huntsville and Colorado Springs.

The candidate will:

  • Partner directly with the RTE to define, mature, and align the Scrum Master role with program-level SAFe frameworks and Agile release trains.
  • Collaborate with the RTE to design, implement, and train the IT team on customized Agile processes, helping technical staff smoothly transition to a structured Agile delivery model.
  • Establish a cohesive "one-team" dynamic across geographically split locations (HSV and COS) by leveraging virtual collaboration tools and maintaining an inclusive hybrid engagement model.
  • Facilitate an optimized Agile battle rhythm tailored to the unique operational needs and delivery cycles of the IT and infrastructure teams.
  • Guide and coach the team and organization on how to use Agile/Scrum practices to deliver high-quality IT solutions.
  • Assist the Product Owner and Technical Leads with backlog maintenance, prioritizing IT initiatives, and translating technical requirements into actionable user stories.
  • Assist the team by making sure all data for planning is documented into the system of record for accurate reporting and metrics development.
  • Deliver metrics to the RTE on a reoccurring (weekly) basis.
  • Identify, track, and actively resolve impediments or blockers that hinder the team’s ability to meet Sprint goals.
  • Manage and track team capacity, sprint velocity, and burn-down charts using Agile lifecycle management tools.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination and dependency management, especially when rolling out complex enterprise system upgrades or resolving break/fix activities.
  • Ensure that IT service delivery and cybersecurity compliance tasks are properly integrated into the Agile workflow.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability within the team.

The successful candidate will:

  • Possess a strong leadership presence with the ability to influence and mentor highly technical engineers who may be new to Agile frameworks.
  • Be a collaborative partner capable of aligning team-level operations with the broader organizational vision defined by the program's RTE.
  • Be highly proficient in managing remote/virtual team dynamics, ensuring active participation and communication across multiple time zones.
  • Be able to quickly learn challenging IT and infrastructure concepts to better understand team impediments and technical debt.
  • Be comfortable operating in an ambiguous, "greenfield" environment to build and document standard Agile processes from the ground up.
  • Effectively function as a self-starter, identifying project risks, resource bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve team efficiency.
  • Have excellent presentation, oral, and written skills to facilitate effective interchanges with senior customer management, Product Owners, and technical staff.
  • Have a "can-do" attitude, be able to work in a very high-pace and dynamic enterprise IT environment and embrace change.

Resumes, in month and year format, must be submitted with application in order to be considered for the position. The selected candidate may be assigned as an employee for one of our teammate companies.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must have 4, or more, years of general (full-time) work experience
    • May be reduced with completion of advanced education
  • Must have 2, or more, years of directly related experience acting as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Project Manager.
  • Must hold a current Agile certification (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM)).
  • Must have experience using Agile management and collaboration tools (such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps) to facilitate remote and hybrid teams.
  • Must have experience applying Agile methodologies to IT operations.
  • Must have an active DoW Secret Security Clearance
  • Must be able to obtain an active DoW Top Secret Security Clearance.

Desired Requirements:

  • Have an active DoD Top Secret Security Clearance.
  • Have prior experience in Agile/Scrum practices within a technical team, ideally under the guidance of an RTE or Agile Coach.
  • Have experience working within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), particularly in a DoD or government contracting environment.
  • Have a technical background or previous experience in System Administration, Network Engineering, or IT Service Management.
  • Have experience integrating ITIL methodologies (Change, Incident, Problem management) with Agile processes.
  • Have a current DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE)
  • Have familiarity with DoD cybersecurity processes, such as RMF, Secure Host Baselines, and DISA STIGs.
  • Have Advanced Agile certifications (e.g., A-CSM, PSM II, PMI-ACP, or SAFe Release Train Engineer).
