Why this job matters:

Working closely with data engineering, application engineering, infrastructure, security, architecture, analytics, business intelligence, product, and vendor teams, leads the operational management, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise database and cloud data platforms. Accountable for managing a team responsible for database administration, production support, access governance, release support, performance optimization, backup and recovery, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, automation, platform modernization across legacy, on-premises, cloud-hosted, and cloud-native data environments. Ensures that data platforms are secure, compliant, performant, resilient, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, data governance, SDLC, DevOps, and operational standards.

Platform scope: Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, Oracle databases and Oracle-based data platforms, IBM Netezza, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure-based data services, data integration touchpoints with Power BI and analytical tools, and Salesforce Data Cloud knowledge where applicable.

What you will do:

  • Lead and manage the Data Platform Operations team responsible for administration, operational support, reliability, governance, security, performance, and modernization of enterprise database and cloud data platforms.
  • Own day-to-day operational coverage for Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Netezza, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and other Azure-based data platforms, ensuring production issues, service requests, and project support are prioritized and resolved effectively.
  • Provide management oversight for database access management activities, including user provisioning, service account governance, access reviews, recertifications, least-privilege controls, and remediation of access-related audit findings.
  • Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance stakeholders to ensure database platforms and data services meet enterprise security, privacy, auditability, retention, and regulatory expectations.
  • Lead operational support for database release and change management, including review and approval of database deployment activities, execution oversight for database scripts, production readiness, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation.
  • Coordinate database infrastructure and environment management activities, including database builds, refreshes, data movement between environments, Snowflake clones, Azure SQL refreshes, Oracle and PostgreSQL refreshes, and test environment readiness.
  • Ensure effective production support and incident management across supported platforms, including response to performance issues, failed or delayed batch jobs, data refresh failures, integration issues, security events, and database availability concerns.
  • Manage platform monitoring practices using Grafana, native cloud monitoring, Snowflake monitoring, SQL Server tooling, Oracle tooling, and other operational observability capabilities to proactively identify availability, capacity, performance, and security risks.
  • Drive database performance and optimization practices, including query tuning, warehouse and compute utilization analysis, storage optimization, reporting workload optimization, and partnership with analytics and application teams on performance remediation.
  • Oversee storage, capacity, and cost management activities across database platforms, including SQL Server storage management, Snowflake warehouse utilization, Azure data platform consumption, archival strategies, cleanup activities, and database consolidation opportunities.
  • Lead backup, recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery planning and execution, including database recovery strategies, DR testing, Snowflake replication, account failover readiness, and platform resilience improvements.
  • Manage vulnerability and security remediation activities for database platforms, including assessment of platform findings, patch coordination, remediation tracking, authentication modernization, security event monitoring, and compliance reporting.
  • Oversee SQL Server licensing and database rationalization activities, including license audits, consolidation planning, compatibility assessments, and migration planning to Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance where appropriate.
  • Provide management and technical guidance for Snowflake platform administration, including RBAC, service user conversion, warehouse performance, data pipeline support, replication, account redirect/failover capabilities, Snowpark, notebooks, and new capability evaluation.
  • Guide teams on appropriate platform selection and modernization patterns across relational databases, analytical platforms, cloud-native data services, data lake architectures, and enterprise reporting workloads.
  • Partner with application development, data engineering, analytics, architecture, infrastructure, and vendor teams to review solution designs, identify operational impacts, establish support models, and ensure data platform readiness for new initiatives.
  • Build and mature operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, support documentation, release documentation, platform standards, service catalog items, and knowledge articles for repeatable platform operations.
  • Drive automation and process improvement efforts, including user provisioning automation, recurring refresh automation, Snowflake clone automation, catalog workflow enhancements, ad-hoc query automation, data archival automation, and recurring operational task reduction.
  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop database administrators and data platform engineers, setting clear priorities, supporting technical growth, managing workload, and promoting consistent operational practices.
  • Manage vendor, partner, and cross-functional relationships supporting data platform operations, ensuring service quality, issue escalation, knowledge transfer, and alignment to enterprise operating models.
  • Track and communicate operational health, risks, incidents, capacity trends, platform improvements, project commitments, audit activities, and modernization opportunities to technology leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Continuously assess emerging capabilities across Snowflake, Azure data services, SQL platforms, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Salesforce Data Cloud, monitoring tools, automation frameworks, and data governance tooling to recommend practical improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5-7 years of experience in database administration, data platform operations, infrastructure operations, data engineering operations, or a closely related enterprise technology discipline.
  • 3-5 years of experience leading teams, managing technical resources, coordinating operational work, or serving in a senior lead role responsible for database or data platform support.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting production database platforms in an enterprise environment with responsibilities spanning availability, performance, security, access management, change management, backup/recovery, and incident response.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise database operations, including administration, monitoring, performance tuning, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, capacity management, storage management, security, and production support practices.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, Oracle, IBM Netezza, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and related Azure data platform capabilities.
  • Ability to manage operational priorities across incidents, service requests, access requests, audit activities, release work, project support, platform upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of data platform security and governance, including role-based access control, least privilege, service account governance, recertifications, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, encryption concepts, retention, and data protection practices.
  • Experience leading production incident response and root cause analysis for database and data platform issues affecting applications, reporting, batch processing, analytics workloads, and data pipelines.
  • Ability to evaluate database performance issues, query optimization needs, compute and warehouse utilization, storage concerns, reporting workload bottlenecks, connectivity issues, and platform configuration risks.

title: Fire Prevention & Protection Specialist
description:
The Fire Prevention & Protection Specialist is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the fire prevention and protection assets across assigned PCG locations. The Fire Prevention & Protection Specialist provides hands‑on operational support, conducts field assessments, contractor management, and leads site‑level and group‑level EHS improvement initiatives.

Additional Information:

This role is not remote/hybrid. This role will report to Sherwin-Williams Global Headquarters located at 1 Sherwin Way, Cleveland, OH 44113 and will have at least 10% travel.

  1. Fire Systems

description:

Role and Scope of Position:

This is an entry level position requiring limited experience responsible for handling assignments in support of Eversource’s wireless telecommunications operations. Handles assignments, under close supervision, associated with planning and performing installation, acceptance testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair of wireless telecommunication systems. Provides wireless communication support, guidance, and advice to customers including but not limited to technical services, engineering, information technology, electrical system operations, control centers, dispatch, customer service, field communications, emergency preparedness, as well as emergency response tactical trailers and Mobile Response Center (MRC) vehicles, etc. Participates in various projects to continually improve and upgrade telecommunications infrastructure. Eversource’s wireless communications systems are composed of but not limited to, analog and digital communication systems, dispatch console systems, voice and data radio systems, WAN, and associated peripheral equipment. Technologies including but not limited to radio frequency modulation, antenna systems, radio wave propagation, IP, T1, serial communications, carrier ethernet, phone and satellite communications systems.

Essential Functions:

  • Gain understanding of radio frequency principles and theories for telecommunications systems of varying complexity.
  • Under close supervision, supports the installation, modification, replacement, removal, and maintenance of wireless telecommunications systems, devices, hardware/software/firmware including programing, wiring, configuring settings, and installing updates.
  • Under close supervision, test, analyze, troubleshoot, and repair WANs, coaxial transmission line, RF connectors, transmitters, receivers and uses basic networking essentials for WAN testing and troubleshooting.
  • Capable of performing work on analog and digital radio systems (including but not limited to, DMR, WAN, base stations, mobiles, portables), voice recorders, servers, routers, voice dispatch consoles, etc. Supported protocols include but are not limited to OpenSky, ethernet, IP, T1, MPLS/IP, 4W E&M, serial data, etc.

  • Analyze test results, makes recommendations to engineering, operations, and other departments based on wireless characteristics or performance; reports and explains details of wireless performance and issues to other personnel; returns equipment to service following repair.

  • Ability to neatly install and maintain bulk cabling, safe and proper dressing techniques, and apply principles of cable management in data centers, communication sites, cabinets, and vehicles, etc.
  • Maintains awareness of and ensures compliance with safe work practices, engineering standards, regulatory and/or operational requirements.
  • Other related duties as assigned.
  • Must work on-call and during emergency restoration efforts as required.

Technical Knowledge/Skill/Education/Licenses/Certifications:

Technical Knowledge/Skill:

  • Knowledge of electrical and electronic components, circuitry, and systems.
  • Ability to use computer-based technology with various types of operating systems.
  • Skill and manual dexterity in making repairs, adjustments, and modifications to equipment with a working familiarity of testing and measurement techniques.
  • Knowledge of specialized instrumentation use and application, working familiarity with electrical and electronic testing and measurement techniques.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively, in both verbal and written form.
  • Knowledge of lock out tag out, switching and tagging procedures.
  • Working knowledge of Eversource safety rules and practices.

Education:

    • Electrical Engineering or Technology
    • Computer Science, Computer Science Engineering or Computer Engineering

  • High school diploma or equivalent with prior related experience as described below.

Experience:

  • With associate degree as described above, no prior related experience is required.
  • With high school diploma as described above, five (5) years of related telecommunications system experience, performing engineering, installation, maintenance, or repair in a utility, industry or military field is required.

Licenses & Certifications:

  • Critical Infrastructure Protection certification must be maintained annually.
  • Must maintain a valid motor vehicle operator’s license.

Working Conditions:

description:
About Air Space Intelligence

ASI's mission-critical technology powers decision-making across aviation, defense, energy, and other critical infrastructure domains. Backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Spark Capital, and Renegade Partners, ASI delivers operational decision superiority—compressing days of analysis into seconds of action. What You Will Do:

Your responsibilities will span from conceptualizing and building innovative products from scratch (0 to 1) to enhancing and optimizing existing solutions as they evolve (1 to n). You will operate in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, where you will have the opportunity to shape and set the standards for excellence. You will work with a cross-functional team, including end-users, other engineers, and deployment strategists. You will solve real problems that make a difference, providing decision-making tools to end users and improving the safety of our airspace.


What We Value:

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language. We work in Rust and Python and expect you to have the foundation to quickly learn these languages.

  • Proficient in leveraging modern LLM tools to accelerate development workflows and enhance code quality.

  • Ability to collaborate with others across multiple teams.

  • The grit to get the job done despite unforeseen obstacles.

  • An aptitude to lead and work independently.

  • Flexibility to adjust to changing business priorities.

  • Curiosity and a drive to grow.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.

  • Active security clearance.

  • At senior levels: experience in building and maintaining high-performance, scalable systems.

How We Hire:

We look at the interview process not as a screening or test, but rather as an opportunity to simulate what it would look like working together. We build the interview process around you.

ASI works with export controlled technology and restricted U.S. Government data, including on contracts mandating U.S. immigration status and location restrictions for performing personnel. Employment offers are contingent on ability to timely obtain all required authorizations for contemplated job duties.

In case you’re interested in taking a shortcut through our application process - try a little puzzle on for size. Below you’ll find an array of bytes. Once decoded, it will reveal the hiring manager’s e-mail. Send an e-mail with the subject “Squawk!” and we’ll get in touch right away! Send in your code as well!

[33, 56, 46, 44, 62, 13, 44, 36, 63, 62, 61, 44, 46, 40, 96, 36, 35, 57, 40, 33, 33, 36, 42, 40, 35, 46, 40, 99, 46, 34, 32]

Each character in the hiring manager’s email was translated into the byte array above by first converting each character into its Unicode integer representation, and then XOR’ing each integer with a secret key.
In order to find the key - you’ll have to do some aviation research into squawk codes. Specifically - the key will be the squawk code used to signal a generic emergency, with any leading or trailing 0’s trimmed out. Happy decoding!

description:
Job Description

Serves as the day-to-day bridge between brand teams and the Patient Support CoE for assigned therapeutic areas, owning TA-specific insight generation, patient journey mapping, and implementation support for critical capabilities. Accountable for translating designs and patient-facing capability concepts into operational and scalable solutions — ensuring new capabilities fit into the broader architecture or new capabilities deploy without disrupting live patient support operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Understand and pressure test TA-specific patient support designs, including workflow assumptions, operational feasibility, and implementation sequencing
  • Serve as day-to-day bridge between brand and CoE teams, enabling integration and one-voice execution across assigned TA
  • Support end-to-end patient strategy execution along with the Patient Support Strategy Lead and interaction models across Access, Affordability, and Adherence, supporting agile pod delivery through input gathering, execution follow-through, issue tracking and resolution
  • Support end-to-end implementation process for capabilities, including scoping, sequencing, and operational configuration — translating documentation (design intent, success criteria, technical requirements) into operational specs for hub vendors and internal teams
  • Identify and resolve implementation blockers — including vendor capacity constraints, data integration gaps, CRM configuration issues, and compliance requirements — and escalate to the right stakeholders for resolution
  • Maintain implementation playbooks that codify repeatable deployment processes, reducing time and risk of future capability rollouts
  • Conduct TA-specific insight generation, including patient-specific market research and HCP feedback as needed along with the brand patient strategy team

Points of Collaboration:

  • Patient Experience and Acceleration Lead: Reporting line; aligning TA-level insights and implementation priorities to vertical strategy and CoE roadmap
  • Patient Access, Affordability, and Adherence Operations Leads: Coordinating deployment timing, vendor impact, and capability sequencing across operational verticals
  • Direct-to-Patient Platform Lead: Thinking through integration with DTP and other emerging channel capabilities as relevant
  • BU Patient Support Strategy lead (SP&ID, Oncology, Rare Disease): Receiving graduated capabilities and brand-specific configuration needs; aligning implementation timing to launch milestones
  • DHH (Data, Hub and Hub Technology): Data integration, CRM configuration, and platform changes required by new capability deployments
  • Hub and Technology Vendors: Translating capability requirements into vendor SOW amendments, configuration changes, and testing protocols
  • Legal, Privacy, and Compliance: Identifying and resolving compliance requirements that create implementation blockers

Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) and 5+ years in biopharma patient services, program implementation, or operations, with experience deploying new capabilities across hub, access, affordability, and adherence
  • Prior experience supporting patient support design and execution, including insight generation, pressure-testing, and implementation support across brand and CoE functions
  • Strong understanding of patient support ecosystems, including hub, specialty pharmacy, access, CRM, and patient journey interactions; familiarity with where new capability deployments could create operational disruption
  • Strong understanding of primary care, specialty care and complex therapy archetypes, including patient needs, access barriers, and support-model differences
  • Experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative inputs into actionable recommendations, including patient, HCP, operational, and program insights; ability to translate findings into operational specs that vendors and hub partners can act on
  • Experience working with hub vendors on SOW amendments, configuration changes, and testing protocols; comfort managing a small, execution-focused team measured by what gets deployed, not designed

title: Battery Service Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Engineering Manager

__

The work model for the role is: Onsite, Richmond, VA

Your role and responsibilities

In this role as Battery Service Engineer, you will have the opportunity to oversee the deployment, maintenance strategy, and operational readiness of our UPS battery infrastructure. In this role, you will transition from hands-on execution to program-level ownership— responsible for the entire lifecycle of critical backup power storage—including installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, diagnostic troubleshooting, and replacement of various battery technologies (VRLA, Flooded Lead-Acid, Lithium-Ion), while ensuring absolute compliance with safety and environmental standards.

You will act as the primary interface between field operations, engineering, and client stakeholders to ensure maximum uptime, reliability, and safety for our clients' critical infrastructure, directly managing how energy storage systems interact with, support, and communicate with UPS topology.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive programs for installation, startup, configuration, maintenance, and testing of UPS battery strings; Oversee internal Field Service Engineers and third-party service vendors. Define Scope of Work (SOW) documents, manage Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and audit field service reports to ensure work meets strict technical standards.

  • Serve as the program-level expert on how to utilize advanced diagnostic tools (internal resistance/conductance testers, thermal imagers, and data loggers) to isolate cell failures, thermal runaway risks, and capacity degradation.

  • Oversee the installation, program, and maintenance of Battery Monitoring Systems. Ensure accurate data reporting, alarm thresholds, and communication protocols (Modbus, SNMP) between the BMS and the UPS or building management systems; Analyze capacity test data, internal resistance trends, and runtime calculations to predict end-of-life cycles.

  • Standardize and enforce safety protocols across all programs, ensuring strict alignment with OSHA, NFPA 70E (Arc Flash), and environmental regulations regarding EPA-certified battery disposal, recycling, and spill containment.

  • Serve as the escalation point for major battery failures, thermal runaway events, or UPS integration issues. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) investigations and implement preventative actions.


Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering PLUS minimum 6 years of experience in field service specifically working with industrial UPS systems (3-phase preferred) and large-scale battery plants

  • Strong foundational knowledge of 3-phase UPS systems and the distinct operating characteristics of VRLA, NiCad, and Lithium-Ion battery

  • Expert-level experience with digital multimeters, battery impedance testers (e.g., Alber, Megger, Midtronics), load banks, etc.

  • Experience commissioning or troubleshooting Lithium-Ion Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and their complex internal management systems, a plus

  • Robust understanding of IEEE standards for battery maintenance and testing (IEEE 450, IEEE 1188, IEEE 1679); NFPA 70E Electrical Safety Certification, a plus

  • Proficiency with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), data analytics tools (Excel, Power BI), and project management software.

  • Willingness to travel to domestic customer sites (typically 50%–75% in the beginning and reducing as a team is developed)

  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview
High Availability (HA) is one of the foundational engineering teams in Microsoft 365 Core, owning backend data platform that powers Copilot and storing exabytes of customer sharded data across a globally distributed fleet. We build and own technology that deliver 99.995% availability, enable sub-5-second cross-regional failovers, and safeguard exabytes of customer data. Our team owns database engine (Extensible Storage Engine - ESE), failover cluster, and asynchronous active-passive replication, and all of that is encapsulated in a concept of Database Availability Group (DAG).
Charting a multi-year journey to change that - to disaggregate storage from compute, replace full-replica redundancy with erasure coding, and evolve High Availability from "another hot copy" into an efficient property of a shared storage fabric. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide the technical leadership and hands-on contribution for this transformation: someone who can hold both the incremental, ship-this-year evolution of the current DAG model and the long-horizon disaggregated-fabric architecture in their head at once and drive the fleet from one to the other without ever compromising durability or availability.
This is a rare opportunity to re-architect a foundational storage system at a scale very few engineers ever touch, with a direct, measurable impact on the cost and efficiency of M365.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Responsibilities
  • Own the multi-year technical strategy and architecture for Substrate High Availability and storage disaggregation — spanning the incremental evolution of the current DAG/log-shipping model, a fleet-scale disaggregated erasure-coded storage service, and the longer-term fabric-native direction.
  • Drive concrete, shippable efficiency wins on the existing fleet: reducing full-copy redundancy, introducing erasure coding (e.g., LRC/VLRC) for durability at a fraction of the footprint, and decoupling compute placement from data placement.
  • Lead the design of the storage data path and control plane: append-only extents, page mapping and garbage collection, metadata/placement services, and the erasure-coding and repair pipeline.
  • Reason rigorously about reliability of the engine, efficiency across storage, memory, and CPU simultaneously, netting out what a change saves against what it adds (reconstruct cost, write amplification, network hops), and grounding decisions in measured fleet data.
  • Leverage AI and intelligent automation to transform service operations through predictive analytics, autonomous remediation, and Copilot-powered engineering workflows.
  • Partner with architects and engineering leaders across Storage Fabric, M365 Core, and Azure infrastructure teams to design innovative solutions that improve availability, durability, performance, and operational efficiency for exabyte-scale storage systems.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, or C#
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++ or C#
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 15+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++ or C#
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Direct experience with erasure coding (Reed-Solomon, LRC/local-reconstruction codes) and the durability/repair/reconstruct trade-offs at scale.
  • Experience with storage-compute disaggregation or cloud-database architectures that separate the log/storage tier from compute (e.g., log-as-the-database designs, page-server architectures).
  • Familiarity with the underlying hardware and fabric trends: NVMe, RDMA/RoCE, SMR HDD economics, SSD endurance, DPUs/SmartNICs.
  • Background in capacity, performance modeling, or fleet efficiency for exabyte-scale services.
  • Experience designing or evolving high-availability database and/or distributed storage engines in production.

Jouw uitdaging
Als audicien in de thuisservice bij Beter Horen ben je werkzaam in een bepaalde regio en bezoek je met jouw Beter Horen-auto klanten die niet in staat zijn om naar een van onze winkels te komen. Je komt bij mensen thuis, maar ook in bijvoorbeeld verzorgingstehuizen. Je verleent zorg en service aan ons huidige klantenbestand en houdt je bezig met het uitbreiden hiervan. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met een hooradviseur. Samen met de klant ga je op zoek naar de beste (hoor)oplossing, handel je vakkundig, overtuigend, daadkrachtig en geef je de klant het beste advies. Daarmee maak jij het verschil. Jij bereikt het hoogste niveau van klantadvies bij Beter Horen door zorgvuldig te luisteren en jezelf te blijven uitdagen in een dynamische en snel veranderende omgeving.

“Als mensen hun mobiliteit verliezen en weinig buitenkomen, wordt hun wereld kleiner. De enige dingen waar ze vaak nog van kunnen genieten zijn de mensen om hen heen, muziek en de televisie. Als ze daar geen plezier meer uit kunnen halen, gaat hun levenskwaliteit achteruit en neemt eenzaamheid toe. Tijdens mijn werk als thuisservice audicien, maak ik mensen elke dag blij”

Sylvia Heinz-Geurts – Thuisservice audicien bij Beter Horen


Wie zijn wij?
Amplifon is een Italiaanse multinational en wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van hooroplossingen en diensten voor de detailhandel. We zijn er trots op dat we de standaard voor onze branche neerzetten. Binnen Nederland opereert Amplifon onder het merk Beter Horen met meer dan 200 winkels en servicepunten en 700 toegewijde professionals. Bij Amplifon geloven we dat mensen het belangrijkste onderdeel zijn van ons succes en daarom investeren wij in onze mensen en hun ontwikkeling. We zijn een doelgerichte organisatie met transparantie naar zowel klanten als medewerkers. Dankzij onze toegewijde audiciens, verkoopmedewerkers en de teams op het hoofdkantoor zijn we in staat om dagelijks mensen de kans te geven om alle emoties van geluid te (her)ontdekken.

Met wereldwijd meer dan 20.300 professionals in een netwerk van 9.700 verkooppunten, servicecentra en partners zijn we een grote, maar platte organisatie met korte lijnen. Het hoofdkantoor van Amplifon is gevestigd in Milaan, in Nederland ligt het kantoor in Utrecht.

Wij geloven dat alleen door sterk te investeren in talent ontwikkeling, voortdurende professionele ontwikkeling, ondersteuning en erkenning, onze mensen kunnen groeien en een mooie carrière kunnen opbouwen.


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een baan bij een inspirerend internationaal bedrijf waar je echt een verschil kunt maken in de levens van mensen;
  • Maandsalaris vanaf € 3.100, - plus 8% vakantiegeld en daarnaast een interessante variabele beloningsregeling voor jou op individueel niveau maar ook met je team;

  • 24 vakantiedagen en 1 extra inclusiviteitsdag + de mogelijkheid om tot 13 vrije dagen bij te kopen;
  • Een goede pensioenregeling;
  • Investering in jouw ontwikkeling via trainingen, workshops en seminars via onze eigen Academy. Bij Beter Horen bieden wij o.a. mogelijkheden om je te specialiseren op audiologisch gebied (bijv. kinderspecialisatie), relatiemanagement (regionaal contact onderhouden met KNO-praktijken) of de thuisservice. Ook bieden wij opleidingsprogramma’s met specialisaties tot mentor en kun je doorgroeien tot shopmanager;
  • Wij leveren een belangrijke bijdrage aan het up to date houden van je StAr-registratie;
  • Volledig uitgeruste winkel met de nieuwste audiologische test- en aanpasinstrumenten, gedigitaliseerde processen en geavanceerde technologie, met een voortdurende innovatie-aanpak;
  • Creatieve en inclusieve werkomgeving met betrokken en ondersteunende collega's;
  • Goede onboarding periode om de organisatie te leren kennen;
  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan Bedrijfsfitness en Lease-a-Bike.

  • Alle (secundaire) arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op 1 plek in de Alleo app, zoals o.a. bedrijfsfitness NL en Lease a Bike. Daarnaast kan je de app gebruiken om zelf keuzes te maken die bij jou passen, zoals:

Wie ben jij?

  • Je spreekt duidelijk articulerend Nederlands, zodat onze klanten jou goed kunnen verstaan;

  • Je bent woonachtig in de regio Apeldoorn.

Assesses and strengthens the security of cloud-hosted systems, analyzes cloud threats, and supports protection, detection, monitoring, response, and reporting aligned to DoD needs.

*This position is contingent upon contract award.*

Responsibilities:

  • Review cloud architecture, design, and security policy for DoD compliance
  • Recommend security-posture improvements
  • Analyze and report cloud-based threats and attacks
  • Coordinate with cyber intelligence and incident-response analysts
  • Identify protection and detection gaps with content developers and cybersecurity engineers
  • Maintain awareness of current cloud threats and deliver actionable reports and briefings

Qualifications:

  • Years of Experience: Three (3) years of cybersecurity experience; Three (3) years of cloud IT administration or cybersecurity experience
  • Clearance Requirements: IT-I Critical Sensitive / Tier 5 (T5), required at proposal submission
  • Certification Requirements:
    • Required for assigned cybersecurity/IA duties before starting work; exact baseline and computing-environment certifications are duty-based and not specified in the role description.
  • Any other work-related qualifications needed for the role:
    • Understanding of NIST Cybersecurity Framework and MITRE ATT&CK
    • Understanding of basic network concepts
    • Experience with PaaS, IaaS, and SaaS deployments

Desired/Preferred:

  • Experience securing AWS GovCloud or other regulated cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting DoD Impact Level 5 systems.
  • Experience implementing zero-trust architecture and role-based access control.
  • Experience with CAC authentication, PKI authentication, and encryption at rest.
  • Experience supporting ATO packages and the DoD Risk Management Framework.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Experience using ACAS or comparable vulnerability-scanning tools and remediating findings.
  • Experience developing, managing, or closing Plans of Action and Milestones.
  • Experience with Web Application Firewalls, reverse web proxies, security monitoring, and cloud incident response.
  • Experience evaluating the security of AI/ML models, pipelines, data, and cloud-hosted applications.
  • Experience with threat detection, insider-threat analysis, fraud detection, or cloud threat intelligence.
  • Experience developing security architecture, system security designs, assessment documentation, and compliance guides.
  • Experience supporting audit logging, audit trails, traceability, and cybersecurity evidence collection.
  • Current DoD 8570/8140 baseline and computing-environment certifications appropriate to assigned duties are preferred.

title: SAP ABAP Developer
description:
SAP ABAP Developer – S/4HANA & ECC

Location: Montvale, NJ, US

Employment Type: OTHER

Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer to develop, enhance, and support SAP ECC 6.0 and SAP S/4HANA solutions across core business domains. This role emphasizes modern ABAP development (RAP, CDS, AMDP, OData) and SAP HANA optimization.

This role will play a critical role in our enterprise SAP modernization journey—supporting both ECC and S/4HANA environments while enabling a Clean Core, upgrade-safe future on SAP BTP. The position partners closely with functional, integration, and architecture teams and contributes to technical standards and strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

· Develop, enhance, and support SAP applications across SAP ECC 6.0 (EHP7) and SAP S/4HANA.

· Design and implement scalable, upgrade-safe ABAP solutions using ABAP Objects, RAP, CDS Views and annotations, AMDP, and OData V2/V4 services.

· Build and support solutions on SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA, leveraging SAP Fiori and SAPUI5, with a focus on performance, scalability, and enterprise architecture standards.

· Support ECC to S/4HANA conversions and upgrades, including SPAU/SPDD activities, ATC-driven custom code remediation, and post-conversion stabilization in dual-landscape environments.

· Design, implement, and support SAP integrations using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, SOAP services, and REST APIs.

· Develop and extend side-by-side and cloud-based applications on SAP BTP, using RAP- and CDS-based backend services aligned to SAP Clean Core principles.

· Optimize application performance on SAP HANA using code pushdown techniques, CDS-centric data models, and efficient Open SQL.

· Provide ongoing production support, enhancements, and defect resolution in SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments.

· Define and enforce ABAP quality, testing, and performance standards using tools such as ABAP Unit, ATC/SCI, Code Inspector, SAT, ST05, SQL Monitor (SQLM), and ST12.

· Collaborate with functional, Basis, integration, and architecture teams on design reviews, effort estimates, and end-to-end solution delivery.

· Participate in code reviews, provide mentoring, and contribute to continuous modernization initiatives and technical standards.

Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience in SAP ECC 6.0 and SAP S/4HANA environments.

· Strong experience with ABAP on HANA, including performance tuning and database-centric development.

· Proven experience supporting SAP upgrades, migrations, and ECC to S/4HANA transition projects.

· Strong expertise in ABAP Objects, enhancements framework, BADIs, interfaces, and performance optimization.

· Hands-on experience with modern ABAP development using RAP, CDS, AMDP, and OData services.

· Experience supporting or developing solutions within logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, or finance domains.

Pay Range

USD $127,300.00 - USD $162,900.00 /Yr.

title: Data Engineer - Onboarding North America
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

  • Remote - United States or Canada

  • From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data/ML Engineer to own the data and machine learning foundation that Sardine's compliance decisions run on. Every onboarding decision we make — a payment approved, an account blocked, a KYC case escalated — is the output of a pipeline someone built. This role owns those pipelines end to end: how data arrives, how it becomes a feature, how that feature becomes a model, and how that model stays correct in production.

This is a high-impact, highly technical IC role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and ML engineering. We need someone at the senior level to set technical direction for the next order of magnitude: new feature generation, build specific models around KYC onboarding, in house entity matcher for the sanctions and more

You will write production code, make architectural calls that outlive your tenure, and raise the bar for how a small team ships fraud ML. You will work directly with data scientists, backend engineers, and the fraud analysts who use what you build.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the data ingestion layer that brings device telemetry, transaction events, KYC/identity signals, and third-party enrichment into the platform — designing streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub, Apache Beam on Dataflow, Flink) and batch pipelines (Python, Airflow on Cloud Composer, Spark on Dataproc) that are correct, observable, and cheap to extend.

  • Build and evolve our feature platform, where the same Chronon feature definitions are computed by Flink for streaming and Spark for batch, with aggregation windows from one hour to 300 days, served to the rules engine and to models under a sub-second budget.

  • Establish feature correctness as an engineering discipline: streaming-versus-batch reconciliation, recomputation tests against the warehouse, train/serve parity checks, and drift monitoring that catches a broken feature before an analyst does.

  • Productionize fraud and identity ML models — training pipelines on Vertex AI and Kubeflow, gradient-boosted and tree-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, scikit-learn), hyperparameter search, SHAP-based explanations, and score normalization — and build the automated retraining, champion/challenger promotion, and rollback machinery we don't yet have.

  • Engineer KYC, AML, and identity risk signals: document verification and doc-KYC outcomes, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening results, email and phone risk, synthetic identity indicators, bank and account verification, and periodic customer due diligence — turning noisy, multi-vendor, multi-jurisdiction data into features a model can actually learn from.

  • Integrate and harden new data sources, including 30+ third‑party enrichment providers called in parallel on the request path, plus our cross‑client consortium network — owning failover behavior, timeout budgets, graceful degradation, caching, and cost.

  • Own the warehouse and modeling layer in BigQuery — partitioning strategy, the staging‑to‑mart layer cake, training datasets, and the in‑flight migration off dbt onto scheduled SQL and Python pipelines.

  • Design the entity resolution and graph data that link customers, devices, emails, phones, cards, bank accounts, and crypto addresses across clients, including large‑scale connected‑components work.

  • Make the platform safe by construction: field‑level encryption for sensitive identifiers, regional data residency enforced in the pipeline definitions, PII handling and deletion paths, and feature‑level gating so a bad signal can be turned off without a deploy.

  • Set technical direction and raise the team's ceiling — write the design docs, run the reviews, mentor engineers and data scientists, and decide what we build versus buy.

What you'll need

  • 8+ years building production data and ML systems, with real ownership of both the pipeline side and the model side. You have shipped models that made consequential automated decisions, not just dashboards.

  • Deep Python and strong SQL. You are fluent in a distributed processing framework (Spark, Beam, or Flink) and comfortable reasoning about streaming semantics — windowing, watermarks, late data, exactly‑once versus at‑least‑once, and where correctness actually breaks.

  • Hands‑on experience with a modern cloud data stack: GCP strongly preferred (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, Composer, Vertex AI) or the AWS equivalents, plus Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD.

  • Practical ML engineering depth: feature stores and feature pipelines, training/serving skew, gradient‑boosted tree models, class imbalance and rare‑event modeling, threshold and cost‑sensitive tuning, model monitoring and drift detection, and explainability.

  • Experience with high‑volume, low‑latency serving where a feature fetch has a few hundred milliseconds and there is no retry budget.

  • Domain experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or identity/KYC — or the demonstrated ability to get fluent in a regulated domain fast. You understand why label latency, feedback loops, and adversarial drift make fraud modeling different from ordinary supervised learning.

  • Comfort with data governance in a regulated environment: PII, encryption, access control, regional data residency, auditability.

  • Strong written communication. You can explain a modeling tradeoff to a fraud analyst and a pipeline design to a backend engineer, and you write things down.

  • A bias toward action and comfort in ambiguity. Much of this role is deciding what should exist, then building it.

Bonus points for

  • Experience supporting customer‑facing ML — bring‑your‑own‑model integrations, model explainability for adverse action or regulatory review, or shadow/challenger scoring frameworks.

  • Experience in high‑growth B2B SaaS, or an early data/ML hire who built the function rather than inherited it.

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre‑vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote‑first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year‑end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One‑time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet‑up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

We are a proud member of the Southeastern Conference, with more than 650 Texas A&M student-athletes competing at the NCAA Division 1-A level in 20 varsity sports.

The successful candidate would also have athletic training department administrative responsibilities based on interest, skillset/experience, and departmental need. Salary: Commensurate based on selected candidates experience.

Cover Letter/Resume: A cover letter and resume are strongly recommended and will help in our review. You may upload them on the application under the CV/Resume section.

Other: Travel required with assigned sport. Ability to work flexible hours (nights, weekend and holidays) as required to complete assigned duties.

  • One-year full-time experience or three years part-time, paid, or voluntary experience as a student trainer.


Required Licenses and Certifications:

  • Ability to sit for State of Texas License to practice Athletic Training.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Medical & First Aid skills.

  • Joint taping and Physical Therapy skills.

  • Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPR Certification.

  • Automatic External Defibrillator Certification.

Responsibilities

TREATMENT/REHAB

  • Tapes, places braces, and prepares student athletes for practice and games (events) of assigned sports.

ATHLETE CARE

  • Attends and supervises, for safety preventive and emergency care, student athletes at practices and games (events) of assigned sports.

  • Travels, as directed and required, with assigned teams.

ATHLETE CARE

  • Assists in the maintenance and supervision of athletic training room, equipment, and supply inventory.

COMPLIANCE

  • Maintains continual and thorough familiarity with all applicable NCAA, Southeastern Conference, and Texas A&M University rules and regulations.

  • This position works to establish and ensure communication and enforcement of rules and regulations for all staff members and student workers supervised.

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration. Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you. Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.

  • Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums

  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays

  • Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month

title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
location: Mexico, Nuevo León, San Pedro Garza Garcia
description:
The Role

At Clarios, we are operating leaner and faster than ever — arming the business with connected intelligence, automation, and AI. As an Associate Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you start your journey at the front line of that work: you embed with supply chain teams and help build the analytics tools, dashboards, and purpose-built command centers — on decision intelligence platforms like Palantir — that turn data into faster, better decisions.

FDEs are hybrid business and technology builders. Rather than handing work between teams, we stay connected to the problem from concept through adoption and measurable value. An FDE blends the Analyst (insights), Data Engineer (pipelines), Data Scientist (models), Business SME (process), and Software Engineer (applications) — and stays embedded with the business, accountable not for a report but for the business outcome.

At the Associate level, you own well-scoped tasks and components — building, iterating, and validating your work under the guidance of experienced FDEs — while rapidly growing the technical skills and domain knowledge that let you take on full solutions. This is the entry-level on-ramp into the Forward Deployed Engineering team driving Clarios’ digital transformation and supply chain excellence.

What You’ll Own (Impact Areas)

  • Build decision-support tools: build and enhance components of dashboards, Ontology-based workflows, and decision-support tools within Palantir Foundry — under the guidance of experienced FDEs — to help solve real business problems.
  • Configure the Ontology: configure Ontology-backed objects, actions, and metrics on well-scoped tasks, learning how business users interact with data through intuitive applications rather than raw reports.
  • Prototype & gather feedback: help build wireframes and prototypes for specific features, and help gather user feedback to refine solutions before they scale.
  • Support data requirements & pipelines: help gather and document data requirements from diverse sources (Azure, data lakes, SQL Server, Excel), supporting Senior FDEs and Global Analytics as they implement ETL changes.
  • Build domain knowledge: learn Clarios supply chain business functions and build the domain knowledge that makes analytics work matter — and that helps you iterate more quickly over time.
  • Build with AI & strong fundamentals: use AI-powered development tools to build and iterate quickly while developing strong engineering fundamentals, pairing with Senior FDEs and FDE Leads and following established patterns and standards to build reliable, reusable components.
  • Document & incorporate feedback: write and maintain clear documentation for the business logic, Ontology definitions, KPIs, and assumptions behind your work, and take direction from the product manager, Senior FDEs, and end users to improve usability and adoption.
  • Support adoption: support the team in adoption activities — testing solutions, collecting user feedback, and helping track whether tools are used and valued.

Level & Scope

  • Core scope: Task / Component — build and validate well-scoped tasks and components under guidance.
  • Span of influence: Self and immediate task within the pod.
  • Formal span of control: None (individual contributor).
  • Promotion signal: Can reliably deliver defined tasks and is ready to own a scoped solution end to end (→ L1).

What Success Looks Like

  • Learn quickly and turn feedback into better solutions with every iteration.
  • Deliver well-scoped tasks reliably, building the fundamentals that lead to owning full solutions.
  • Build strong working relationships across your pod and with the business users you support.
  • Participate in a high-performing team culture focused on learning, collaboration, and results.

Core Competencies

  • Foundational data manipulation and analysis (SQL, Python, or Excel).
  • Curiosity for decision intelligence platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry) and Generative AI tools.
  • Building dashboards, Ontology-based workflows, and decision-support applications.
  • Clear documentation of business logic, KPIs, and assumptions.
  • Collaboration in cross-functional pods — taking direction and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving and eagerness to grow both technical and business domain knowledge.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

Must-have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field — recent and upcoming graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Internship / co-op experience, or academic or personal projects in data, analytics, or software equivalent to an internship / co-op.
  • Foundational skills in data manipulation and analysis (e.g., SQL, Python, or Excel), and curiosity about decision intelligence platforms such as Palantir and Generative AI tools.
  • Willingness to learn, take direction, and collaborate in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an eagerness to grow both technical and business domain knowledge.

Nice-to-have

  • Internship, co-op, or project experience in analytics, data engineering, or software development.
  • Familiarity with decision intelligence tools (e.g., Palantir, Aera) or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) or databases (SQL Server, Snowflake).
  • Advanced coursework or a graduate degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Computer Science.
  • Familiarity with agile ways of working (user stories, sprints).
  • Coursework or projects using Python or R for data analysis and automation.
  • Exposure to automotive or manufacturing environments.

Tech Stack We Use

  • Decision Intelligence Platforms (Palantir) and Atlan for data cataloging.
  • Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyMC).
  • SQL (Snowflake, SQL Server, Azure).
  • TypeScript and React (Palantir).

Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. With around 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, we bring deep expertise to our Aftermarket and OEM partners, and reliability, safety and comfort to everyday lives. description:

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

Travel to Office Expectations

If this role is remote, there will be in‑office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but are not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi‑annual and annual team meetings.

If this role is hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but are not limited to, weekly/bi‑weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

For Remote Roles

If this role is remote, there will be in‑office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but are not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi‑annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles

If this role is hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but are not limited to, weekly/bi‑weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

At PointClickCare, we are building the data foundation that powers the next generation of AI and machine learning products in healthcare. We are seeking a Senior Applied Research Data Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, applied research, and domain discovery.

This is not a traditional data engineering role focused solely on pipelines and infrastructure. You will work closely with AI researchers, data scientists, clinicians, and product experts to transform complex healthcare data into trusted, reusable, AI‑ready research assets. Success in this role requires curiosity, investigative thinking, and the ability to uncover meaning in complex, poorly documented systems.

You will be responsible for learning new domains quickly by reading source code, reverse‑engineering SQL and business logic, interviewing subject matter experts, and building durable semantic data products that support experimentation, model development, evaluation, and production AI systems.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving data mysteries, creating order from ambiguity, and building datasets that researchers trust. You understand that the quality, semantics, lineage, and documentation of a dataset are often more important than the model itself.

In This Role, You Will

  • Build and own reusable gold‑layer data products that power AI, machine learning, and generative AI research.
  • Transform structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured healthcare data into trusted, model‑ready datasets.
  • Investigate and document complex business logic by analyzing source systems, stored procedures, application code, and stakeholder workflows.
  • Partner directly with researchers to design datasets for experimentation, evaluation, and model training.
  • Create semantic data definitions, lineage documentation, provenance records, and data quality frameworks that enable reproducible research.
  • Develop point‑in‑time‑correct datasets, feature sets, and evaluation corpora for classical ML and generative AI workloads.
  • Support advanced AI data preparation techniques including programmatic labeling, weak supervision, synthetic data generation, and research dataset curation.
  • Serve as a bridge between domain experts, researchers, and engineering teams, turning tacit knowledge into durable data assets.

What Makes Someone Successful In This Role

  • You enjoy learning new domains and solving ambiguous data problems.
  • You are comfortable working with incomplete documentation and legacy systems.
  • You naturally ask "What does this data really mean?" before asking "How do I process it?"
  • You can translate conversations with clinicians, product experts, and researchers into robust data products.
  • You create documentation, data definitions, and semantic models that other teams depend on.
  • You care deeply about data quality, reproducibility, provenance, and research integrity.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Wellness Support Programs and Resources
  • Parental & Caregiver Leaves
  • Fertility & Adoption Support
  • Continuous Development Support Program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Allyship and Inclusion Communities
  • Employee Recognition … and more!

title: Risk Mitigation Specialist
description:
Amentum is seeking highly motivated, self-starting Risk Mitigation Specialist/Officer. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Ability to maintain a Top Secret-SCI clearance.

Responsibilities:

Prepare, implement, and oversee routine to moderately complex RMSs addressing risk indicators, ensuring each meet prescribed quality standards and contain the appropriate focus, depth, and breadth of information based on the individual task circumstances RMSs should clearly convey the treatment(s) chosen for each risk indicator, a rationale for each treatment, and any residual risk remaining requiring action by an outside party. Ensure RMSs adhere to applicable internal style guides prior to internal and external dissemination. Actively manage and oversee a portfolio of companies operating under mitigation. Provide technical direction and feedback to Government and Contractor staff, other internal parties, and external parties related to business and security risks, specific mitigation measures available, unmitigated residual risks, and related processes and procedures. Provide coaching, training, and mentoring to less experienced RMOs.

Conduct peer reviews of RMSs drafted by less experienced RMOs as directed. Identify areas for improvement, determine the appropriate course of action addressing the areas for leadership’s consideration, and implement solutions areas for improvement may include workflow enhancements, product format revisions, additional training needs, and updates to internal guidance. Conduct workload management tasks by providing reasonable and appropriate suspense dates based on documented case prioritization related to timing, monitoring completion status, ensuring suspense dates are met, and realigning work, as needed, and if required. Manage competing priorities in those circumstances where current staff is not available to meet customer requirements. Actively monitor individual metrics against established key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare the timely dissemination of individual and team performance metrics to supervisors on a recurring basis as requested. Respond to requests for information from internal and external Government customers. Participate in and brief at conferences and meetings with internal and external customers on matters related to the risk management mission

  • Contractor must review and process NISP, DESP, or Section 847 risk management actions in accordance with established DoD instructions and DCSA guidance.

  • Must be responsible for conducting activities to support analysis actions under Government oversight.

  • Must produce written products within time intervals based on the specific mission.

  • Conduct maintenance of existing implemented strategies (i.e., supplements, Outside Directors/Proxy Holders).

  • Must complete implementation of risk management actions with industry and Government stakeholders.

  • Conduct workload management tasks and written products by providing reasonable and appropriate suspense dates based on established key performance indicators, documented case prioritization related to timing, monitoring completion status, ensuring suspense dates are met, quality requirements, and realigning work.

  • Must conduct reviews of DCSA all-source products, as well as review open-source research, company submitted materials, and Government databases, aimed at U.S. and foreign companies and affiliated parties (key management personnel, suppliers, partners, creditors, owners, investors, and other U.S. and foreign affiliations) while producing a Risk Management Strategy (RMS) and Source Packages (SPs).

    • Some locations may require local travel local travel within the U.S.

    • Working with teams and independently required.

Requirements:

  • Active TS-SCI Clearance required

  • Desired Experience: At least 8 years of experience conducting analysis relevant to the specific labor category with at least a portion of the experience within the last 2 years.

  • Desired Education: Bachelor’s degree in an area related to the labor category from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.

  • Minimum 8 years’ experience in

    • Risk treatment or risk management in the areas of law, finance, business, operations, insurance, security, manufacturing, audits, or compliance.

    • Or education in risk management systems or guidelines, such as International Organization of Standardization 31000, Committee of Sponsoring Organizations, or other Enterprise Risk Management models.

    • Applying data analysis, trend analysis and problem-solving techniques. Contractor must be knowledgeable of data manipulation within databases and Microsoft software packages.

title: Sr Embedded DSP Engineer - High Performance Signal Processing
description:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2022, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

The Sr Embedded DSP Engineer - High Performance Signal Processing will play a key role in developing advanced RF sensing capabilities for Mach’s autonomous defense platforms. Working on the DART team, you will focus directly on next-generation counter-UAV radar systems and RF seekers.

You will design radar signal-processing algorithms and implement them as high-performance, low-latency embedded software on high performance processors. You will own capabilities across the full development lifecycle - from mathematical modeling and algorithm prototyping and implementation on high performance processing cores, performance optimization, hardware integration, and system-level validation.

This role involves close collaboration with RF, FPGA, hardware, GNC engineers to ensure the successful development of high-performance, low-latency radar systems that meet mission-critical requirements. Success in this role requires strong technical execution, adaptability and expertise in signal processing theory, low level C and hands-on experience optimizing real-time processing pipelines in a fast-paced, iterative, start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mission: Build next generation counter-UAV defense systems that will be used to defend human lives, critical infrastructure, and high value assets for the United States and its allies.

  • Radar signal processing: Develop high performance radar and RF sensing signal processing software, including FFT processing, beamforming and detection on high performance embedded systems, to detect and track targets with high accuracy/resolution while meeting strict latency, memory and power constraints and update rate requirements.

  • Modeling & simulation: Develop radar models and simulation tools to prototype candidate algorithms and simulate the performance of the radar system and generate test vectors to validate the accuracy of the radar system.

  • Firmware development: Write highly efficient, well-tested production code in C/C++ across platforms ranging from lower power MCUs to high-performance multi-core processors.

  • Algorithm and software validation: Develop unit, functional and lab tests to validate the numerical accuracy, real-time performance of the individual software modules and end-to-end signal processing chain.

  • Hardware co-design: Work with hardware engineers on component selection and optimal hardware-software trade-offs (performance, power, form factor and cost).

  • RF calibration & seeker optimization: Develop automated calibration methods and software for measuring, storing, and applying RF signal-chain corrections. Use calibration and signal processing to maximize end-to-end sensor performance.

  • Testing and reliability: Own embedded software quality and reliability and signal processing chain performance by proactively identifying, documenting/tracking and fixing issues to maintain the high performance of Mach’s radar systems.

  • Project planning: Contribute to project planning, including communicating risks/blockers and manage engineering trade-offs.

  • Documentation: Author clear software specifications, software architecture designs and testing procedures to support manufacturing and scalability.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience developing production signal processing software for radar, RF sensing, EW signal processing, wireless or similarly demanding real-time systems.

  • Signal processing fundamentals: Strong knowledge of digital signal processing, statistical signal processing, estimation, detection theory, or related discipline.

  • Algorithm development: Ability to identify and translate mathematical models into implementable algorithms that meet system requirements and performance.

  • Modeling and analysis: Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for algorithm development, simulation, recorded-data analysis, visualization, and test-vector generation.

  • Languages: Proficiency in low level C/C++ for embedded systems with the ability to write clean, well-tested, and efficient code.

  • Environments: Proven experience developing for one or more embedded processing architectures, such as microcontrollers, DSPs, SIMD/vector processors, or heterogeneous multicore SoCs.

  • Real-time optimization: Ability to profile and optimize the performance of signal processing algorithms to meet real-time software constraints and achieve optimal radar system performance.

  • Hardware: Ability to read schematics and bring-up new boards and processors, including bring-up peripherals/drivers and embedded code from scratch.

  • Communication protocols: Experience using standard device-to-device protocols (SPI, I2C) and GPIO to control/calibrate RF signal chains and interface with customer platforms.

  • Testing: Ability to debug, test and validate embedded software using functional tests, logic/protocol analyzers and lab tests to ensure the functionality of embedded software.

  • Execution: Strong grasp of full software development life cycle and ability to execute and thrive in a fast-paced, high-iteration environment, delivering frequent software updates with speed and precision.

  • Location: Ability to work 100% on-site at our headquarters in Huntington Beach, CA.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Radar systems: Experience developing signal processing pipelines for pulse-Doppler radar, phased-array radar, active electronically scanned array systems, radar seekers, counter-UAV sensors, or other RF sensing products.

  • Advanced processing: Experience with SIMD/vector programming, multicore processing, hardware accelerators, DMA-based data movement, cache optimization, or heterogeneous processing architectures.

  • Embedded platforms: Experience with real-time operating systems, bare-metal development, device drivers, board bring-up, and interfaces such as SPI, I2C, GPIO, Ethernet, or CSI-2.

  • Automation/scripting: Proficiency in Python or other high level language for data collection, analysis and presentation of system performance.

  • Test equipment: Experience using lab test equipment to test the performance of radar and RF sensing systems.

  • Compliance: Knowledge of military, aerospace, or safety-critical software standards (e.g., DO-178C, MISRA C, ASIL).

Disclosures

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
