title: Experienced P&C Field Services Technician
description:
WSP is currently initiating a search for a POWER Testing and Energization (PTE) Experienced P&C Field Services Technician for our project locations in the states of Texas and Louisiana. Successful applicants will be involved in projects with our PTE Team and be a part of a growing organization that is solving problems and supporting client needs in electrical testing and commissioning in utility substations, industrial, and bulk electrical power systems.

This Opportunity

  • Supports a wide range of testing and commissioning activities through application of client testing standards, industry standards (IEEE, NETA, NFPA, NESC), and manufacturer recommendations
  • Works under limited supervision, independently executing moderately complex assignments, and contributing to regulatory compliance, safety adherence, and data integrity across active job sites
  • Provides day-to-day support to field teams, helps resolve challenges on-site, and mentors junior technicians to promote quality, efficiency, and safe work practices
  • As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery, power generation, and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition—and we need your help.

Your Impact

  • Perform assigned testing and commissioning tasks for Protection and Control systems on high voltage substations
  • Perform on-site hands-on protective relay testing using relay test sets such as Omicron CMC 256/356 or Doble F6150. Examples of relays to be tested are SEL-311L, SEL-387, SEL-487, SEL-421, SEL-351S, GE L90, GE D60 among others
  • Use field forms, digital data tools, and mobile applications to document site activities
  • Perform equipment cleaning, inventory control, and calibration as directed
  • Support the Project Lead or Field Supervisor on projects
  • Escalate complex technical problems or unexpected field conditions to the site lead or project manager
  • Participate in daily safety briefings and ensure compliance with health and safety protocols
    Communicate progress, field observations, and potential delays to the project team
  • May review the work of less experienced technicians for quality and accuracy, providing informal guidance as needed
  • Maintain attention to detail when filling out logs, photo documentation, and label entries
    Collaborate with other technicians to maintain workflow, safety, and quality standards
  • Assist in monitoring subcontractor performance and activities and report observations to field leadership
  • Perform clerical responsibilities such as timecards, expense reports, and project reports
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in the electrical testing industry, including experience in medium and high voltage circuit breakers, power transformers, instrument transformers, and substation protection and controls testing
  • Demonstrable expertise on transmission, generation, and distribution relays (SEL, Basler, Beckwith, and GE families) and protective schemes
  • Technical skills related to protective relays include relay calibration utilizing test sets/measuring devices such as Omicron CMC 256/356 and Doble F6150, control scheme testing, testing of the sensing CT/PT circuits, ability to upload settings to microprocessor relays, and static & dynamic testing of microprocessor-based protective relays
  • Proven experience with electrical field testing standards, practices, and procedures, such as NETA, IEEE, and NFPA applicable standards
  • Demonstrable knowledge of testing electrical distribution, generation, and transmission projects with voltage levels ranging from 15 kV to 500 kV, including protective relays and circuit breakers
  • Experience using technical software such as ProTesT, Protection Suite, ENOSERV RTS, Omicron Test Universe, and AcSELerator Quickset for testing purposes and data review
  • Experience with reading and understanding electrical drawings
  • Ability to identify routine field challenges and equipment issues, responding within established procedures and escalating atypical conditions
  • Skilled in preparing field logs, sketches, and digital reports
  • Physical stamina to work in outdoor and physically demanding conditions
  • Experience collaborating with contractors, technicians, and engineers
  • Demonstrated commitment to field safety, quality, and regulatory compliance
  • Good interpersonal and verbal communication skills for field team collaboration
  • Capable of critical thinking and problem-solving skills to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from inspection and testing results
  • Capability to support a wide variety of tasks in dynamic or changing environments
  • Ability to follow procedures, meet deadlines, and maintain accountability in the field
  • Commitment to continued learning and development in technical field services
  • Understanding of confidentiality and ethical behavior in technical environments
  • Competent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment
  • Reliable, punctual, with the ability to work independently or with a team
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies
  • Willingness and physical ability to lift up to 35 pounds individually, and up to 100 pounds with assistance
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, basic color differentiation, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must be willing to travel (up to 80%)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Technology degree in a similar discipline
  • Experience in testing and troubleshooting electromechanical relays
  • Experience in testing and commissioning electrical equipment on high voltage substations such as CTs, CCVTs, PLC systems, and DC systems, including batteries and battery chargers
  • Current OSHA 30-hour or 40-hour HAZWOPER certification

That might be extra professional development, extra annual leave, time to work on your side hustle, or something else completely different! One size does not fit all.

This includes access to the Mantel AI Gateway, our secure, centralised platform with multiple AI models, plus a dedicated monthly budget and a safe environment to experiment and innovate.

title: Fulfillment Technician
description:
BELEAF MEDICAL | Swade Dispensaries • Sinse Cannabis
Order Fulfillment Technician
Wholesale Order Fulfillment & Supply Chain • St. Louis Metro, MO • $16.50–$18.00/hr • Full Benefits, 100% Company-Paid Premiums

Build your career in the engine room of Missouri cannabis. As an Order Fulfillment Technician on our facilities team, you’re the person who gets Swade and Sinse products out the door and into the market — packaging, staging, and shipping wholesale orders that stock dispensary shelves across the state. This is hands-on warehouse and supply-chain work with a fast-growing, vertically integrated operator, and a real path to grow in one of the country’s most exciting industries. No cannabis experience required; if you’re accurate, dependable, and take pride in getting the details right, we’ll teach you the rest.

You’ll work alongside our Logistics team to receive, process, and deliver orders on schedule — and every full-time team member gets health, dental, and vision insurance with individual premiums covered 100% by the company, a 401(k) match, paid time off, and a generous employee discount. It’s a career, not just a job.

Why You’ll Love Working Here
  • Competitive pay: $16.50–$18.00/hour (non-exempt), commensurate with experience.
  • 100% company-paid premiums for individual health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match to help you invest in your future.
  • 12 days of paid time off, plus paid holidays including 3 personal days.
  • Generous employee discount on the products you help bring to market.
  • Grow with us: hands-on experience in cannabis logistics, inventory, and supply chain with clear paths to advance as we scale across Missouri.

About the Role
The Order Fulfillment Technician keeps our wholesale order pipeline running on time and error-free. Based out of our facilities — not the dispensary — you’ll maintain the schedule and up-to-date requirements for wholesale orders, then receive, process, package, and deliver those orders for both internal and external shipment. You’ll manage finished-goods inventory from processing and storage through fulfillment, partner with the Logistics team on routing, and become an expert in our inventory tracking system. It’s detail-driven work in an office, manufacturing, and warehouse environment where accuracy keeps our partners stocked and our operation compliant.

What You’ll Do
Order Fulfillment & Shipping
  • Evaluate, package, and stage all orders, ensuring the accuracy of every form and manifest.
  • Determine all product requirements and prepare the required paperwork.
  • Collaborate with the Logistics team on delivery routing and scheduling.
Inventory & Reporting
  • Manage the finished-goods inventory supply chain — from processing and storage through order fulfillment.
  • Generate and communicate accurate inventory reports and status updates to internal team members and wholesale partners on request.
  • Learn and master the order-fulfillment and inventory-management functions of the company inventory tracking system.
Workplace & Team
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Work efficiently and continually strive to increase productivity.
  • Maintain a culture of professionalism.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For
  • Fluency with inventory tracking or fulfillment computer software.
  • Detail-oriented, with consistently accurate counts and data entry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a State Agent ID.

Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to sit or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Able to move about a typical office, manufacturing, and warehouse environment.
  • Able to lift and move up to 50 pounds daily.

Compensation & Benefits
  • $16.50–$18.00 per hour, non-exempt, commensurate with experience.
  • Health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance — individual employee premiums covered 100% by the company.
  • 401(k) with company matching.
  • 12 days of paid time off.
  • Paid holidays, including 3 personal days.
  • Generous employee discount.

Who We Are
BeLeaf Medical is one of Missouri’s leading vertically integrated cannabis companies, home to Swade Dispensaries and Sinse Cannabis. With years of experience, we grow, package, and deliver the best cannabis flower and manufactured/infused products to market in Missouri — meeting the high standards of discerning customers who appreciate cannabis in all its forms.

Ready to Apply?
Submit your application through our online portal today. Cannabis warehouse and logistics jobs in the St. Louis area fill fast, so don’t wait.
BeLeaf Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Virtual Observer - Nights
description:

Job Summary

Provides continuous observation and surveillance of assigned patients, under the direction and supervision of a Registered nurse, utilizing TeleSitter software system, including verbally redirecting the patient from engaging in at-risk behaviors and summoning the nursing staff if the patient requires assistance.

**Virtual Observer, Full-Time Nights
**Shift: 6:45 pm - 7:00 am
**BLS preferred
**This position is located at The Woodlands Hospital.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED, preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Certified in Basic Life Support or Heartsaver CPR with AED within 90 days of employment

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Six (6) months patient care experience, preferably in an acute care setting; or
  • No experience if Certified as a Nursing Assistant by the Texas Department of Health; or
  • No experience if completed one (1) semester of clinical rotation in a professional nursing program (Associates of Nursing or Bachelors of Nursing)
  • Ability to understand verbal and written instruction and communicate clearly and effectively with hospital staff and respond quickly to patient behavioral changes
  • Ability to perform duties requiring prolonged and/or extensive sitting, standing, and walking
  • Ability to use discretion and courtesy when working with patients, visitors, and staff
  • Efficiency in multi-tasking and ability to prioritize simultaneous situations
  • Proficient computer skills with ability to navigate a windows-based environment

  • Provides patient with explanations as necessary either in person or through monitoring system voice output, but does not counsel or provide opinions; maintains knowledgeable and is supportive of patient and institutional confidentiality and related hospital policies.
  • Seeks help or advice if patient appears to pose a threat to themselves or others by utilizing clinical knowledge and skills.
  • Operates TeleSitter software, properly navigating the system and understanding the functions and use of the monitoring device.
  • Participates in a collaborative identification and reporting of patient safety issues, and ensures safe patient environment; seeks assistance with removal of any potential safety hazard from room and reports findings to Charge Nurse Participates in hand-off of pertinent information/behavior about assigned patients when arriving on unit and upon completion of shift assignment.
  • Demonstrates safe work practices and attitudes; follows safety rules; works to prevent unsafe conditions and behaviors; and participates in organizational and department safety programs.
  • Considers the diverse needs of each patient, providing and ensuring the highest level of service according to established service standards, optimizing the patient experience.
  • Performs other duties as assigned within scope of responsibility and clinical competency.
  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.
  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.
  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Active Directory Platform Engineer
description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

Zelis is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Active Directory Platform Engineer to lead in designing, implementing, and optimizing robust Active Directory solutions. The role involves managing user accounts, security policies, and access controls for stability and scalability. As a crucial contributor to our directory service strategy, you will drive standardization, implement security measures, and proactively optimize performance. Beyond day-to-day responsibilities, you will lead strategic initiatives, including addressing patching deficiencies, consolidating domains, establishing business continuity plans, and crafting a roadmap for future enhancements. Additionally, this role encompasses responsibilities for Entra ID solutions, ensuring their seamless integration within the Active Directory environment.

About Active Directory at Zelis:

Active Directory is a central identity management platform crucial for our services, providing identity management for internal and SaaS applications, and configuration services for Windows Servers, Windows Desktops, and Linux Servers. Proper support is vital for maintaining operational integrity, meeting compliance requirements, and upholding IT security controls.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the management of user accounts, security policies, and access controls for stability and scalability.
  • Drive standardization and consolidation of Active Directory use, configuring Identity and Access Management, Policies, and usage.
  • Implement robust security protocols, conduct audits, and ensure compliance to protect against cyber threats.
  • Independently resolve issues promptly, proactively addressing IT-related problems.
  • Lead in optimizing Active Directory to meet growing demands while maintaining excellent response times.
  • Develop and implement disaster recovery plans, ensuring business continuity in case of system failure or data loss.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement and enhance Entra ID solutions within the Active Directory environment.
  • Configure and manage Entra ID settings, ensuring optimal performance and alignment with security protocols.
  • Implement and maintain identity management practices specific to Entra ID, addressing user accounts, access controls, and security policies.
  • Lead efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to Entra ID, contributing to the overall stability of our identity management ecosystem.
  • Stay informed about Entra ID best practices and emerging technologies, incorporating relevant advancements into our identity management strategy.
  • Accumulate specialized knowledge and share it across the IT department.
  • Efficiently handle AD-related tasks for consistency and eliminate redundancies.
  • Develop strategies to scale Active Directory seamlessly as the organization grows.
  • Facilitate the transition from Active Directory to Entra ID (Azure AD).

· Proven experience upgrading and decommissioning Active Directory Domain Controllers in enterprise environments.

· Hands-on experience upgrading Active Directory forest and domain functional levels, including planning, risk mitigation, and validation.

· Demonstrated experience with Active Directory domain migrations, including consolidating legacy domains into a primary parent domain.

· Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Enterprise Applications and App Registrations.

· Proven ability to configure and manage Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations across SaaS and internal applications.

· Extensive experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Conditional Access policies to enforce security and compliance requirements.

Requirements:

  • 7–12 years of experience with infrastructure technologies.
  • Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Active Directory architecture and design.
  • Deep knowledge of Active Directory, security, compliance, and governance.
  • Demonstrated experience with Entra ID (Azure AD) solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

If you're ready to contribute to the future of Active Directory Platform Engineering, including Entra ID solutions, at Zelis, apply today. We offer a dynamic work environment, opportunities for growth, and the chance to make a significant impact in the realm of directory services and identity management. Join us in building robust and secure Active Directory and Entra ID platforms.


Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.


While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

JOB SUMMARY

The Specialist supports the Business Tax Services Division by performing various routine audits, reviews, or investigations. This may include independent responsibility for conducting audits of various functions or activities or serving as a member of an audit team in completing more complex audits or special investigations.

The Specialist is involved in conducting professional operational reviews, audits, or special investigations to determine compliance with laws and regulations, generally accepted accounting procedures, financial accountability standards or other requirements. This includes scheduling, planning, and conducting required audits, reviewing required accounting records or other business documents, evaluating financial controls, identifying deficiencies, advising on compliance with established requirements or standards, and preparing audit reports and supporting documents.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The functions performed by employees in this job family will vary by level, but may include the following:

  • Assist taxpayers with proper formatting and submission of their monthly production return.
  • Review monthly production reports to validate variable exemptions, price changes, and prior period adjustments made by the taxpayer.

  • Assist taxpayers with understanding penalties and interest associated with their filings.
  • Prepares memos and taxpayer correspondence in a manner sufficient to convey procedures, laws, and regulations.
  • Assists taxpayers, legal representatives, internal and external personnel in a professional manner by email, telephone, and in person
  • Completes assigned work items in order to meet section production and accuracy standards.
  • Resolves complex and non-complex business tax issues.
  • Uses proper resources to find solutions and responds in a timely manner.
  • Reviews financial records and other business records; identifies deficiencies; provides advice on requirements for compliance with existing laws, policies, and standards.
  • Prepares audit reports; makes recommendations concerning changes in policies or operating procedures.
  • Performs special investigations as assigned.
  • Additional duties as assigned

Knowledge of

· Generally accepted accounting principles and practices

· Auditing theories and techniques

· Financial statements, ledgers, journals, and reports

· Analytical principles

· Modern office methods and procedures, including computer technology related to accounting systems.

Skills in

· Attention to detail

· Interpersonal skills

· Written and verbal communication

· Active listening

· Exceptional attention to detail

Ability to

· Review and analyze accounting records and business practices

· Prepare audit reports and recommendations

· Establish and maintain effective working relationships with others

· Communicate effectively

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of

· A bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business or public administration, or closely related field

· Each year of relevant experience may be substituted for each year of required education.

Preference may be given to candidates who have completed a CPA certification or have a background in business taxes.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time. Exhibit manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination to operate a computer, keyboard, photocopier, telephone, calculator, and other office equipment. Ability to see and read a computer screen and printed material with or without vision aids. Ability to hear and understand speech at normal levels, with or without aids. Ability to communicate clearly. Physical ability to lift up to 15 pounds, to bend, stoop, climb stairs, walk and reach. Duties are normally performed in an office environment with a moderate noise level.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

Travel is not required.

Oklahoma Tax Commission’s normal work hours are Monday through Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm. This schedule may require minor flexibility based on the needs of the agency.

Telework may be required based on the needs of the agency, division, and section. If applicable, applicant must be willing and able to work BOTH on-site and telework at an off-site location, generally in the applicant’s home. Applicant must have a secure internet connection and a dedicated telephone (landline) or smart phone device during scheduled working hours.

This position has access to Federal Tax Information (FTI) and is required to uphold the strictest standards of confidentiality as an essential part of its job responsibilities. This includes safeguarding all tax information obtained from records, files, tax returns, and departmental investigations, whether in paper, electronic, or verbal form.

title: Sr. Software System Architect Lead
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Defense Systems Group (DSG) provides analysis-based decision support to senior leaders on space architectures, policy and strategy, technology development, warfighter capability enablers, systems integration, defense industrial base, and threat reduction to help shape existing and future space missions across the national security space (NSS) enterprise. DSG is unique at Aerospace as it not only directly supports major customers, including the U.S. Space Force, U.S. Space Command, Air Force Material Command, and senior leadership at the Pentagon, but also provides a broad range of technical support across the national space enterprise, maintaining vertical responsibilities with customers’ portfolios as well as horizontal, matrixed responsibilities across the corporation. Additionally, DSG provides deep technical expertise to the Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) in the conception, design, acquisition, launch and operations of satellite, launch vehicle, ground control, and range systems.

The Aerospace Space Domain Superiority Directorate, in the Special Programs Division, supports a broad array of Combat Power missions covering the entire threat response chain from the Space Domain Awareness function through the multidomain effects needed for space superiority. These programs include major system acquisitions for multiple ground and space segments, future architecture definition at the data/software/hardware levels, and research and technology for continuous evolution of space warfighting capabilities.

We are looking for a Sr. Software System Architect Lead to contribute to a team that is developing and delivering a critical space control capability to guarantee space superiority for our nation. This work is focused on supporting all aspects of implementing programs within the tightly integrated program office consisting of military, Aerospace, and SETA personnel. You will work on site in the government program office, where you will have frequent interaction with the government and support contractors. This opportunity will also collaborate with National Security Space mission partners that are building and integrating capabilities. This position allows for the opportunity to see your contributions to a critical mission become realized in the near future.

The Sr. Software System Architect Lead in the space domain will be responsible for overseeing the design, integration, and delivery of complex software systems from multiple vendors. The focus will be on validating a robust, modular architecture that allows seamless collaboration between teams and ensures our space technologies are scalable, secure, and high-performing. Working in close collaboration with cross-functional teams (software engineers, hardware engineers, system integrators, and vendors), this role will shape the future of our product line.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in El Segundo, California.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Oversee the delivery of highly scalable, fault-tolerant, and secure systems
  • Define and enforce software standards, ensuring that solutions meet performance, security, and scalability requirements
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and external vendors to develop technical roadmaps and timelines
  • Lead technical reviews and design discussions with multiple vendors to ensure system integration aligns with overall project objectives
  • Establish and implement middleware and modular design frameworks (e.g., AUTOSAR, DDS, ROS) to support a modular software ecosystem
  • Develop and maintain documentation for all systems and components
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and certifications relevant to the space domain (e.g., ECSS, CCSDS)
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to development teams and vendors to ensure software best practices are followed
  • Collaborate on system testing, validation, and verification with teams to ensure a smooth performance of systems
  • Act as a point of escalation for complex technical challenges, working closely with vendors to troubleshoot and resolve issues

What You Need to be Successful
Minimum Requirements for Sr. Project Leader – Systems Software Engineering and Cloud Computing Architecture:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related STEM field
  • 12+ years of experience in software, system design, and systems integration
  • Proven experience working with vendors to deliver large-scale, multi-component systems
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and containerization technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures

title: Engagement & Communications Intern
description:
About Audubon

The National Audubon Society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. Birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. Audubon works across the Western Hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. Through a collaborative, bipartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, Audubon drives meaningful and lasting conservation outcomes. With 800 staff and over 1.9 million supporters, Audubon is a dynamic and ever-growing force committed to ensuring a better planet for both birds and people for generations to come. Learn more at and on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram @audubonsociety.

Position Summary:

Audubon seeks an Engagement & Communications Intern to provide critical capacity in digital communications, data-base management, and statewide chapter support.


The internship is a paid semester long internship designed to give students and early-career professionals hands-on nonprofit experience while contributing to conservation capacity-building in Texas. Across Texas, there are 19 Audubon affiliated chapters supporting our mission to protect birds and the places they need today and tomorrow through local grassroots community outreach and education. In an effort to advance their impact, we are looking to support their work through technology advances on their websites, creating informational hubs for easy resource access, connecting chapters with the next generation of birders through social media, and other opportunities in collaboration with the intern, Audubon Texas, and the Chapters.

The intern will manage digital tools and resources, support communications, and collaborate with chapter leaders to aid their outreach efforts to meet our Flight Plan Community Building Milestone of growing and mobilizing a broader, more diverse network of people who care about birds and the places they need. Beyond their primary responsibilities, the intern will also have opportunities to learn from Audubon program staff and explore conservation career pathways.

Length of Internship: The internship is expected to last between 10-15 weeks

Location: Remote Texas; opportunities for hybrid work in Texas

Hours: 15 hours per week anticipated

Intern Schedule: Monday – Friday, working hours between 8am-5pm, flexible schedule and times available

Projected Start Date/End Date: aligned with fall and spring academic semesters estimating start date Sep 1.

This role is remote with flexibility for in-person experiences when possible.

Compensation:

$20.00 – $22.50 / hour

Additional Job Description

Essential Functions:

  • Maintain and enhance digital libraries and shared resource platforms for Audubon chapters.

  • Create toolkits, templates, and guides to support chapter operations, communications, and fundraising.

  • Assist with website updates and social media content creation for Audubon and affiliated chapters.

  • Help coordinate chapter engagement activities, such as quarterly check-ins and training webinars and the in-person gathering in September in Austin, Texas

  • Collect and synthesize feedback from chapters to assess needs and strengthen support systems.

  • Participate in professional development opportunities, including shadowing Audubon program staff or visiting Audubon centers.

  • Maintains and fosters culture of safety.

Internship Benefits:

  • Gain practical nonprofit and conservation management experience.

  • Learn about statewide conservation priorities and community-based engagement.

  • Build skills in communications, knowledge management, and digital tools.

  • Connect with conservation professionals through Audubon’s Tomorrow’s Leaders Conservation (TLC) program and chapter network.

  • Explore career pathways in conservation by engaging with staff across Audubon centers and programs.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Interest in nonprofit management, communications, environmental science, or related fields.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple tasks.

  • Comfort navigating digital tools such as Google Workspace, Canva, Mailchimp, or similar platforms.

  • Willingness to learn, take direction, and engage with constructive feedback.

  • Commitment to Audubon’s organizational values of care, collaboration, change, integrity, impact, and innovation.

  • Experience fostering inclusive and collaborative work environments is valued.

title: Software Engineer - Prediction and Planning ML
description:
About Applied Intuition

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments.

About the role

We are looking for a software engineer with expertise in ML-first behavior prediction and planning. You will develop ML-first behavior modules that can forecast the future motions of road users and predict their interactions. You will work closely with the perception team on areas such as training data generation, and with the planning team on ML-based planner development.

In addition to your engineering contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the nascent autonomy industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Prototype, evaluate, refine, and deploy state-of-the-art ML algorithms that predict the future motion of the ego agent and other road users in the scene

  • Leverage established products at Applied Intuition to build the software and infra foundation for behavior-specific ML development

  • Collaborate tightly with perception and planning engineers on many cross-team initiatives

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related field

  • Experience with the end-to-end development cycle of deep learning models

  • Expertise in subdomains such as modeling, input pipelines, evaluation, deployment, and model optimization

  • 3+ years of experience building production software using modern software practices

  • Fluency in C++, or fluency in Python with intermediate experience in C++

Nice to have:

  • Peer-reviewed research at machine learning conferences like NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, ICCV, ECCV, IROS, or ICRA.

  • Experience with driver assistance or autonomous driving systems

  • Experience in evaluating and improving system-in-the-loop model performance

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Please reference the job posting’s subtitle for where this position will be located.

title: Generalist, Growth
description:
About Base

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

About the Role

We're hiring a Growth Generalist who wants to do their best work at a company building something that matters. This isn't a traditional marketing role — it's a seat for someone who thinks in channels, experiments, and outcomes, and doesn't need a title to tell them where to play. You'll help millions of people discover a better way to power their homes, at a moment when reliability, cost, and the grid are top of mind. You'll work across every surface of the growth motion and own the results end to end.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer acquisition targets with clear accountability across a channel that you own

  • Design and run structured growth experiments across the funnel to unlock step-change improvements.

  • Translate performance data into decisions: what to double down on, what to fix, and what to shut down.

  • Operate a high-velocity creative engine, working closely with design to develop, test, and scale winning creative.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on growth experience with direct ownership of channels in a consumer or consumer-adjacent business.

  • Time spent in early-stage or unstructured environments, and comfort with the ambiguity that comes with it.

  • Equal comfort in a dashboard, a creative brief, and a cross-functional standup.

  • A bias to move fast and start before you're told to.

  • A pull toward action over analysis, and a defined scope you build yourself rather than wait for.

About the Team

The Growth team sets the pace for how fast Base can deliver affordable, reliable power to the people who need it. We operate as one team across marketing, sales, support, product, and design — lean and high-ownership. Everything we build is measured against one bar: the fastest-growing, most beloved energy company in the world.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

Our Values

  • First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

  • Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

  • Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

  • Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

  • Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

  • Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

  • Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Do the best work of your life at Base.

title: Program Scheduler
description:
Title:

Program Scheduler

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a Program Scheduler to support an Army Aviation Acquisition Program in Huntsville, Alabama. In this role, you will develop, maintain, and analyze Integrated Master Schedules utilizing Primavera P6 while coordinating schedule inputs from multiple functional organizations. You will play a key role in program execution by providing schedule analysis, earned value reporting, risk assessments, forecasting, and baseline management support. This position requires close collaboration with program leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure cost, schedule, and technical objectives remain aligned. The Program Scheduler will provide actionable recommendations to support informed decision-making, identify schedule risks, and develop recovery strategies that contribute to successful program execution.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and manage the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for an Army Aviation Acquisition Program utilizing Primavera P6.
  • Conduct schedule analysis and assessments to ensure schedules are structured properly, contain complete network logic, support critical path reporting, and follow industry scheduling best practices.
  • Perform trend analysis, baseline versus current schedule comparisons, margin assessments, cost and schedule risk assessments, duration compression analyses, and schedule health checks.
  • Track schedule progress and develop customized reports, metrics, and dashboards for program leadership and stakeholders.
  • Conduct cost and schedule integration activities to validate budget and resource requirements and assess impacts of changes to project cost, schedule, or technical baselines.
  • Consolidate monthly schedule updates from participating organizations and maintain the program master schedule.
  • Interpret schedule analysis results, identify critical activities and impacts, and validate that corrective actions satisfy customer requirements.
  • Develop project status reports, support change control processes, generate what-if scenarios, and assist in recovery planning activities.
  • Support risk management activities, conduct monthly Earned Value Management (EVM) reporting, prepare Estimates at Completion (EACs), and support annual PPBE planning activities.
  • Participate in Integrated Master Schedule reviews, Change Control Boards, and resource planning activities to support effective forecasting and program execution.
  • Other duties as assigned in support of mission and business requirements.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8 years of experience in developing and executing Master Schedules for acquisition programs. Bachelor's Degree preferred. Combinations of education and experience are acceptable.
  • Must be fully trained/experienced in Primavera as a scheduling tool.
  • Must be experienced in EVM and establishing EACs.
  • Experience in managing life cycle support strategies and the required acquisition documentation.

title: Product Manager, Patient Onboarding & First Value
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

The Patient Apps team owns Dexcom’s patient-facing mobile experiences and partners across design, engineering, clinical, regulatory, medical affairs, and commercial teams to deliver differentiated experiences that improve outcomes for patients and providers.

As Product Manager focused on Onboarding & First Value, you will own the product outcome, discovery evidence, and opportunity prioritization for the Onboarding & First Value domain.

Working within a cross-functional team, you will identify the customer opportunities most likely to help new users successfully download the right app, start, understand, and realize value from their CGM experience. Success means translating evidence into recommendations that reduce early friction, increase confidence, and help users reach meaningful value quickly and independently.

Where you come in:

  • Own the product outcome, discovery evidence, and opportunity prioritization for the Onboarding & First Value domain.
  • Lead outcome-based discovery: Identify the customer opportunities most likely to improve setup completion, first-session success, user confidence, and early engagement.
  • Define first meaningful value: Partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Medical Affairs, and Research to identify what makes a new user's first CGM experience personally relevant and worth continuing.
  • Build evidence for decisions: Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, and behavioral insights to guide prioritization and recommendations.
  • Shape onboarding and education experiences: Define how Dexcom introduces CGM concepts, expectations, goals, and context without creating unnecessary burden or complexity.
  • Increase motivation and confidence: Help users understand what CGM is showing, why it matters to their goals, and what actions they can take next.
  • Capture meaningful starting context: Define what information should be gathered early to support more relevant experiences, guidance, and insights over time.
  • Jointly own product risks within the Quad: Partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, and Human Factors to evaluate value, usability, feasibility, viability, and safety.
  • Translate ambiguity into focused recommendations: Convert broad questions around activation, motivation, education, confidence, personalization, and early engagement into clear problem statements, tested assumptions, and prioritized next steps.
  • Define success measures and learning agenda: Establish the metrics, qualitative signals, and evidence needs that indicate whether users are reaching value faster, continuing with confidence, and engaging beyond initial setup.

What makes you successful:

  • Product management experience: Product Manager: 5+ years in product management or a closely related role, ideally in healthcare, digital health, consumer software, mobile applications, or regulated technology.
  • Outcome-based discovery: Demonstrated ability to work backward from customer and business outcomes, identify opportunities, and use discovery to validate what drives adoption, engagement, retention, and time-to-value.
  • Activation and onboarding expertise: Experience improving customer activation, onboarding, adoption, engagement, retention, or first-value experiences through product strategy, experimentation, and iterative learning.
  • Customer empathy: Ability to understand customer motivations, goals, behaviors, barriers, and confidence gaps, then translate those insights into intuitive product experiences.
  • Education and comprehension: Experience simplifying complex information into clear, confidence-building experiences that help users understand what they are seeing, why it matters, and what to expect next.
  • Behavior change and engagement thinking: Experience designing products that help users build confidence, develop habits, sustain engagement, or progress toward meaningful health or behavioral outcomes over time.
  • Strategic product thinking: Ability to connect customer needs, product opportunities, business outcomes, and evidence into a clear product strategy.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to partner with engineering, design, medical affairs, clinical, regulatory, legal, commercial, data science, research, quality, and human factors teams to deliver high-impact experiences.
  • Regulated environment fluency: Comfort operating within regulated environments where safety, compliance, privacy, and quality must be balanced with customer experience and speed of learning.
  • Data-informed product development: Experience using customer research, analytics, experimentation, behavioral data, and qualitative signals to guide prioritization and measure success.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with consumer onboarding, activation funnels, mobile app engagement, first-use experiences, or customer retention.
  • Experience designing personalized onboarding, goal-setting, education, habit formation, or behavior-change experiences.
  • Experience with digital health, chronic condition management, diabetes, CGM, health coaching, digital therapeutics, or patient-facing medical device software.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, SaMD, HIPAA-compliant platforms, medical device software, or other regulated technology environments.
  • Experience using analytics, experimentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, or behavioral metrics to improve product outcomes.
  • Experience designing experiences for users with varying levels of health literacy, technology confidence, motivation, or support needs.
  • Ability to define what “first meaningful value” means for a product experience and translate that into measurable activation, engagement, and retention signals.
  • Strong systems thinking, including the ability to define reusable onboarding, education, context capture, and personalization patterns that can scale across patient experiences.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders, commercial stakeholders, clinicians, regulatory partners, researchers, designers, and technical teams, especially when tradeoffs are ambiguous or evidence is still emerging.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 5-15%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8-12 years of related experience.
  • At this level a graduate degree may be desirable with 4 years of related experience

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

We're a VC-backed defense technology company pioneering an expeditionary manufacturing ecosystem that produces and sustains modular, mission-adaptable unmanned systems, parts and components for repair and sustainment, and the software to transform point solutions into a network of strategic assets.

We're building a team of engineers, operators, and problem-solvers who believe the future of deterrence cannot rely only on expensive, exquisite platforms made in centralized factories. title: Power Electronics Engineer I
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Responsibilities:


The Power Electronics Engineer will support JPL’s Power Electronics Group in designing, building, and testing next‑generation space power hardware. In this role, the engineer will contribute to the full development cycle of power electronics—from initial concepts and subsystem design to hardware fabrication, testing, documentation, and delivery. The position involves hands‑on work with laboratory test equipment, collaboration with senior engineers and project managers, and ensuring high‑reliability standards for flight hardware. Candidates should have an electrical engineering background, experience testing and debugging circuits, and familiarity with design and simulation tools, with additional preference for experience in aerospace or space‑focused power electronics development.

JPL’s Power Electronics Group (345D) leads the research and development and flight applications of power systems, power electronics, power sources, energy storage, energy conversion, and related sensor systems at JPL. The Power Electronics Group within the Avionics, Power, and Instrument Electronics section is dedicated to the development of power subsystem electronics concepts, implementation of power system architecture designs, design and implementation of hardware for flight projects, and support for proposal development and project formulation. Currently we are seeking an Electronics Engineer to participate in the development and testing of the next generation of space power hardware.

As an Engineer in the Power Electronics Group you will design and test electronics subsystems and support equipment and will be involved in all aspects of power electronics development from concept to delivery. You will work closely with Power Electronics Cognizant Engineers, Senior Design Engineers, Systems Engineers, and the Technical Group Supervisors.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Design power electronics systems, subsystems, and test equipment.

  • Coordinate the fabrication of prototype and flight hardware.

  • Test both prototype and flight hardware to verify and validate that it operates correctly and that requirements are met, including environmental testing.

  • Develop engineering documentation, including engineering drawings, circuit analyses, test procedures, and presentations for reviews.

  • Work with other engineers to solve technical problems as they arise, both at the design level and during laboratory testing.

  • Work with section and project managers to ensure that schedules are appropriately planned and met.

  • Understand and ensure that appropriate procedures are followed and documentation developed to successfully deliver high reliability flight hardware.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or related technical subject area with typically a minimum of 1 years of related experience, or Master’s degree in similar disciplines with a minimum of 0 year related experience

  • Experience with Bench Top Test Equipment, including DMMs, high current power supplies, electronic loads, various measurement probes and oscilloscopes.

  • Ability to test and debug circuits in the lab, both on your own and in collaboration with others.

  • Knowledge of and experience with computer aided engineering software and tools for design and simulation of power electronics.

  • Good oral and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work with a diverse group of people.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in the design, development, fabrication, assembly and test of power electronics or analog hardware, particularly focused on power systems and analog electronics in space environments.

  • Military, Aerospace & Space hardware development experience.

  • Experience with LTSpice for simulation and Altium for schematic capture and PWB layout.

  • Experience with test software and hardware. Preferably using scripting languages like Python for automation

description:

title: Lead P&C Technician Field Services
description:
WSP is searching for a POWER Testing and Energization (PTE) Lead P&C Technician Field Services for our project locations in the states of Washington, Idaho, Nevada, Arizona, and Utah. Successful applicants will be involved in projects with our PTE Team and be part of a growing organization that solves problems and supports client needs in electrical testing and commissioning in utility substations, industrial, and bulk electrical power systems.

This Opportunity

  • Leads field operations for complex construction, environmental, and infrastructure projects by providing expert technical guidance, hands-on execution, and oversight of day‑to‑day site activities
  • Applies extensive field experience and specialized knowledge to support day-to-day site activities, troubleshoot technical challenges, and uphold quality and safety standards while ensuring escalations are made to project leadership for issues involving contractual, schedule, or major scope impacts
  • Coordinates with engineers, scientists, and subcontractors to ensure field tasks are delivered efficiently and in compliance with regulatory and client requirements
  • Supports project delivery by mentoring technicians, managing site logistics, and facilitating effective communication between field crews and project leadership
  • As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery, power generation, and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition—and we need your help.

Your Impact

  • Perform testing and commissioning of Protection and Control systems on high voltage substations
  • Perform on-site hands-on protective relay testing using relay test sets such as Omicron CMC 256/356 or Doble F6150. Examples of relays to be tested are SEL-311L, SEL-387, SEL-487, SEL-421, SEL-351S, GE L90, GE D60 among others
  • Independently execute and validate advanced protection and control testing sequences, ensuring alignment with test plans, applicable standards, and client specifications
  • Follow safety protocols and participate in daily safety briefings and job hazard assessments
  • Use field forms, digital data tools, and mobile applications to document site activities
  • Perform equipment cleaning, inventory control, and calibration as directed
  • Act as a primary field liaison with clients, contractors, vendors, and project managers to communicate progress, risks, and technical concerns
  • Apply expert knowledge of field instrumentation and troubleshoot technical issues with minimal supervision
  • Lead field implementation of site-specific health and safety protocols, job hazard analyses, and quality control procedures
  • Lead field crews, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring consistency across work streams
  • Mentor junior and mid-level technicians in technical procedures, safety practices, and proper documentation
  • Support corrective actions by troubleshooting equipment or procedural issues and identifying practical solutions
  • Monitor contractor compliance with site safety plans, environmental controls, and work quality expectations
  • Lead field readiness planning, including tool inspection, site access coordination, utility marking, and weather contingency measures
  • Participate in pre-construction meetings, regulatory inspections, and client walkthroughs as the senior field representative
  • Ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and integration with project systems and internal databases
  • Maintain oversight of fleet vehicles, tools, materials, and inventory to support site productivity
  • Contribute expert technical expertise to incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives across projects
  • Maintain a strong safety culture and encourage proactive hazard recognition and reporting
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 11 years of experience in the electrical testing industry, including experience in medium and high voltage circuit breakers, power transformers, instrument transformers, and substation protection and controls testing
  • Demonstrable expertise on transmission, generation, or distribution relays (SEL, Basler, Beckwith, and GE families) and protective schemes
  • Advanced technical skills related to protective relays, including relay calibration utilizing test sets/measuring devices such as Omicron CMC 256/356 and Doble F6150, control scheme testing, testing of the sensing CT/PT circuits, ability to upload settings to microprocessor relays, and static & dynamic testing of microprocessor-based protective relays
  • Proven experience with electrical field testing standards, practices, and procedures, such as NETA, IEEE, and NFPA applicable standards
  • Expert knowledge of testing electrical distribution, generation, and transmission projects with voltage levels ranging from 15 kV to 500 kV, including protective relays and circuit breakers
  • Strong understanding of technical software used for testing purposes and data review: ProTesT, Protection Suite, ENOSERV RTS, Omicron Test Universe, and AcSELerator Quickset
  • Demonstrable ability to identify and respond to field challenges and equipment malfunctions
  • Advanced skill in preparing field logs, sketches, and digital reports
  • Physical stamina to work in outdoor and physically demanding conditions.
  • Significant experience collaborating with contractors, technicians, and engineers
  • Demonstrated commitment to field safety, quality, and regulatory compliance
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for field team collaboration
  • Capability to support a wide variety of tasks in dynamic or changing environments
  • Ability to follow procedures, meet deadlines, and maintain accountability in the field
  • Commitment to continued learning and development in technical field services
  • Understanding of confidentiality and ethical behavior in technical environments
  • Reliable, punctual, and detail-oriented with the ability to work independently or with a team
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies
  • Willingness and physical ability to lift up to 35 pounds individually, and up to 100 pounds with assistance
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, basic color differentiation, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must be willing to travel (up to 80%)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Technology degree in a similar discipline
  • Experience in testing and troubleshooting electromechanical relays
  • Experience in testing and commissioning electrical equipment on high voltage substations such as CTs, CCVTs, PLC systems, and DC systems, including batteries and battery chargers
  • Current OSHA 30-hour or 40-hour HAZWOPER certification

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:
Expected Salary (all locations): $70.00 - $90.00 per hour

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

Lead. Innovate. Transform.

Are you ready to shape the future of engineering for the F5 Distributed Cloud product? We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Director of Engineering to drive engineering excellence, scale innovative teams, and make bold advancements in cloud technology. If you're inspired by the challenge of creating the next-generation cloud data plane designed to power AI traffic and modern applications, and overseeing multiple cloud services, this is your opportunity to make a global impact.

As the Senior Director of Engineering, you’ll lead our data path engineering teams, guiding them in designing and delivering scalable solutions at the intersection of distributed cloud services, artificial intelligence, and high-performance applications. You will play a pivotal role in operating and optimizing multiple cloud services that serve our global user base.

What You’ll Do:

  • Champion Vision and Direction: Build and optimize the cloud data plane for AI traffic and modern, distributed applications, ensuring high availability, scalability, and state-of-the-art performance.
  • Run Multiple Cloud Services: Take ownership of operating and scaling multiple cloud services. This involves managing distributed systems and ensuring they meet robust performance, security, and reliability benchmarks.

  • Revolutionize Processes: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies within engineering workflows. Introduce tools and mechanisms for automation and seamless coordination in a high-growth, distributed team environment.
  • Scale Engineering Excellence: Develop a roadmap for scaling engineering processes, infrastructure, and global team structures, focusing on efficiency and quality without compromising innovation.
  • Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with product management, design, and engineering leaders, ensuring seamless alignment of engineering direction with product delivery milestones.
  • Elevate Engineering Infrastructure: Oversee investments in cutting-edge tools, including CI/CD pipelines, project management systems, and communication platforms, that propel engineering productivity to the next level.
  • Metrics That Matter: Set KPIs and use data to inform strategic decisions. Drive improvements based on actionable insights and measurable outcomes.
  • Talent Supercharger: Nurture leadership within the teams. Build a high-performance, collaborative culture that inspires engineers to stay ahead of the curve and excel continuously.
  • Master Resource Management: Plan and deploy resources effectively to support ambitious operational goals and engineering demands while managing budgets with precision.

What You Bring:

  • Leadership Mastery: 10+ years of experience scaling and leading engineering teams with hands-on success in distributed, global organizations.
  • Proven Experience Running a Cloud Service: Hands-on experience operating, scaling, and managing a cloud service—including addressing performance, reliability, and security at scale—absolutely required.
  • Cloud Expertise: Proven experience working with cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and designing architectures that support cutting-edge AI traffic workflows and modern application demands.
  • Trailblazer in Technology Innovation: A deep understanding of cloud data planes for delivering scalable, high-performance solutions to drive AI-powered applications.
  • Strategic Visionary: You excel at translating vision into execution, driving operational excellence, even in fast-paced, high-growth technology organizations.
  • Data-Driven Problem Solver: You thrive on using metrics and analytical insights to guide strategic decisions and engineering success.
  • Cross-functional Connector: Exceptional collaboration and stakeholder management prowess make you a trusted and respected partner, aligning diverse teams behind common objectives.
  • Inspiring Leader: Your ability to build trust, influence, and culture makes you a builder of teams that collaborate, innovate, and win.

Bonus Points:

  • Expertise in creating distributed cloud data planes specifically for AI-driven traffic and intelligent applications.
  • Experience scaling engineering organizations at technology companies with DevOps practices and agile methodologies at their core.
  • Deep knowledge of cutting-edge tooling ecosystems, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Demonstrated success in managing global teams across diverse geographies and time zones.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to lead engineering at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and modern applications. If you’re excited about scaling innovation, transforming engineering operations, and running world-class cloud services, apply now to shape what's next at F5 Distributed Cloud.

title: Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPM)
description:
Description: The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13-213, Airfield Driving. The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13-204 and DAFI 13-213. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have a *7-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
  • Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
  • Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
  • Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
  • Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
  • Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
  • Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
  • Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
  • Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13-213 and local directives.
  • Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
  • Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
  • Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
  • Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.
