title: Part-Time Assistant News Editor
description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

The New York Post is seeking a tough, experienced and sharp-eyed journalist with exceptional news judgment to join the team as a part-time Assistant News Editor.

This position will involve vetting, assigning and editing news stories of national interest – whether they involve politics, crime, deep investigations or any other major issue in the news cycle. You will work hand in hand with our national editor and our crack team of reporters.

We’re looking for someone with a proven track record of delivering timely stories while adhering to the highest journalistic standards of sourcing and accuracy. The ideal candidate is someone who is able to thrive in a highly competitive atmosphere while juggling multiple reporters and stories and rolling deadlines for our print newspaper.

The schedule is flexible but will include Sunday 10am - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with our national editor and reporters on hard-hitting stories that only The Post can deliver

  • Conduct strong edits on stories while ensuring you are maintaining The Post’s signature voice

  • Assign and even pitch stories of national interest

The ideal candidate will have/be:

  • At least 5 years of experience in a major metropolitan or national newsroom.

  • Experience leading a team of at least five reporters in a newsroom environment

  • A sharp eye for picking out that one detail that makes a Post story a Post story that other outlets may miss

  • Strong news judgement and editing chops

  • A voracious consumer of news in all areas

  • Experience editing multiple stories a day and turning them around quickly for both print and digital audiences

  • A fiercely competitive spirit

  • Flexibility in working weekend or later night shifts

  • Understanding of SEO, social media and video best practices and how to utilize those resources to optimize content and reach a wide audience a plus

  • Experience working in print production a plus

Note: This position will be required to come on-site at least three days a week to our Midtown newsroom.

Please note that this is an engagement facilitated through a third-party vendor. While the role supports The New York Post, employment and payroll will be managed by the vendor.

title: Analista de E-commerce PL
description:
Escopo:

  • Garantir a excelência da operação dos canais digitais, intervindo desde a gestão de catálogo, anúncios, preços e estoque até campanhas comerciais, acompanhamento de desempenho, análise de concorrência e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão dos Marketplaces: Gerencia a operação diária dos marketplaces, garantindo a execução comercial, saúde das contas, qualidade dos anúncios, ofertas, campanhas e cumprimento das políticas de cada plataforma.
  • Gestão de Catálogo e Conteúdo: Criar, atualizar e otimizar SKUs e anúncios, garantindo qualidade de títulos, transações, imagens, atributos e informações técnicas, além da aplicação de boas práticas de SEO para marketplaces e melhoria contínua da conversão.
  • Desempenho, Vendas e Pricing: Monitore diariamente vendas, KPIs, margem, conversão, Buy Box, estoque e rentabilidade por categoria/canal. Apoiar estratégias de precificação, competir e identificar oportunidades de crescimento e melhoria de resultados.
  • Campanhas e Planejamento Comercial: Operacionalizar o calendário comercial e campanhas dos marketplaces, incluindo ofertas, cupons, combos/kits, lançamentos, pré-vendas, datas comemorativas e ações específicas de editores e vendedores, avaliando estoque, preço, margem e potencial de vendas.
  • Estoque, Pedidos e Operação: Monitorar disponibilidade de produtos, pedidos, cancelamentos, devoluções, SLA e cumprimento, atuando preventivamente sobre riscos de violação e garantindo a integração e consistência das informações entre estoque, ERP, hub e marketplaces.
  • Analytics, Inteligência Competitiva e Reportes: Analisar dados internos e de mercado, utilizando ferramentas como Nubmetrics e soluções de precificação , para gerar insights sobre concorrência, preços, participação de mercado e desempenho. Desenvolver e acompanhar relatórios e KPIs, apoiando integração, planejamento de demanda e fóruns de desempenho.
  • Integrações e Evolução dos Canais: Acompanha integrações entre ERP, hubs e marketplaces, identificando e solucionando inconsistências junto às áreas de Tecnologia e Operações. Apoiar a implementação, expansão ou reestruturação de novos marketplaces e plataformas digitais, incluindo iniciativas de Social Commerce, Retail Media, Live Commerce e Afiliados.
  • Parceria com as áreas de negócio: Atuar em estreita colaboração com os gestores de categoria, Comercial, Marketing, Logística, Financeiro, Atendimento ao Cliente, Produtos, Tecnologia e parceiros externos, sendo ponto de apoio para a execução e evolução do negócio digital.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em E-commerce, Marketplaces ou operações digitais, com vivência em Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon e/ou outros marketplaces.
  • Experiência com gestão de catálogo, anúncios, campanhas, precificação e operação de marketplaces.
  • Experiência com análise de indicadores de vendas, margem, estoque, pedidos e desempenho.
  • Vivência com ERP, hubs e integradores de marketplaces; experiência com Anymarket (Diferencial).

title: Project Engineer
description:
Hoffman Construction is seeking a Project Engineer. This individual will be an integral member of the on-site Engineering Department, providing essential technical and administrative support throughout the lifecycle of various construction projects. Reporting to the Program Engineer, this individual will support coordination among project team members, design professionals, subcontractors, and client stakeholders to resolve complex field coordination issues and maintain alignment across all disciplines. The Project Engineer is on the front line and plays a key role in driving project milestones while ensuring safety, quality, and constructability standards are upheld. This position will be fully onsite in Boise, ID.

Salary Range: $75,000-$130,000 DOE + Incentives

Qualifications

Professional Experience and Education

  • Minimum 3 years of Project Engineering experience in commercial building construction required, hyperscale or mission-critical data center projects experience highly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of construction means and methods, trade sequencing, and commissioning workflows.
  • High School diploma or GED required.
  • Bachelor of science in civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, structural engineering, construction management or equivalent degree and/or equivalent craft level work experience.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead or support meetings involving area managers, design team members, multiple subcontractors, and client representatives.
  • Interface between area managers and multiple subcontractors to assist with resolution of field coordination items.
  • Review and interpret design drawings, construction documents, technical manuals, and quantifying materials required for construction from the documents.
  • Coordinate all civil, architectural, and structural (CSA) systems within the overall project scope.
  • Assist with organize and facilitate training of the client’s personnel in the operations and maintenance of CSA elements and systems.
  • Review and process shop drawings, product data, and technical submittal information; cross-coordinate between submittals to ensure the compatibility and constructability.
  • Generate, receive, and distribute Requests for Information (RFI).
  • Receive and distribute change documents, bulletins and field directives issued by other team members.
  • Support BIM coordination and participate in clash detection and resolution processes.
  • Participate in quality assurance and quality control activities, including pre-functional testing and systems start up.
  • Assist in the commissioning and turnover of systems.
  • Serve as the technical advisor at onsite field construction office.
  • Provide technical support in the field, including layout, verification, and sequencing of installations.
  • Attend and contribute to pre-installation meetings; assist in documentation of as-built conditions.
  • Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) engineers to ensure integration of architectural, structural, and MEP systems.

Position Related Skills

  • Proficient in Windows and Microsoft Office 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Power Point and Teams) and have a strong understanding of working within a computer network.
  • Experience with project management software such as Prolog, Procore, E-Builder, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, and Primavera Project Planner (P6).
  • Experience with design software such as AutoCAD, Revit and Navisworks.
  • Training in design and construction document reading, design specifications, survey theory and techniques.
  • Experience in organizing technical data in a neat and accurate method. Familiar with Construction Specifications Institutes (CSI) Master Format.
  • Strong understanding of construction means and methods, sequencing, and field practices.
  • Capable of organizing and analyzing technical data effectively and accurately.
  • Ability to work well and maintain a cooperative attitude in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent time-management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work while frequently interrupted by phone calls and questions on work in progress.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills with an ability to develop strong interpersonal relationships.
  • Ability to work closely with variety of trade and craft people in a field work situation. Patience and professionalism are essential.
  • Must be a strong team player with the ability to collaborate with various personnel within and across departments and at all levels of leadership.
  • Work schedule must be flexible to allow extended hours or off shift work to accommodate changing construction schedule and sequences.

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Standing/Walking/Sitting: Workday is a combination of being stationary and moving about the work location.
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and on active construction sites.
  • Must be able to climb stairs, to ascend and descend ladders, scaffold, inspect confined or underground spaces.
  • Hands/Arms: Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery.
  • Sight: Specific vision abilities required include close vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus in an outdoor environment. Must be able to safely operate a vehicle with a valid driver’s license.
  • The work is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading print and digital documents.
  • Hearing: Must be able to work in proximity to loud equipment more than 50% of the time. Must be able to wear hearing protection, as necessary. Often required to communicate with customers and co-workers in an office setting and on the job site.
  • Speech: Ability to communicate laws, ordinances, plans, regulations, protocols, directives, and standard operating procedures related to project scope in English.
  • Lift/Carry: Must have the ability to lift or manipulate fifty pounds to a height of three feet and carry or push it 50-100 feet.
  • Bending/Twisting: Frequent.
  • Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: Must be able to regularly position self in a kneeling, crouching or crawling position for purpose of examining project work.
  • Must be able to physically access all areas and levels of construction site for work progress review.
  • Work schedule must be flexible to allow for extended hours or off-shift work to accommodate changing construction schedule and sequences.
  • Must use independent judgment, organizational and critical thinking skills to determine best method to accomplish desired results.

title: R&D- Global Fire Protection Portfolio Technical Director
description:
The Global R&D Technical Director for Fire Protection is a member of the Global Protective & Marine R&D Technology Leadership Team. This role is responsible for leading sales support, as well as product and platform development, for intumescent coating systems within Sherwin Williams’ Protective & Marine global business.

Job duties include contact with other employees and access confidential and proprietary information and/or other items of value, and such access may be supervised or unsupervised. The Company therefore has determined that a review of criminal history is necessary to protect the business and its operations and reputation and is necessary to protect the safety of the Company’s staff, employees, and business relationships.

This role will be located at Sherwin-Williams Morikis Global Technology Center located at 6745 Miller Road, Brecksville, OH 44141.

1. Product Development & Execution
o Lead the full lifecycle of product development for intumescent coatings, ensuring timely and successful delivery from concept to commercialization.
o Drive executional excellence across global R&D teams, ensuring alignment with business cases and market strategies.
o Champion innovation and continuous improvement in product performance, application, and system integration.
2. Regulatory Standards & Third-Party Testing
o Provides organizational leadership and accountability for regulatory standards and third party testing, serving as the technical authority for global fire protection standards including UL, EN, ASTM, and ISO.
o Through direct and indirect teams, establishes governance and oversight to ensure products meet or exceed regulatory and certification requirements.
o Owns the strategy and execution model for third party testing and certification.
o Ensures the organization proactively adapts to evolving global regulatory requirements to maintain compliance, manage risk, and protect market access.
3. Physical Property & Compatibility Testing
o Oversee rigorous testing of product physical properties including adhesion, durability, thermal expansion, and fire resistance.
o Ensure environmental and physical compatibility across substrates, surface preparation methods, primers, and topcoats.
o Lead system-level validation to ensure product performance in real-world applications.
4. Strategic Collaboration & Leadership
o Partner closely with the Global Fire Portfolio Marketing Director to align technical development with customer needs, market trends, and strategic priorities.
o Translate business cases into clear, actionable R&D plans with defined deliverables and success metrics.
o Provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration between R&D, marketing, regulatory, and operations.
o Key Stakeholder in the delivery of the Fire Center of Excellence (FCOE) Approval and Completion

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
• Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without needing sponsorship for employment work visa status now or in the future (e.g., OPT, CPT, H1B, EB-1,etc.)
• Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math field.
• Must be at least 18 years of age.
• Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience in coatings or specialty chemicals R&D, with a strong emphasis on regulatory compliance and product delivery.
• Deep expertise in global fire protection standards and certification processes, including successful engagement with third-party testing agencies.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Advanced degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math field.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage complex technical programs, and deliver results aligned with strategic business goals.
• Strong background in physical property testing and system compatibility, especially in multi-layer coating systems.
• Skilled in technical decision-making, risk management, and resource prioritization across global teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence across technical and commercial domains.

Travel Requirements: 40% Domestic and International

This position is not eligible for sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, including conversion to H-1B visa.

Successful candidate will be required to sign an Employee Restrictive Covenant Agreement where permitted by law.

title: Laboratory Technician II

title: Network Specialist-Cable Plant I
description:
Location: Panama City Beach, FL
Job Type: Full-Time
Security Clearance: Ability to obtain a Secret clearance


AERMOR is seeking a Network Specialist-Cable Plant I who will support the Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) Network Manager in the installation, troubleshooting, and repair of the NSWC PCD network infrastructure, including RDT&E and NMCI networks. The specialist will assist in diagnosing physical network connectivity problems and working with a broad range of telecommunications cabling media, including fiber optic, Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP), coaxial, and main feeder cables. This role is critical in ensuring efficient network installations and infrastructure maintenance.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Assist in the installation, troubleshooting, and repair of telecommunications cabling, including fiber optic, UTP, coaxial, and main feeder cable.
  • Install cable racks, conduit, Panduit, and other support structures to ensure the protection and aesthetics of cables.
  • Test cables for signal quality, continuity, and availability to maintain optimal performance.
  • Perform cable plant troubleshooting, fabrication, and installation, including CAT5/6, RJ-11, RJ-45 terminations, and fiber optic connections.
  • Repair and troubleshoot media converters, copper/fiber modems, and other cable plant infrastructure components.
  • Pull telecommunications cabling through various building architectures, including Protected Distribution Systems, buried conduit (outside plant), inter-building routes, ceilings, raised floors, and cable troughs.
  • Support structured cabling infrastructure by ensuring compliance with installation standards and procedures.
  • Collaborate with CP II Network Specialists to ensure proper cable management and installation practices.
  • Create and maintain network diagrams using Microsoft Visio.
  • Document cabling layouts, installations, and updates to ensure accurate network infrastructure records.

Required Qualifications:
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with network cable installation, termination, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of cable plant systems, including copper and fiber optic subsystems used for transmitting electrical and optical signals between active communication equipment.
  • Familiarity with cable testing, including signal continuity and availability testing.
  • Ability to work with various cabling media, including fiber optics, UTP, and coaxial cables.
  • Understanding of building cable routing, including protected and buried conduits.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a structured IT environment.

description:
Goodway Group is one of AdAge's 2025's BEST PLACES TO WORK!   • Collaborate across engineering, product, and data teams. Work closely with stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize work, and deliver solutions that align with business goals. You actively participate in design discussions and influence implementation decisions.
  • Mentor and unblock other engineers. Support team growth through code reviews, documentation, and technical guidance. You help others improve their approach to data engineering and keep projects moving forward.
  • Identify and mitigate risks early. Anticipate edge cases, scalability challenges, and data integrity risks. You surface issues early and help the team make informed tradeoffs.
  • Improve systems, tools, and processes. Introduce improvements to pipelines, testing, observability, and deployment practices. Your contributions lead to faster delivery, fewer incidents, and stronger overall system performance.

    • Strong experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines (batch and/or streaming)
    • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python, Scala, or similar)

    • Ability to design and implement scalable data systems with clear tradeoffs
    • Experience improving system reliability, performance, and maintainability
    • Strong understanding of data architecture patterns and best practices
  • Product & Business Awareness
    • Ability to connect technical decisions to business impact
    • Experience working with stakeholders to define requirements and prioritize work
  • Clear communicator in code, documentation, and discussions
  • Proven ability to mentor others and contribute to team growth
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a remote environment

title: VP Trade Compliance
description:
Primary Function of Position
The Vice President of Trade Compliance reports to the SVP Planning and Logistics and is
responsible for establishing, governing and enforcing Intuitive’s global trade compliance
framework for medical devices, instruments, accessories, capital equipment, service parts,
software, and indirect materials. The role ensures full legal compliance with all applicable import,
export, customs, sanctions, and trade regulations while supporting uninterrupted patient care,
regulatory approvals and global commercial operations. The position balances regulatory rigor
with operational continuity in a highly regulated environment where delays and enforcement
actions may impact healthcare delivery.
Essential Job Duties

Continue to build and lead a global trade compliance
organization. Establish training programs tailored to
manufacturing, service, commercial teams, distributors,
logistics providers, and customs brokerage. Direct
responsibility for compliance with inbound materials,
manufacturing cross border transactions, and finished goods into markets. Ensure
escalation, issue management, and document controls.
• Serve as primary interface with customs and export control authorities, health authorities
and trade regulators. Represent the company in industry groups addressing medical
device trade issues. Manage relationships with brokers, consultants, outside counsel,
and regulatory advisors.
• Oversee trade compliance systems integrated with ERP, WMS, TMS, and Global Trade
Management platforms. UDI, lot, serial, and device history record data. Ensure accuracy
of HS codes, ECCNs, valuation, and origin and the sku and serialized device level. Drive
automation to reduce clearance delays and improve audit readiness

Required Skills and Experience

Strategic Leadership: define and own the trade compliance strategy across R&D,
manufacturing, service, and commercial distribution. Proactively advise executive
leadership on trade risks affecting business continuity, and service programs. Assess
geopolitical, sanctions, and regulatory developments impacting medical device supply
chains.
• Regulatory and Medical Device Compliance: ensure compliance with trade regulations as
they apply to finished goods, capital equipment, service parts, digital health components,
clinical trial materials, samples, etc. Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality to ensure
trade compliance does not compromise regulatory approvals, UDI requirements, or
product traceability. Understanding FDA regulated products and global equivalents (EU
MDR, UKCA, PMDA, NMPA, ANVISA, etc.)

Governance, Policy, and Risk Management: establish and
maintain global policies covering: HS classification,
Valuation, ECCN determinations, Country-Of-Origins and
substantial transformation analysis, Free Trade Agreements
and preferential duty programs, sanctioned and denied
party screenings for institutions and distributors. Lead government audits, inquiries, and
inspections related to customs and export controls. Oversee voluntary disclosures and
corrective actions in coordination with Legal, Outside Counsel, and Quality.
• Continuity of Care: embed compliance into workflows including global manufacturing,
field service and logistics, repair networks, consignment, loaner, and emergency
replacement programs. Ensure compliant execution of bonded movement, bonded
warehouses, Free Trade Zones, and duty deferral programs. Enable tariff-mitigation
strategies without risking regulatory violations or product holds.
• Track Record: history of zero material trade violations, on time clearance of critical device
and service parts, successful audits with customs, effective tariff and duty optimization,
and institution of systems and networks

Required Education and Training
• Proven leadership at Vice President and Director levels of global and regional
compliance teams. Demonstrated experience supporting regulated medical device or life
science supply chains.
• BS in Law, International Trade, Business, Supply Chain / Logistics, or related field
• 15+ years of experience in global trade compliance, customs, or export controls
• Trade or Custom Certifications (LCB, CCS, CUSECI, or equivalent)

Preferred Skills and Experience
• Advanced degree
• Experience with FDA regulated products and global health authorities
• Medical device regulatory fluency and risk management. Capital equipment, software
enabled devices, serialization, service intensive portfolios

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

If you're passionate about building robust, scalable software for complex robotic systems and want to work across the full robotics stack—from low-level system interfaces to high-level application logic—then we'd like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is enthusiastic about building the right solutions for our customers and will collaborate with other teams to ensure that our product meets Amazon-scale requirements. They will:
- Develop real-time sensor data processing pipelines, including implementing sensor fusion algorithms and computer vision models for robotic perception.
- Develop and optimize multi-modal data recording pipelines to support recording high-bandwidth data from multiple sensor sources simultaneously.
- Develop physics-realistic simulations of various sensor types (LiDAR, Radar, IMU, force/torque, tactile) to enable virtual testing and validation of perception and control algorithms prior to hardware deployment.
- Design, develop, and maintain production software for robotic systems in C++ and/or Python, spanning perception, motion planning, controls, and application layers.
- Work with multiple system components including sensor integration, networking, safety systems, and real-time actuation on modern robotic hardware.
- Debug and troubleshoot complex system-level issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.
- Develop solutions that balance performance, reliability, and maintainability under the guidance of senior engineers.

A day in the life
As a Senior Software Development Engineer you will work within cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deploy software for robotic systems that operate in Amazon's fulfillment network. You will work across multiple domains of the robotics stack—interfacing with sensors, actuators, and control systems while also building higher-level application logic that coordinates robot behavior. The development process will involve contributing to system design, analyzing trade-offs of proposed approaches, and implementing production features. Testing efforts involve writing automated tests, building simulation environments, and performing live hardware testing to debug and root-cause issues on physical robot platforms.

title: Senior Substation Project Engineer
description:
Senior Substation Project Engineer

Location: UNAVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Overview

Join us as we Rise to the Challenge

At KCI, we’re building an enduring community that provides unparalleled value to our employee-owners. We make our mark designing and delivering our world-class solutions, so we invest deeply in supporting and developing our team. We reward integrity and commitment, and when we do well, you do well. Our employees have the freedom to innovate, unlimited growth, a voice that matters, a lifestyle that works, and skin in the game. Achievements are shared and celebrated. As a team, we are motivated to better ourselves, each other, and the world around us.

THE COMPANY

KCI Technologies, Inc. is a 100% employee-owned engineering, consulting and construction firm serving clients throughout the United States. KCI is recognized as an industry leader, employing cutting-edge technologies, management practices and strategic growth initiatives. Employee ownership fosters an entrepreneurial spirit, encourages technical expertise, and shapes strategic planning.

KCI is currently ranked #50 on Engineering News-Record’s list of the Top 500 design firms in the nation.

KCI BENEFITS INFORMATION

We offer a competitive compensation package, family friendly benefits, a collaborative working environment, and the training, mentoring and resources you need to advance in your career.

We understand that you have choices, and we know that together we will make a great team!

KCI is committed to building a diverse and inclusive staff, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply.

KCI Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Duties, Responsibilities & Other

As the Energy – Senior Project Engineer (Substation), you serve as a senior technical leader for the execution of complex transmission and distribution substation projects. The role may be filled by an engineer whose primary technical expertise is in Substation Physical and/or Protection & Control and/or Substation Studies and/or Settings/SCADA. Partnering with Project Managers, Design Leaders, clients, and multidisciplinary engineering teams, you lead technical planning, coordination, design, quality, and delivery from conceptual engineering through construction and commissioning support.

You are expected to bring senior-level depth in at least one technical specialty—not necessarily all four—while maintaining sufficient working knowledge to coordinate the other specialties into a complete substation solution. You are accountable for accurate, coordinated, constructible, and technically sound deliverables that meet KCI standards, client expectations, project schedules, budgets, and quality objectives. You provide technical direction to Engineers, Designers, and CAD Technicians; resolve complex engineering issues; strengthen standards and workflows; and develop future technical leaders across the substation practice.

Key Technical Skills Required:

  • Demonstrate senior-level technical expertise in Substation Physical and/or Protection & Control and/or Substation Studies and/or Settings/SCADA. Expertise across multiple specialties is preferred but is not required.
  • Substation Physical: Lead equipment selection and application, one-line development, general arrangements, equipment layouts, bus and conductor design, electrical clearances, grounding, lightning protection, raceways, cable routing, control building arrangements, auxiliary AC/DC systems, equipment specifications, bills of material, and physical design calculations.
  • Protection & Control: Lead development of protection philosophies, one-line and three-line diagrams, AC/DC schematics, relay and control panels, wiring and interconnection diagrams, CT/VT application, tripping and interlocking schemes, control logic, telecom and SCADA interfaces, cutover plans, testing requirements, and commissioning support.
  • Substation Studies: Lead power-system modeling and analysis applicable to the project, including load flow, short circuit, grounding, arc-flash, protection coordination, insulation coordination, temporary and switching overvoltage, transient recovery voltage, electromagnetic transient, dynamic stability, EMF, induced voltage, and other specialty studies.
  • Settings/SCADA: Lead protective relay settings and coordination, relay logic and configuration, RTU/IED/gateway integration, SCADA architecture, HMI and alarm configuration, point lists, I/O mapping, databases, communications networks and protocols, IEC 61850 integration, FAT/SAT, field testing, energization, and commissioning support.
  • Apply IEEE, ANSI, NESC, NEC, NFPA, utility standards, client specifications, and industry best practices to substation engineering.
  • Coordinate technical interfaces among Substation Physical, Protection & Control, Substation Studies, Settings/SCADA, Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, Transmission Line, Project Management, vendors, contractors, and clients.
  • Bring advanced technical judgment in constructability, brownfield execution, outage and cutover planning, system performance, field support, commissioning, quality assurance, and risk management.
  • Use engineering, design, modeling, settings, automation, and document-control tools applicable to the assigned technical specialty. Experience may include AutoCAD, MicroStation, Bluebeam, ProjectWise, ETAP, SKM, CDEGS, ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, PSS®E, PSCAD, PowerWorld, relay configuration software, SCADA platforms, and IEC 61850 engineering tools.

Project Engineering Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Serve as the senior technical leader for assigned substation projects while partnering with Project Managers to achieve successful project delivery.
  • Establish the engineering execution plan, design criteria, technical approach, deliverable requirements, review strategy, and multidisciplinary workflow.
  • Direct and coordinate the technical activities of Engineers, Designers, CAD Technicians, specialty disciplines, vendors, and subcontracted engineering resources assigned to the project.
  • Serve as the primary technical interface with clients, utilities, vendors, contractors, and internal project leadership.
  • Lead technical, design, constructability, client, vendor, and interdisciplinary review meetings.
  • Support proposal strategy, scope development, estimating, resource planning, technical approaches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Develop Project Engineers and other technical leaders through coaching, delegation, review, and progressively responsible project assignments.

Ownership and Accountability:

  • Take ownership of the overall technical execution of assigned projects from planning through final delivery and project closeout.
  • Maintain accountability for technical accuracy, completeness, interdisciplinary coordination, constructability, quality, and compliance with project requirements.
  • Identify and manage technical risks, design conflicts, scope gaps, schedule impacts, quality concerns, and constructability issues early.
  • Make and document sound engineering decisions while escalating material commercial, contractual, safety, or project risks appropriately.
  • Confirm that technical deliverables are reviewed, comments are resolved, and required approvals are completed before issuance.
  • Serve as Engineer of Record or responsible engineer when assigned and appropriately licensed for the project jurisdiction.

Training, Development, and Compliance:

  • Mentor Project Engineers, Engineers, Designers, and CAD Technicians through technical coaching, project guidance, and meaningful review feedback.
  • Support onboarding, technical development, succession planning, knowledge transfer, and professional licensure development.
  • Promote technical excellence, sound engineering judgment, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Lead or contribute to development of engineering standards, design guides, calculation tools, workflows, lessons learned, and quality practices.
  • Comply with KCI policies, ISO requirements, Quality Management Systems, client standards, professional practice requirements, and industry best practices.

Financial Management:

  • Partner with the Project Manager to develop and manage the engineering scope, budget, schedule, staffing plan, and delivery strategy.
  • Track engineering progress and resource performance against project requirements and communicate variances early.
  • Identify scope changes, additional services, schedule impacts, technical risks, and opportunities affecting project performance.
  • Support change management by defining technical impacts, required effort, assumptions, exclusions, and revised deliverable requirements.
  • Promote efficient project execution through proactive planning, appropriate delegation, standardization, constructability, and effective use of engineering and design resources.

Project Execution and Technical Oversight:

  • Lead multidisciplinary substation engineering from conceptual development and design criteria through Issued for Construction (IFC), construction, commissioning support, and record documentation.
  • Develop and review calculations, models, settings, databases, specifications, reports, drawings, equipment requirements, procurement documents, technical bid evaluations, testing documentation, and bills of material applicable to the assigned technical specialty.
  • Coordinate Substation Physical, Protection & Control, Substation Studies, Settings/SCADA, Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, Transmission Line, and other project interfaces.
  • Lead quality assurance, quality control, interdisciplinary, constructability, and client reviews appropriate to the complexity and risk of the project.
  • Coordinate technical requirements with equipment manufacturers and evaluate vendor drawings, data, exceptions, and proposed substitutions.
  • Support field investigations, construction, commissioning, Requests for Information (RFIs), design revisions, nonconformance resolution, and project closeout.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet KCI quality standards, client specifications, applicable codes, regulatory requirements, and professional engineering obligations.

* Essential Duties and Responsibilities are the basic job functions that an employee must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Qualifications

Education and/or Work Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field (AEC Industry) ABET-accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven experience in planning, organizing, estimating, scheduling and monitoring engineering projects.
  • Proven experience in project management roles, with a track record of successful project delivery.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to construction management, quality assurance, and safety protocols.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Education and/or Work Experience Preferred:

  • Master’s Degree

Certificates, licenses, and/or Registrations Required:

  • Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.)

Pre-employment drug screening and background check are conditions of employment. Motor vehicle checks may be required based upon position.

title: Security Manager
description:
KAIROS, Inc is searching for an energetic, experienced, and highly motivated Security Manager to join our team.

Established in July 2013, KAIROS, Inc. is a growing Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) specializing in Life Cycle Program Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Logistics and Sustainment, Enterprise Platforms and AI, and Additive Manufacturing services focused on optimizing customers’ program performance and mission through proven methodologies and ethical practices. Our headquarters is in California, MD, near Naval Air Station Patuxent River. We offer competitive salaries and benefits with outstanding growth potential.

The Security Manager will serve as KAIROS’ Facility Security Officer (FSO) responsible for administering and implementing the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and ensuring compliance with Government security requirements that support personnel, facilities, information, and classified operations. The Security Manager will support facility and personnel clearance processing and management, visit certifications, and security education and training.

Primary Duties:
  • Process personnel security actions including visit requests, clearance verification, indoctrinations, debriefings, and access authorizations.
  • Maintain classified document accountability, storage, destruction, reproduction, transmission, and inventory records.
  • Coordinate classified visits, visitor control procedures, and foreign visitor requests.

  • Work closely with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), Government security personnel, KAIROS leadership, Contracts, prime contractors, and Human Resources to administer personnel security, physical security, document control, visitor management, classified material accountability, and security education programs.
  • Perform self-inspections, security audits, and internal compliance assessments while identifying corrective actions.
  • Maintain security records, Standard Practice Procedures (SPPs), emergency action plans, and facility accreditation documentation.
  • Investigate and report security incidents, violations, and suspicious activities in accordance with Government reporting requirements.
  • Serve as Insider Threat Program Senior Official (ITPSO). Coordinate insider threat awareness and training activities.
  • Support subcontractor security coordination and ensure compliance with contractual security requirements.
  • Prepare for and support DCSA security reviews, audits, and inspections
  • Maintain accountability for COMSEC, controlled unclassified information (CUI), and classified materials, as applicable
  • Promote security best practices and continuous process improvement to protect personnel, facilities, and classified information.
Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong understanding of personnel security processes, including clearance processing, onboarding, and reinvestigations.
  • Ability to safeguard classified information and ensure compliance with security handling, storage, and transmission procedures.
  • Strong customer relations, analytics, and documentation skills
  • Self-starter, highly motivated, strong work ethic with a commitment to quality
  • Microsoft Office suite proficiency, i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Ability to work within a challenging, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work independently
  • Ability to multi-task and meet competing, deliverable deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to provide clear status and/or communicate issues
  • Ability to adapt to evolving technology
​Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, homeland security, business administration, information security, or a related field.
  • In lieu of a degree, additional years of experience as an FSO may be substituted
  • Seven (7) to ten (10) years of experience supporting industrial security, personnel security, physical security, or security administration for Government or Department of Defense programs.

  • Experience with the following: National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), DISS (Defense Information System for Security), National Background Investigation Services (NBIS), National Industrial Security System (NISS), e-QIP/eAPP, SWFT, and other Government security systems

Clearance:
This position is subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. In order to complete the requirements for a government security clearance investigation, you must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to complete the full background investigation. This position requires an Active Top Secret Security Clearance.

Compensation:
While skills, education, and experience are key factors, they are not the sole determinants of salary. Other determining factors include, but are not limited to location, contract budgets and requirements, and government labor category guidelines. The estimated salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00. KAIROS also provides a comprehensive benefits package as additional employee compensation.

KAIROS, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Collaborating closely with the Strategic Client Executive (SCE), the CSC helps clients achieve targeted outcomes while maximizing revenue and value for Zelis. What you’ll do:

  • Proactively identify and pursue opportunities to optimize client utilization and value realization, including cross-selling and enhancing existing solutions based on client needs.

  • Own and deliver the business unit’s portion of client business reviews by providing product insights, performance recommendations, and best practice guidance.

Strategic Account Planning and Collaboration

title: Project Engineer
description:
Sr. Project Engineer

Location: Piketon, OH, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Overview

Act as the owner's advocate in all project phases, from planning and design to construction and closeout. Responsible for technical and engineering support for area specific assignments. The role will include coordination of cross-organizational and cross-discipline inputs and outputs for the design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and turnover of installed systems, structures, and components for the deployment of an enrichment plant in Piketon Ohio. Responsible for coordinating with the EPC and other contractors and vendors and provide oversight and guidance. People in this position will become SMEs in specific systems, facilities, and technologies.

Responsible for conceptual and detailed design package development and reviews. Support construction work packages development, review, and approval steps to support field execution. Coordinate change management during execution phase including, but not limited to, constructability issues, risk mitigation actions, test plan identified corrections. Successful position candidates should implement safety first and program compliant approaches to successfully support the design, procurement, fabrication, testing, commissioning, and turnover for plant operation program elements for long-term plant operations.

Responsibilities

  • As directed by EPC management, this position will support and coordinate with Centrus staff, EPC supply chain manufacturers/vendors, EPC contractors, and Centrus augmented staff by direct involvement of specified areas for the construction of new facilities, modification of existing facilities. The efforts will include preparation of equipment specifications, conceptual and detailed certified-for-construction (CFC) designs to fabricate/construct, inspect, test, commission, and operate new plant infrastructure.
  • Periodic travel to various vendor locations is anticipated
  • Support generation of specific design criteria and system design requirements (SRDs)
  • Support identification and flow-down of configuration management criteria for identified component level systems, structures, components (SSC’s) as designated for items categorized as Items Relied on For Safety (IROFS)
  • Support development of acceptable fabrication, site acceptance testing (SAT), facility acceptance testing (FAT), and equipment installation specifications and testing aspects for specialized equipment following NQA-1 quality program as specified
  • Support development and implementation of Integrated System Test Plans (ISTPs) to demonstrate equipment meets design reliability and operational requirements
  • Establish preventive maintenance actions for the optimal service life of specialized equipment
  • Monitor project schedules, budgets, and progress, ensuring adherence to contractual requirements.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, conflicts, and potential delays.
  • Review and track project budgets, ensuring cost control and financial efficiency.
  • Evaluate contractor invoices, change orders, and financial reports for accuracy and compliance.
  • Support the development, review/comment, and approval cycles of engineering documentation including, but not limited to, system requirements documents (SRDs), engineering evaluations (EE), equivalency substitutions evaluation (ESE), design analysis and calculations (DAC)s, Change Evaluations (CE), Job Field Instructions (JFI), Post Maintenance Testing (PMT)s, Preventive Maintenance determinations, and design verification test plans (TP)s
  • Perform field walkdowns within industrial work areas before, during, and after construction activities including wearing of specified PPE i.e., steel toed shoes, hardhat, safety glasses, etc.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of science degree in engineering from an Accreditation Board of Engineering and Technology (ABET) accredited college or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. BS degrees in Architecture or Construction Management will also be considered.
  • 5-7 years’ engineering experience, preferably in a construction environment
  • Be able to obtain and maintain a “Q” level security clearance

Stronger Candidates Will Have:

  • Currently possess a “Q” level security clearance
  • Project management/engineer experience preferred.
  • Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and or Chemical engineering discipline preferred
  • Effective in multiple communication modes with various vendors, suppliers, and internal team members
  • Possess effective oral and written communication skills

The Opportunity

As a Data Scientist, you will position data science as a key competency within the enterprise and be responsible for creating value from data assets using advanced analytics capabilities including data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence methodologies to identify critical business risk and opportunities for Roche.

You will help Roche Diagnostics continue to progress through the data maturity model using data science methods and principles to generate deeper insights from a great variety of internal and external data sources. You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You have experience in the areas of analytics, data transformation, and data science. title: Senior Director, Solutions Architecture
company: Respage: Apartment AI Leasing Automation and Marketing
description:
Senior Director, Solutions Architecture (Institutional Client Solutions)

Location: Remote, TX, US

Employment Type: OTHER

Overview

Cherre is now a RealPage company, expanding our ability to deliver innovative data and technology solutions that transform the real estate industry. Join us as we build what’s next together.

Cherre is the leading real estate data management and analytics platform. We connect, resolve, and organize the fragmented data real estate organizations rely on: internal systems, public records, and third-party providers, into a single, connected source of truth. Institutional investors, asset managers, and brokers use Cherre to power underwriting, portfolio management, and reporting on data they can trust.

Our work sits at the intersection of real estate domain knowledge and modern data infrastructure, and this role is central to how we translate that platform into value for our most strategic clients.

Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Director of Solutions Architecture to lead the domain-first solutions engine of our sales and delivery motion. You'll own the presales function end to end, from first discovery call through handoff into delivery. You'll manage and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts, and you'll set the vision for how we scope, demonstrate, and win.

This role rests first on deep real assets domain expertise, complemented by technical acumen and a strong market-facing presence. You'll be credible discussing property operations and investment strategy with a client's leadership, guiding the solution alongside their data and engineering teams, and representing Cherre in front of a prospect's decision-makers. Domain fluency is the foundation; the ideal candidate pairs it with enough technical depth and executive presence to carry a solution from discovery through the deal.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic deals, shaping how we translate complex prospect requirements into compelling, credible solutions. Just as important, you'll be expected to modernize how the function operates. We want a leader who builds tools and AI-assisted workflows that make the team faster and sharper, not one who simply runs the existing playbook.

  • Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.
  • Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.
  • Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.
  • Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.
  • Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.
  • Ensure clean handoffs to Delivery. Build and maintain a repeatable bridge from presales scoping into implementation so nothing is lost between the sale and the build.
  • Modernize the function with AI. Design and build skills and agentic workflows, and optimize the agentic fleet to streamline the process from scoping through delivery. Continuously identify ways to use AI to improve the quality and speed of the team’s output.
  • Represent the point of view. Publish, speak, and advocate for Cherre’s perspective on real assets data and semantic infrastructure, shaping how the market thinks about the problem—not just how Cherre solves it.
  • Close the loop into Product. Translate market and client signals from the field into product roadmap input, ensuring the roadmap reflects what the market is actually telling you—not just what has already been scoped.

Qualifications

  • Real assets domain expertise spanning the full stack: up into the capital stack (fund structures, debt and equity vehicles, investment vehicles) and down into the physical, operational asset (property operations, leasing, maintenance, tenant and resident experience). A track record of scoping and designing solutions that hold together across both ends of that stack, not just one.
  • Global and cross-asset-class experience: comfortable moving between multifamily, office, industrial, retail, and alternative asset classes, and across US, European, and APAC market conventions and regulatory contexts.
  • 10+ years in real estate, proptech, or consulting, with experience leading teams of domain and technical experts.
  • Technical fluency across entity resolution, graph-based data models, and semantic layer architecture, sufficient to guide solution and demo design and engage credibly with a client's data and engineering teams on how identity, confidence, and lineage actually work under the platform, not just what the platform outputs.

title: Supply Chain Logistics Analyst
description:
Title:

Supply Chain Logistics Analyst

Job Summary

KBR is seeking a Supply Chain Logistics Analyst to support the Future Long Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA) Program in Huntsville, Alabama. This position provides Integrated Product Support (IPS) and supply chain logistics analysis across acquisition, sustainment, and lifecycle management activities supporting a critical Army aviation modernization effort. The selected candidate will work collaboratively with government and industry stakeholders to evaluate logistics data, assess supply chain risks, support acquisition documentation development, and strengthen product support strategies throughout the system lifecycle. The role requires detailed analysis of logistics operations, sustainment planning, and supply chain performance to ensure alignment with program objectives and statutory requirements. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to coordinate across multiple functional teams while supporting complex acquisition and sustainment initiatives.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Support all aspects of Integrated Product Support (IPS), including research, analysis, development, integration, and coordination of logistics data with stakeholders.
  • Support development and review of acquisition documentation such as Statements of Work (SOW), Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRL), Data Item Descriptions (DID), Work Breakdown Structures, Integrated Master Schedules, and lifecycle cost estimates.
  • Support milestone activities including documentation review and participation in design reviews.
  • Analyze and assess Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) to identify and mitigate risks related to sourcing, procurement, cybersecurity, manufacturing quality, and DMSMS.
  • Support analysis of logistics information across product support integrators and providers to optimize product support strategies.
  • Participate in Integrated Product Teams, including those focused on supply chain risk management.
  • Analyze logistics operations across FLRAA deployment environments to identify deficiencies and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assess product support arrangements to ensure alignment with FLRAA sustainment strategies.
  • Support development and maintenance of required logistics documentation including LCSP, Core Logistics Determination, Sustainment Workload Estimates, Independent Logistics Assessments, IUID Plans, and other statutory requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned in support of mission and business requirements.

Basic Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen with an active Secret Clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience supporting Integrated Product Support for Army and/or DoW acquisition programs.
  • In lieu of formal education, a High School Diploma and at least 16 years of progressive experience in a related field.
  • Familiarity with acquisition program processes, procedures, and IPS management.
  • Knowledge of acquisition and IPS regulations, policies, and standards.
  • Experience managing and executing complex logistics or acquisition projects.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office products.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of Supply Chain Risk Management, including cyber risk.
  • Experience with Aviation Acquisition Program Offices.

description:
Behind every success is a team of dedicated experts driving us forward. Our corporate functions don’t just support — they lead, shaping the company’s path and preparing clients and employees for the moments that matter. Be part of a team where your work makes a difference, with opportunities to grow, collaborate, and thrive.

Job Description

Técnico de Simuladores de Aviones

Acerca de CAE

En CAE, nuestra misión es hacer del mundo un lugar más seguro. Durante casi 80 años, hemos sido líderes en simulación, entrenamiento y preparación para misiones, brindando apoyo a la aviación civil, la defensa y las operaciones críticas en todo el mundo. Mediante tecnología de vanguardia y una cultura que impulsa la innovación, capacitamos a nuestros clientes para operar de manera más inteligente, rápida y sostenible.

Dotamos a las personas que desempeñan funciones críticas con los conocimientos y soluciones necesarias para crear un mundo más seguro. Por encima de todo, capacitamos a pilotos, tripulaciones de cabina, aerolíneas, fuerzas de defensa y seguridad para que rindan al máximo cada día y cuando más importa.

Estamos presentes en todo el mundo con más de 13,000 empleados aproximadamente, 250 centros de formación en más de 40 países.

El Puesto que Ofrecemos

CAE busca un Técnico de Simulador I motivado y con ganas de aprender para unirse a nuestro equipo en Santiago, Chile.

Como Técnico de Simulador I, ayudarás a garantizar el funcionamiento seguro, confiable y eficiente de los dispositivos avanzados de entrenamiento de vuelo de CAE. Este puesto de nivel inicial ofrece capacitación técnica estructurada, experiencia práctica en simuladores y una trayectoria hacia una carrera especializada en tecnología de simulación.

Trabajarás en las áreas de simulación, brindando apoyo en mantenimiento, resolución de problemas y preparación operativa junto con un equipo dedicado de Servicios Técnicos.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Come help us create innovative capabilities for Amazon's Associates, managers, and leaders to support the evolution of People eXperience and Technology (PXT). The Workforce Solutions (WS) team builds and delivers world-class products for Amazon's employees — we believe happy Amazon customers start with happy Amazon employees! We give associates around the globe the flexibility to enrich their job experience. As a member of this team, you are changing people's lives by building the tools that help them advance in their careers.

Behind these products sits a genuinely interesting engineering challenge: we build distributed, event-driven microservices on native AWS (Java, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, ECS Fargate, ElastiCache, infrastructure as code with CDK) that serves over one million employees across multiple countries in real time. Our systems must encode country-specific rules and regulations into a single scalable platform, process large volumes of operational data through orchestrated workflow pipelines, and hold a high bar for availability and data correctness — because our outputs directly affect employees' pay and careers. We are also actively modernizing: re-architecting established systems onto a next-generation microservices platform, with safe, validated migrations — so you'll get both greenfield design work and the satisfaction of retiring legacy.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate highly available, distributed services on native AWS that serve employees globally in real time
- Build event-driven data pipelines and orchestrated workflows that scale in volume and handle the complexity of diverse, country-specific rules and regulations
- Drive the modernization of existing systems onto a new microservice architecture, proving correctness before cutover
- Own automation of business processes end to end in a full-stack environment using proven and evolving AWS services
- Solve complex business and technical problems by diving deep, collecting data, and using sound judgement in the face of insufficient data
- Be a technical innovator: challenge the norms, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, develop, and test Amazon-scale enterprise systems serving over a million employees worldwide, continuously learning new technologies and using the newest AWS tools — including AI-assisted development, where we build our own AI agents for operational automation. We run a sustainable, shared on-call rotation and we invest in automation to keep it quiet. We take work-life balance seriously.

The hiring manager and the whole team are co-located in Dublin, giving you real in-person collaboration and mentorship.

About the team
Workforce Solutions (WS) is a global, multi-discipline organization whose mission is to build people-forward technology for Amazon's workforce. Our portfolio is global and built mostly on native AWS — from employee-facing experiences down to the distributed backend services and data pipelines that power them. We value people-centric solutions and the open exchange of ideas: the team has a clear product north star, but remains flexible in the paths to achieve it.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.

Role Summary
We are seeking a Principal Data Engineer, ML/AI Platform to lead the design, development, and governance of scalable data solutions that power machine learning, AI, and GenAI use cases on our GCP Cloud Data Platform. This role will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for building robust data foundations for analytics, data science, and production ML systems.

The ideal candidate combines deep cloud data engineering expertise with practical experience supporting teams of Data Scientists and ML Engineers. They understand how to design reliable, high-quality, cost-efficient data pipelines and data products that enable model training, batch and online inference, feature generation, experimentation, and monitoring in cloud-native environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Architect and Lead ML-Ready Data Solutions
• Design end-to-end data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, GCS, Dataproc, Composer, Dataform, Data Fusion, and related cloud-native tooling.
• Build and standardize scalable batch and near-real-time data pipelines that support:
o model training datasets
o feature engineering workflows
o batch and online inference use cases
o analytics and operational reporting
• Define reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, quality validation, metadata capture, lineage, and observability.
• Design data models optimized not only for BI/reporting, but also for machine learning, AI, and GenAI workloads, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
• Establish patterns for CDC, ELT, distributed processing, and data product design in support of modern cloud platforms.
Partner Closely with Data Science and ML Engineering
• Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Architects, Platform Engineers, and Product Owners to translate business and model requirements into scalable data solutions.
• Enable ML teams by delivering trusted, discoverable, and reproducible datasets for experimentation and production.
• Support feature generation and data preparation workflows used in model development and operationalization.
• Partner with ML engineering teams on data interfaces for tools such as Vertex AI, feature stores, model monitoring, and inference pipelines.
• Contribute to data patterns that support AI/GenAI use cases such as prompt pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector-ready data preparation, and document/content processing where applicable.
Strategic Data Engineering Leadership
• Drive architecture direction for a GCP-first data platform serving analytics and AI/ML workloads.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend best-fit solutions to improve scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
• Lead modernization efforts to refactor legacy ETL into cloud-optimized, maintainable ELT and ML-ready data pipelines.
• Define best practices for data quality, lineage, governance, security, and lifecycle management across enterprise data assets used for analytics and ML.
Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence
• Act as a technical mentor and reviewer for senior and mid-level data engineers.
• Lead large cross-functional initiatives and serve as the escalation point for complex data platform and production pipeline issues.
• Set coding, testing, and deployment standards using GitHub and CI/CD practices.
• Promote strong software engineering discipline across the data engineering function, including code quality, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
Operational Excellence
• Ensure reliability, scalability, observability, and governance across production data environments.
• Define and monitor SLAs/SLOs for critical data pipelines and data products.
• Create technical documentation, reusable frameworks, and metadata standards that improve enterprise data maturity.
• Partner with stakeholders to align data platform capabilities with business outcomes and ML/AI roadmap priorities.
Qualifications
Experience
• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data warehousing, including significant experience with cloud-native architectures.
• Proven track record designing and implementing large-scale data pipelines and data platforms on GCP.
• Demonstrated experience working closely with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to support production ML/AI solutions.
• Hands-on experience delivering data pipelines for model training, feature engineering, inference, or ML monitoring workflows.
• Experience modernizing legacy data solutions into scalable cloud-native architectures.
Technical Proficiency
• Strong hands-on expertise with Python, SQL, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks.
• Deep experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, GCS, Dataproc, Composer, Dataform, and Data Fusion.
• Strong understanding of BigQuery-centric design, optimization, and cost management.
• Solid understanding of data architecture patterns including ELT, CDC, data products, lakehouse concepts, and domain-oriented architectures.
• Practical familiarity with ML/AI platform concepts such as:
o Vertex AI
o feature stores
o experiment reproducibility
o model data lineage
o batch and online inference data flows
o MLOps/DataOps practices
• Experience supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data for AI/ML use cases.
Leadership and Collaboration
• Demonstrated success influencing architecture and engineering standards across multiple teams.
• Strong mentoring and technical leadership skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across engineering, analytics, and data science teams.
Preferred
• Experience supporting ML, AI, or GenAI solutions in production.
• Familiarity with Vertex AI, Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud-native orchestration patterns.
• Experience with data observability, governance, and quality frameworks at scale.
• Experience with feature engineering platforms, vector-ready pipelines, or RAG/data preparation workflows.
• Experience integrating enterprise SaaS and operational data sources such as Salesforce, D365, Qualtrics, Pendo, or similar.
• Google Cloud certification such as Professional Data Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or Professional Machine Learning Engineer.

Company Overview:

company: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Rhode Island
description:
