$116,900.00 - $187,100.00

Please email HR_Talent_AcquisitionTeam@bcbsri.org if you are a candidate seeking a reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.


We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.
It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.


Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Working closely with product owners, scrum masters, developers, QA, business analysts, configuration admins, integration, security, and data teams, this role directs the technical execution of a Salesforce delivery pod supporting Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams. Serves as a technical resource responsible for organizing and guiding all technical aspects of day-to-day support and project delivery, translating business priorities into implementable Salesforce solutions, enforcing platform standards, coordinating technical work across disciplines, and ensuring high-quality delivery through agile/scrum practices, disciplined release execution, and strong technical documentation.

Platform scope: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud where applicable, Data Cloud integrations, Salesforce platform configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, and connected enterprise systems.

What you will do:

  • Lead and coordinate all technical aspects of a Salesforce pod that includes developers, QA, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring technical work is organized, sequenced, estimated, reviewed, and delivered consistently across agile/scrum ceremonies and release cycles.
  • Provide senior hands-on technical leadership for Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams, including day-to-day operational work, enhancements, production support, and project-based delivery.
  • Translate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into scalable Salesforce technical designs and implementation plans that align with platform standards, architecture direction, security expectations, and agile delivery commitments.
  • Guide developers and configuration admins on solution approach, design tradeoffs, platform-native patterns, reuse opportunities, and technical debt management while maintaining accountability for technical quality across the pod.
  • Review and direct configuration, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, SOQL, REST/SOAP API, Visualforce where applicable, and Salesforce integration work to ensure solutions are secure, maintainable, performant, and governor-limit aware.
  • Partner with product owners, scrum masters, and analysts to refine backlog items, define technical tasks, identify dependencies, manage technical risks, and ensure readiness for sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, and support handoff.
  • Lead technical design reviews and participate in architecture, security, integration, and platform governance forums when required, ensuring designs obtain appropriate approvals and exceptions are documented.
  • Coordinate with QA to define test strategy, support automated and manual testing, validate acceptance criteria, ensure adequate unit test coverage, and resolve defects across configuration, custom code, integrations, data, and user experience components.
  • Support CI/CD and release management activities, including source control discipline, branching, build validation, deployment planning, release readiness, change control, rollback planning, and post-deployment verification.
  • Identify, communicate, and manage technical risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments across the pod, escalating when needed and recommending practical mitigation options.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting for production issues, platform events, integration failures, data integrity concerns, governor limit issues, access/security issues, and performance problems in collaboration with support and platform teams.
  • Ensure Salesforce security controls are implemented appropriately, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, field-level security, object permissions, secure integration patterns, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Support data migration, data quality, data mapping, and data lifecycle activities, including ETL coordination, validation, reconciliation, and remediation for complex Salesforce initiatives.
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation, including design notes, diagrams, runbooks, deployment notes, code review outcomes, environment considerations, and operational support procedures.
  • Coach and mentor Salesforce developers, admins, and analysts on platform best practices, code and configuration standards, agile execution, estimation, documentation, testing discipline, and release quality.
  • Continuously assess Salesforce platform capabilities, seasonal releases, AppExchange products, and ecosystem tooling to recommend improvements that increase reliability, maintainability, user value, and delivery velocity.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Data Science, Computer Science, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Seven to ten years of Salesforce platform experience with strong hands-on development and configuration experience, including experience serving as a senior developer, technical lead, or comparable senior technical role on enterprise Salesforce delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical execution for agile/scrum teams or pods supporting a mix of project delivery, enhancements, configuration, QA, and operational support work.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Flow, APIs, security configuration, declarative automation, and platform configuration patterns.
  • Ability to direct technical work across developers, QA, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring clear work breakdown, sequencing, estimation, dependency management, sprint readiness, and delivery accountability.
  • Strong understanding of agile/scrum delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, definition of ready, definition of done, and technical task management.
  • Experience supporting Sales Cloud and Service Cloud capabilities, including case management, account/contact models, sales/service processes, queues, routing, activities, automation, reports, dashboards, and role-based access models.
  • Experience with Salesforce configuration and administration practices, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, page layouts, Lightning record pages, validation rules, flows, approvals, objects, fields, and metadata management.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security and sharing, including least-privilege design, field-level security, object permissions, sharing models, auditability, and privacy-aware configuration.
  • Understanding of integration patterns and technologies relevant to Salesforce, including REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, platform events, middleware, batch integrations, and secure error handling and monitoring practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps and SDLC practices, including source control, CI/CD, deployment pipelines, packaging or metadata deployment approaches, branching strategies, automated testing, and release governance.
  • Ability to review code, configuration, technical designs, test plans, and deployment plans to ensure quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, performance tuning, bulkification, asynchronous processing, large data volume considerations, selective querying, data archiving, and high-volume transaction patterns.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce production issues, including integration failures, automation errors, data quality issues, security access problems, platform events, governor limits, and user experience defects.
  • Ability to identify and manage technical risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments, communicate impacts clearly, and drive timely resolution across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to produce and maintain clear technical documentation, diagrams, design notes, deployment notes, operational runbooks, and support handoff materials.
  • Ability to mentor and coach technical team members, promote standards adoption, support technical skill development, and foster consistent delivery practices across the pod.
  • Ability to partner effectively with product owners, business stakeholders, scrum masters, analysts, architects, security, integration, data, QA, release management, and operations teams.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce seasonal releases, AppExchange products, platform roadmap considerations, and the ability to evaluate new capabilities for business value, risk, and operational maturity.
  • Experience designing and supporting Salesforce solutions in regulated environments with awareness of privacy, auditability, data protection, retention, encryption where applicable, and secure integration practices.
  • Proficient communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and delivery impacts clearly.
  • Comfortable working in agile/scrum delivery models and able to operate within waterfall, hybrid, or governance-driven processes when required.

The extras:

  • Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, or Sharing and Visibility Architect.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another environment with strong privacy, auditability, and data protection requirements.
  • Experience with Financial Services Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce/Einstein capabilities, OmniStudio, or other Salesforce cloud capabilities relevant to customer/member-facing and internal service workflows.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems and middleware such as MuleSoft, Informatica Cloud, APIs, event-driven patterns, contact center platforms, document management platforms, identity platforms, ServiceNow, or core business systems.
  • Experience leading or coordinating complex data migration, ETL, data quality, and reconciliation efforts.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model or with blended internal, vendor, and offshore development teams.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

description:

Leadership technique :

Apporter une expertise approfondie dans le domaine des données pour concevoir et construire des pipelines de données évolutifs et piloter des initiatives de business intelligence, contribuant ainsi à la croissance et à l'optimisation de notre plateforme de données moderne.

• Assurer la responsabilité des décisions techniques de l'équipe et appliquer les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie (documentation, automatisation, gestion du code, principes de sécurité, utilisation de CoPilot).

• Maîtriser les pipelines CI/CD, de la construction au déploiement, en passant par les tests.

Réaliser des évaluations de performance régulières, fournir du feedback et accompagner le développement professionnel. • Favoriser une culture de responsabilité des services et renforcer l'engagement de l'équipe.

• Collaborer avec les équipes transversales, notamment la gestion de produits, la conception et les opérations, afin de garantir l'alignement et la réussite des projets. Communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux.

• Prendre des décisions de déploiement en tenant compte des risques.

Qualifications requises :

The Program Coordinator will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of the GREAT program activities and provide support to the principal investigators (PIs) who oversee the overall operation of the GREAT program. The GREAT Program Coordinator I will play a major role in the recruitment, retention, and support of participants. The coordinator will conduct clerical and administrative duties, maintain the GREAT website and newsletter, and assist with conference attendance. The program coordinator will assist with the execution of the internal evaluation process.

This position is funded by a grant or restricted funds. Continued employment is contingent on the renewal of grant or restricted funding.

Responsibilities:

Program Administration and Operations

  • Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the GREAT program in support of program objectives.
  • Support Principal Investigators (PIs) with implementation of program activities and training initiatives.
  • Maintain program records, participant documentation, calendars, and operational timelines.
  • Schedule meetings, workshops, seminars, and training events.
  • Prepare agendas, meeting minutes, reports, and correspondence.
  • Monitor participant compliance with program requirements and established deadlines.


Recruitment, Retention, and Participant Support

  • Assist with recruitment of undergraduate scholars from targeted student populations.
  • Coordinate application, selection, onboarding, and orientation processes.
  • Track scholar participation and progress throughout the program.
  • Provide guidance regarding program expectations, professional development activities, and required documentation.

title: Risk Mitigation Specialist
description:
Amentum is seeking highly motivated, self-starting Risk Mitigation Specialist/Officer. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Ability to maintain a Top Secret-SCI clearance.

Responsibilities:

Prepare, implement, and oversee routine to moderately complex RMSs addressing risk indicators, ensuring each meet prescribed quality standards and contain the appropriate focus, depth, and breadth of information based on the individual task circumstances RMSs should clearly convey the treatment(s) chosen for each risk indicator, a rationale for each treatment, and any residual risk remaining requiring action by an outside party. Ensure RMSs adhere to applicable internal style guides prior to internal and external dissemination. Actively manage and oversee a portfolio of companies operating under mitigation. Provide technical direction and feedback to Government and Contractor staff, other internal parties, and external parties related to business and security risks, specific mitigation measures available, unmitigated residual risks, and related processes and procedures. Provide coaching, training, and mentoring to less experienced RMOs.

Conduct peer reviews of RMSs drafted by less experienced RMOs as directed. Identify areas for improvement, determine the appropriate course of action addressing the areas for leadership’s consideration, and implement solutions areas for improvement may include workflow enhancements, product format revisions, additional training needs, and updates to internal guidance. Conduct workload management tasks by providing reasonable and appropriate suspense dates based on documented case prioritization related to timing, monitoring completion status, ensuring suspense dates are met, and realigning work, as needed, and if required. Manage competing priorities in those circumstances where current staff is not available to meet customer requirements. Actively monitor individual metrics against established key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare the timely dissemination of individual and team performance metrics to supervisors on a recurring basis as requested. Respond to requests for information from internal and external Government customers. Participate in and brief at conferences and meetings with internal and external customers on matters related to the risk management mission

  • Contractor must review and process NISP, DESP, or Section 847 risk management actions in accordance with established DoD instructions and DCSA guidance.

  • Conduct workload management tasks and written products by providing reasonable and appropriate suspense dates based on established key performance indicators, documented case prioritization related to timing, monitoring completion status, ensuring suspense dates are met, quality requirements, and realigning work.

  • Must conduct reviews of DCSA all-source products, as well as review open-source research, company submitted materials, and Government databases, aimed at U.S. and foreign companies and affiliated parties (key management personnel, suppliers, partners, creditors, owners, investors, and other U.S. and foreign affiliations) while producing a Risk Management Strategy (RMS) and Source Packages (SPs).

    • Applying data analysis, trend analysis and problem-solving techniques. Contractor must be knowledgeable of data manipulation within databases and Microsoft software packages.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Storage is experiencing incredible innovations right now. The innovations of storage technologies and cloud connected devices are having a profound effect on every area of Microsoft’s business. Storage devices are getting larger in capacity, faster in performance and intelligence at an astounding rate; our customers are expecting seamless experiences across devices and across local and cloud boundaries. Come and join the team that builds the platform and end user experiences for storage across Windows devices and the Cloud.

We deliver storage solution for Windows, Azure, IoT and new devices that Microsoft and our industry partners ship in the future. This area involves tough challenges and provides tremendous upside opportunities including leveraging the reduced size, portability and increased functionality of new storage devices, improved software platform infrastructure, emerging protocol standards, seamless integration of local and cloud storage and development of solutions to new content usage paradigms.

In Core OS (Operating System), we are responsible for the Operating Systems that power Azure, Microsoft's Linux Operating System (OS), the platforms for Windows Client and Xbox, and our Windows Server ecosystem – through all of these, we support every one of our cloud businesses and billions of customers around the world. In this era of ubiquitous computing, systems software excellence has never been more important for Microsoft. High quality, high-efficiency operating systems and platform components underpin everything we do as a company, from making our systems more reliable for our customers, to increasing our competitiveness by reducing Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), to delivering new features and capabilities to delight customers – that’s all us!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining storage and file system virtualization components across client, server, and cloud systems, on both Windows and Linux operating systems. You will conceive, design, and implement storage virtualization features in tandem with partners inside and outside of Microsoft to address the business needs of our customers.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Performance analysis of designs and implementations, taking into consideration the rapid advancements in storage technologies.
  • Ownership of the software engineering process from design, development, code review, validation, delivery, and maintenance.
  • Working as a team member, authoring documentation and tools that improve the team’s ability to develop and maintain software, participating in design discussions and code review outside of your immediate scope, and assisting less experienced team members in their personal growth.
  • Building an understanding of the wider storage ecosystem and bringing that understanding to the table as new features are considered.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative team culture.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR master’s degree in computer science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience with storage in Kubernetes.
  • Experience in analyzing storage performance and functionality in storage subsystems.
  • Familiarity with current and emerging storage technologies.
  • Familiarity with storage virtualization concepts like Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID), caching, tiering and thin provisioning.
  • Experience in operating systems (Linux or Windows) is a plus, as is general storage stack development experience.
  • Experience with filesystems, Databases, KV (Key Value) stores e.g. Rocks DB (Database), Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation and Durability (ACID) transactions is a big plus.
  • 3+ years of experience with kernel and device driver development in Linux or Windows.
  • Solid communication and collaboration skills.
  • Solid understanding of systems software.
  • Solid coding, debugging, testing, and problem-solving skills.
  • A track record of solid results across multiple ship cycles.
  • Experience in Block Storage and Filesystem.
  • Thorough understanding of modern computer architectures found in desktop PCs and servers, including computer networking.
  • 7+ years of industry experience with C/C++.
  • 4+ years of experience with systems programming in Linux or Windows.

title: Instructional Designer II
description:
Job Title

Instructional Designer II

Agency

Texas A&M University

Department

Teaching and Learning Innovation

$5,250.00 monthly

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

A Glimpse of the Job

Mays Business School is seeking a collaborative and team-oriented Instructional Designer II to assist with designing and developing innovative and high-quality online, hybrid, and face-to-face learning content. This position will work closely with faculty, subject matter experts, and the Mays Business School staff to develop digitally enhanced courses that promote student engagement and interactivity with course content, peers, and instructors across Mays Business School. Through the learning design process, the Instructional Designer will partner with faculty to create high-quality learning experiences and materials that align with program objectives. This role will also research and evaluate emerging instructional design innovations while developing faculty resources and training materials to support the design process. If you are a relationship-driven professional with an eye for course design and a passion for project management, we encourage you to apply!

What You Need to Know

Salary: $63,000 - $70,000/annually (Compensation will be commensurate to the selected hire’s experience).

Cover Letter/Resume: A cover letter and resume will assist us in our review of your application materials. These can be uploaded on the application under CV/Resume.

Other Requirements and Factors: Evening or weekend work may be required.

Opportunities to Contribute

  • Instructional Design - Independently meets with faculty and subject matter experts to design and develop innovative, high-quality online, hybrid, and face-to-face learning content that promotes student engagement with course materials, the instructor, and peers. Facilitates the learning design process by developing learning objectives that align with course materials and assignments. Creates and curates learning content that is accessible, engaging, and promotes active learning. Designs activities that promote interactivity with the content, between students, and between students and instructors. Builds learning content in the TAMU Canvas environment. Collaborates with faculty to locate and evaluate learning materials, to include open educational resources (OER) and third-party media. Provides training and resources on the topics of copyright and fair use. Works with subject matter experts (SMEs) on the planning of media assets, to include video, audio, graphics, and other appropriate media. Remains abreast of emerging trends in online instruction, pedagogy, and tools particularly those related to copyright issues, accessibility, and the use of open educational resources.

  • Quality Assurance - Evaluates the quality of courses using a course quality rubric established as a standard by Mays Business School.

  • Project Management - Monitors progress, anticipates and troubleshoots roadblocks, recalibrates deliverables and timelines, and communicates frequently with the director about the progress of all assigned projects. Builds collaborative relationships with faculty, staff, and other stakeholders through face-to-face, digital, and remote communication channels. Manages communications and utilizes excellent time management skills to complete projects. Uses project management system to document project progress. Maintains documentation for each project. Reports on learning design project progress. Manages and maintains digital asset library for graphic design projects.

  • Faculty Development - Develops guides, resources, and training materials to support faculty with the learning design process and research-based best practices in teaching and learning across teaching modalities, and the digital learning environment. Provides training to faculty on the LMS and other tools associated with the digital learning environments (e.g., instructional technologies, Zoom and other third-party tools).

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in applicable field such as curriculum and instruction, instructional design, instructional technology, training and development or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Two years of experience in instructional design or related experience in K-12 education, higher education, adult learning and literacy, or training and development.

A Well-Qualified Candidate Will Also Possess:

  • MS, MA, or PhD degree in education, online learning, instructional design, instructional technology, curriculum & instruction, UX/UI design, or a related field.

  • More than two years of experience in instructional design or related experience in K-12 education, higher education, adult learning & literacy, or training and development.

  • Experience curating, researching, writing, proofreading, and editing instructional materials.

  • Experience designing, developing, and implementing innovative, engaging, and accessible online, hybrid, and face-to-face learning content;

  • Experience interacting with faculty and students to provide support.

  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to apply instructional design theories, principles, best practices, and current trends in teaching and learning to the design and development of innovative, high-quality online, hybrid, and face-to-face learning content. Knowledge of quality design standards such as Quality Matters, OLC Scorecard, or similar rubrics.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects and work collaboratively and professionally with others.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain positive interpersonal relationships, collaborate within and across teams, and with faculty and subject matter experts.

  • Expert knowledge of quality course design and associated rubrics.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in managing complex workflows and applying project management best practices.

  • Experience leading staff development of other instructional designers.

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and demonstrated performance in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency in Canvas and contemporary learning technologies, and in the use of basic programming relating to online learning (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc.).

  • Knowledge of project management best practices and tools such as Wrike or related.

  • Educational technology tools leveraging AI.

Who We Are

Texas A&M University’s Mays Business School is a vibrant learning organization of more than 175 faculty members, 125 staff members, and 6,400 undergraduate and graduate students in accounting, finance, management, management information systems, marketing, and supply chain management. Mays Business School’s vision is to advance the world’s prosperity. To advance the world’s prosperity means providing a better future for generations who follow, including quality of life, environment, and economic systems. To fulfill this vision, our mission is to be a vibrant learning organization that creates impactful knowledge and develops transformational leaders.

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration. Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you. Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.

  • Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums

  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays

  • Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month

  • Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas

  • Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time

  • Professional Development: All employees have access to free LinkedIn Learning training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more

  • Educational release time and tuition assistance for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee

  • Living Well, a program at Texas A&M that has been built by employees, for employees

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experience. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.

Job Overview

The Marketplace Ecommerce Specialist will support the growth of Bloomingdale’s Marketplace business through three primary areas of focus: Live-to-Site Operations, Site Merchandising, and Offshore Team Management.

This role will drive operational excellence across product onboarding, PDP quality, and live-to-site execution for a diverse portfolio of both luxury and non-luxury Marketplace partners. This individual will serve as a key operational partner across Marketplace Strategy, Site Merchandising, Marketing, and external vendors to ensure products launch efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with Bloomingdale’s digital standards and customer experience expectations.

A critical component of this role is leading and managing an offshore catalog data validation team of approximately 20 associates. This individual will be responsible for prioritizing workflows, maintaining quality standards, improving operational processes, and driving consistency across a rapidly growing Marketplace assortment.

Success in this role will be measured by speed-to-site, PDP quality and completeness, catalog accuracy, operational efficiency, and overall site integrity.

This position reports to the Director, Marketplace Strategy.

Essential Functions

You will serve as a key operational partner responsible for driving efficient live-to-site execution, maintaining PDP quality standards, and supporting the overall digital customer experience across Bloomingdale’s Marketplace business.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Marketplace Operations & Live-to-Site

  • Manage and support the end-to-end live-to-site process for Marketplace products, ensuring timely and accurate product launches

  • Partner cross-functionally with site merchandising, marketing, and vendors to facilitate approvals and launch readiness
  • Track products tied to key marketing campaigns and exposures to ensure product availability and site readiness

PDP Quality & Site Experience

  • Maintain and update internal and vendor-facing PDP guidelines, SOPs, and process documentation

Offshore Team Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Lead, coach, and prioritize workstreams for an offshore catalog data validation team of approximately 20 associates
  • Ensure high-quality execution through workflow management, quality assurance processes, and ongoing training
  • Identify operational gaps and drive process improvement initiatives to support Marketplace scalability and efficiency
  • Establish best practices and documentation standards to improve consistency across Marketplace operations

Competencies

  • 3+ years of related experience
  • Strong understanding of Bloomingdale’s PDP requirements, catalog operations, and live-to-site processes
  • Experience leading or managing teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal teams and external vendor partners
  • Ability to professionally represent the Bloomingdale’s brand in interactions with both luxury and non-luxury Marketplace partners
  • Customer-centric mindset with strong attention to detail and a passion for enhancing the digital customer experience
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and execute with urgency in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving operational improvements
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, troubleshoot workflows, and implement scalable solutions
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Advanced computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
  • Maintains confidentiality and security of sensitive company information
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule based on department and Company needs

Essential Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting, with occasional standing and walking
  • Ability to bend, reach, hear, and communicate as needed
  • Continuous use of computers and standard office equipment
  • Ability to lift and move up to 25 lbs. as required

title: Growth Associate
description:
About Kernel

Agents are becoming part of how companies sell, buy and operate. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it needs to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and half-correct enrichment. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a shared identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We create a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it.

Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

The Growth team’s purpose is simple - make Kernel grow faster. To date, most of Kernel’s customers have been sourced via cold sales outbound. What we need is for someone to add fuel to the fire by creating a world-class brand that excites prospects and customers alike.

One week you may organise a New York dinner for the most senior people in our target audience, the next you could fly to San Francisco to film a case study that is circulated to thousands. The potential is limitless, and you will have agency to run considered experiments that lead to results.

As the second person in Kernel’s growth team, you will play a crucial role in ensuring we continue and accelerate our success.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build and own a brilliant events schedule. We know that in-person events work for Kernel. This includes premium in-person dinners, lunches, conferences, and events we have not yet considered

  • Own the public profiles of the Kernel leadership team, especially on LinkedIn

  • Design and implement marketing channels that deliver results

  • Create content for Kernel, both non-technical and technical, reaching an audience of 10s of thousands

  • Work directly with the CEO and Head of Sales on creative approaches to help Kernel win key deals

  • Contribute to product launches, customer announcements, and case studies

  • Come up with your own ideas for how Kernel can grow faster, scope them, implement them, and ensure they’re successful

What You Bring:

  • We don’t need you to have had direct marketing or growth experience, what we do require is the following:

    • Exceptional taste

    • The ability to write exceptionally well without AI

    • Strong analytical skills, with a preference to judge results by numbers

    • Ruthless prioritisation

    • 2-5 years’ work experience

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer slow-paced, highly structured environments

  • Need rigid process instead of figuring things out on the fly

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Like working on one project at a time

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly-remote setup. We're in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you the ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £60,000 – £80,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process (1-2 weeks)

  • Stage 1 – Video call with Zak (Hiring Manager)

  • Stage 2 – Case study interview (in person) with Zak

  • Stage 3 – Values interview with Founders, Anders and Marcus. On the same day, coffee chat with the Head of Sales and one other Kernel team member

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

title: B Lineman - Overhead (Oncor)
description:
Position Summary

The Class B Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines while using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent overhead line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Cyber Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
Who are we?


At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

What Will You Contribute?

As a Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a critical role in protecting Finastra's global technology environment by monitoring, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats and incidents. Working within the Cyber Security Operations team, you will leverage advanced security technologies, threat intelligence, and analytical expertise to identify and mitigate risks across cloud and on-premises environments. This role is ideal for a cybersecurity professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment, enjoys solving complex security challenges, and is passionate about continuous learning. You will support North American operations, collaborate with global teams, and contribute to strengthening Finastra's overall security posture. The Finastra Role Catalogue identifies Security Operations professionals as responsible for identifying cybersecurity vulnerabilities, providing situational threat awareness, and managing overall security posture.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts, events, and incidents across enterprise environments using security monitoring and detection tools.

  • Perform threat analysis and triage activities to determine the validity, impact, scope, and remediation requirements of potential security threats.

  • Support incident response activities, including containment, escalation, tracking, resolution, and post-incident documentation.

  • Utilize SIEM platforms, threat detection technologies, and security monitoring tools to proactively identify suspicious activity and security anomalies.

  • Assist in the administration, configuration, and optimization of security tools across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external security partners to investigate threats and improve security monitoring capabilities.

  • Contribute to process improvements, automation opportunities, knowledge documentation, and operational playbooks to enhance SOC effectiveness.

  • Participate in an on-call and rotational shift schedule to support continuous security monitoring and operational coverage.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience working within a Security Operations Center (SOC), Network Operations Center (NOC), security monitoring, or threat management environment.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or similar security monitoring platforms.

  • Strong understanding of security alerts, threat detection methodologies, incident response processes, and escalation management.

  • Knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, SMTP, operating systems, and common cybersecurity attack techniques.

  • Experience investigating security events across cloud and on-premises environments using security tools, logs, and threat intelligence data.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Cybersecurity certifications such as GSEC, GCIA, GMON, GCDA, CISSP, or similar credentials are preferred. Experience within financial services, fintech, and security automation is considered an asset.

Location: This is a hybrid role with 2 days per week in office requirement (Mississauga, Ontario, Canada). Rotational shift coverage supporting North America. Standard shifts include 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST and 1:00 PM - 9:00 PM EST on a rotating basis.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Lead Data Scientist

Location: Hanover, MD, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Overview

Job Summary:

Allegis Group is the global leader in talent solutions, delivering staffing services to our customers through our operating companies, including Aerotek, TEKsystems, and Aston Carter. The IT department at Allegis is leading us through a digital transformation where we are seamlessly incorporating technology into our work to enhance who we are – a company committed to creating opportunity for those around us and for those who will come after us.

We are seeking a Lead Data Scientist to join the Connected Growth & Insights team — a metrics-focused practice within Connected Shared Services. This team serves as the "engine of insight" for the Connected program, connecting every data point to a strategic outcome and functioning as the Metrics Support System for every team in Connected.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and visualization skills with emerging AI/ML capabilities to surface the value of the Salesforce ecosystem of products and linked applications. This person will own metric definition, dashboard delivery, and stakeholder storytelling across multiple OpCos and transformation stages — while also advancing our Cortex AI agent initiative to make Snowflake data and insights more accessible through self-service tooling.

Are you up for the challenge?

Top Skills:

  • Expertise with SQL for complex querying against cloud data platforms (Snowflake preferred)
  • Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools, especially Tableau
  • Experience defining, measuring, and communicating business metrics and KPIs to executive stakeholders
  • Familiarity with AI/ML techniques including text-to-SQL, semantic modeling, and predictive analytics (Snowflake Cortex experience a plus)
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem and CRM analytics

Job Description:

  • Leads metrics strategy and analytics delivery for the Connected Growth & Insights team within Allegis Group's enterprise Salesforce practice.
  • Partners with coalition leaders, product owners, and Data & Analytics architects to define success metrics across all transformation stages.
  • Designs and delivers Tableau dashboards and visualizations that transform product and sales activity into decision-ready metrics for OpCo stakeholders.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for senior leadership using data storytelling techniques.
  • Advance self-service analytics capabilities through Snowflake Cortex AI (Cortex Analyst / Cortex Search) to reduce time-to-insight and enable rapid decision-making for early-phase experiments and enterprise rollouts.
  • Evaluate analytics tooling to reduce duplicative technology and optimize the team's reporting stack.
  • Mentor team members on analytics best practices and data science principles.
  • Presents findings to stakeholders at all levels.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

  • Defines, builds, and maintains success metrics for Connected initiatives across all transformation stages (Experiment → Pilot → Enterprise Rollout → Steady State), aligned to the Metrics Center of Excellence framework
  • Designs and delivers Tableau dashboards and reports that transform product and sales activity into decision-ready metrics for OpCo stakeholders (TEKsystems, Aerotek, Actalent, Aston Carter)
  • Translates complex data into clear, actionable narratives for coalition leaders, product owners, and senior IS leadership — using data storytelling to demonstrate the value of the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Advances the Cortex AI agent initiative by developing and expanding self-service analytics capabilities (Cortex Analyst / Cortex Search) that reduce time-to-insight for stakeholders
  • Delivers reports and analysis for the Incubation Hub and cross-coalition teams, ensuring data-driven decisions are applied to the performance of experiments
  • Analyzes and recommends analytics tooling (e.g., Adobe Analytics vs. Quantum Metric) to reduce duplicative technology and optimize the analytics stack
  • Serves as the Growth & Insights data SME within Metrics CoE tactical working groups, partnering with coalition leads and Data & Analytics architects to ensure metrics align with business goals
  • Works in an Agile team with business analysts, product owners, and developers to deliver analytics solutions in sprints
  • Communicates project status, issues, and resolution with appropriate stakeholders
  • Maintains a working knowledge of new technologies and adopts suitable concepts for the organization
  • Creates level of effort (LOE) and duration estimates for assigned work. Proactively manages activities to meet those expectations
  • Mentors and guides junior team members on analytics best practices, metric design patterns, and data science principles

Qualifications

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or other related STEM field
  • 7+ years in a data science, analytics, or business intelligence role with progressive responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience defining and delivering business metrics and KPIs at enterprise scale
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Tableau (or equivalent BI platform)
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms
  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, or automation
  • Familiarity with Salesforce data models and CRM reporting is strongly preferred

Skills/Abilities:

  • Knowledge of descriptive and inferential statistics, including hypothesis testing and A/B experimentation
  • Ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques for classification, clustering, and predictive modeling
  • Experience building semantic models or AI-driven analytics tools (Snowflake Cortex, LLM-powered analytics a plus)
  • Strong data visualization skills with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and stakeholder-appropriate design
  • Ability to communicate insights to business and leadership audiences in verbal and written formats — including executive-level data storytelling
  • Strong understanding of Agile processes and practices (SAFe experience a plus)
  • Ability to lead initiatives, mentor team members, and take accountability for delivery
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Intellectual curiosity: creativity and innovation to go beyond current tools to deliver the best solution to complex problems

Office Requirements:

  • Required in office at least 2-3 days a week out of our headquarters in Hanover, MD or offices in Jacksonville, FL

Core Competencies:

  • Customer Service
  • Building Relationships
  • Business Knowledge / Organizational Acumen
  • Self-Motivation / Self-Starter
  • Leading Self and Others
  • Data Storytelling & Executive Communication

title: Director - Global Data Transformation Lead Architect
description:
Introduction to role:

Are you ready to define how enterprise-wide data moves, transforms, and delivers value in a once-in-a-generation transformation? In this role, you will hold global custodianship of the end-to-end Data Transformation Journey—from Cleanse to Migration to Reconciliation—across all deployments, ensuring clean, governed, and reusable data as the foundation for faster decisions, streamlined operations, and ultimately better outcomes for patients.

You will own the Global Data Transformation Functional & Technical Strategy and its associated templates, shaping the standards, patterns, and specifications that power large-scale data transformations and migrations to SAP S/4HANA and adjacent platforms—with a particular focus on operational domains including Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, and Material Master. From initial scoping and design workshops onwards, you will support the Data Deployment journey to accelerate and integrate, translating ambition into actionable designs that delivery teams can execute at pace.

This is a chance to lead a highly visible capability that touches supply chain, manufacturing, and quality data flows used by tens of thousands of colleagues every day—from bench to patient. You will coach a distributed team and set the roadmap that keeps us ahead of the curve.

Accountabilities:

  • E2E Data Transformation Custodianship: Hold global accountability for the end-to-end Data Transformation Journey—Cleanse, Migration, and Reconciliation—ensuring coherent design and execution across all deployments.
  • Global Functional & Technical Strategy: Own and evolve the Global Data Transformation Functional & Technical Strategy, playbooks, guidelines, and templates that underpin every deployment wave.
  • Data Deployment Support: Support the Data Deployment journey from initial scoping and design workshops onwards, accelerating integration and ensuring designs are fit for purpose from day one.
  • Migration & Cleanse Scope: Define and govern the Data Migration & Cleanse scope for each deployment, establishing clear boundaries, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  • Harmonisation & Transformation Mapping: Develop and maintain Global Data Migration Specifications (DMSs), Harmonisation & Relevancy Rules, and Transformation Mapping to ensure consistency and traceability across domains.
  • Reconciliation Strategy: Own the Reconciliation Strategy, playbooks, and Report Passports that validate data accuracy and completeness at each stage of the journey.
  • Templates & Accelerators: Create and maintain reusable accelerators including C4 Workshop Decks, Data Load Plan Templates, and Entry and Exit Criteria to drive repeatable, efficient deployments.
  • Design Standards & Governance: Establish patterns that ensure consistency, traceability, and regulatory-ready quality across diverse operational domains—particularly Manufacturing, Quality, and Material Master.
  • Solution Design to Delivery: Provide actionable, high-fidelity design solutions to downstream delivery teams, aligned to delivery constraints and timelines so teams can execute with confidence.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Work closely with Build and Run Leads to embed designs into delivery, enabling repeatable pipelines and aligned cutover strategies across operational workstreams.
  • Team Oversight & Coaching: Oversee and guide the work of Data Transformation Architects (including offshore), champion best practices, and resolve design and delivery challenges swiftly.
  • Technology Evaluation: Lead evaluation and testing of new technologies relevant to data transformation design—from proofs of technology/value to technical inputs that strengthen business cases.
  • Stakeholder Partnerships: Build strong relationships with data, operations, and business stakeholders to understand priorities, shape demand, and evolve the transformation design roadmap.
  • Capability Development: Build the Data Transformation Design capability—training, tooling, ways of working, and operating model—to improve throughput, quality, and value.
  • Growth & Learning: Manage personal and team development, fostering internal promotion, skills growth, and continuous learning in data transformation technologies and methodologies.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field.
  • Very high techno/functional proficiency—deep SAP knowledge, Axial Data Design expertise, and strong command of data transformation processes and tooling.
  • Significant experience in complex programme data migration, with practical examples of using modern data platforms to design, support build, and maintain data transformation applications
  • Ability to bring best-practice experience and benchmarks from similar large-scale programmes to accelerate delivery and raise the quality bar.
  • Delivery mindset and Business Thinking First—ability to balance technical rigour with pragmatic, outcome-oriented decision-making
  • Proficiency in data engineering techniques and testing methodologies (e.g., data validation, reconciliation, defect triage).
  • Proficiency with data and application design patterns and processes for migration.
  • Blend of design skills suited to Agile data development projects, serving as technical design authority for transformation and migration

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Experience leading data transformation and migration design for large-scale ERP programmes, ideally including SAP S/4HANA and SAP data models with depth in operational data domains (Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Material Master).
  • Proven success industrializing transformation patterns, metadata management, and automation across multiple waves or markets.
  • Background in life sciences or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of compliance, auditability, and validation in data movements.
  • Track record leading distributed and offshore teams with measurable improvements in velocity and quality.
  • Strong stakeholder influence skills, translating complex design decisions into clear business value and risk trade-offs.
  • Experience developing and deploying reusable accelerators (workshop frameworks, load plan templates, entry/exit criteria) at enterprise scale.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Join a company scaling a global ERP on S/4HANA that will standardize processes and deliver real-time insight across finance and supply chain, used daily by more than 20,000 colleagues. Here, unexpected teams come together to solve complex challenges with urgency and creativity, and your work on reusable, governed data will ripple from operational excellence to patient impact. You will be trusted to take smart risks, equipped with cutting-edge technology, and supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition—so you can turn bold ideas into data capabilities that accelerate science and bring medicines to those who need them.

Step into this pivotal role and lead the data transformation design capability that powers change at scale—shape the standards, build the automation, and deliver the impact. Submit your application today to make your mark!

  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and technical writing skills.

Desirable Requirements

  • Strong understanding of waste hierarchy principles, including waste minimisation, segregation, characterisation, treatment, and disposal optimisation.

Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

title: Associate Director, Acceleration & Insights Operations
description:
Job Description

Serves as the day-to-day bridge between brand teams and the Patient Support CoE for assigned therapeutic areas, owning TA-specific insight generation, patient journey mapping, and implementation support for critical capabilities. Accountable for translating designs and patient-facing capability concepts into operational and scalable solutions — ensuring new capabilities fit into the broader architecture or new capabilities deploy without disrupting live patient support operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Understand and pressure test TA-specific patient support designs, including workflow assumptions, operational feasibility, and implementation sequencing

  • Serve as day-to-day bridge between brand and CoE teams, enabling integration and one-voice execution across assigned TA

  • Support end-to-end patient strategy execution along with the Patient Support Strategy Lead and interaction models across Access, Affordability, and Adherence, supporting agile pod delivery through input gathering, execution follow-through, issue tracking and resolution

  • Support end-to-end implementation process for capabilities, including scoping, sequencing, and operational configuration — translating documentation (design intent, success criteria, technical requirements) into operational specs for hub vendors and internal teams

  • Identify and resolve implementation blockers — including vendor capacity constraints, data integration gaps, CRM configuration issues, and compliance requirements — and escalate to the right stakeholders for resolution

  • Maintain implementation playbooks that codify repeatable deployment processes, reducing time and risk of future capability rollouts

  • Conduct TA-specific insight generation, including patient-specific market research and HCP feedback as needed along with the brand patient strategy team

Points of Collaboration:

  • Patient Experience and Acceleration Lead: Reporting line; aligning TA-level insights and implementation priorities to vertical strategy and CoE roadmap

  • Patient Access, Affordability, and Adherence Operations Leads: Coordinating deployment timing, vendor impact, and capability sequencing across operational verticals

  • Direct-to-Patient Platform Lead: Thinking through integration with DTP and other emerging channel capabilities as relevant

  • BU Patient Support Strategy lead (SP&ID, Oncology, Rare Disease): Receiving graduated capabilities and brand-specific configuration needs; aligning implementation timing to launch milestones

  • DHH (Data, Hub and Hub Technology): Data integration, CRM configuration, and platform changes required by new capability deployments

  • Hub and Technology Vendors: Translating capability requirements into vendor SOW amendments, configuration changes, and testing protocols

  • Legal, Privacy, and Compliance: Identifying and resolving compliance requirements that create implementation blockers

Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) and 5+ years in biopharma patient services, program implementation, or operations, with experience deploying new capabilities across hub, access, affordability, and adherence

  • Prior experience supporting patient support design and execution, including insight generation, pressure-testing, and implementation support across brand and CoE functions

  • Strong understanding of patient support ecosystems, including hub, specialty pharmacy, access, CRM, and patient journey interactions; familiarity with where new capability deployments could create operational disruption

  • Strong understanding of primary care, specialty care and complex therapy archetypes, including patient needs, access barriers, and support-model differences

  • Experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative inputs into actionable recommendations, including patient, HCP, operational, and program insights; ability to translate findings into operational specs that vendors and hub partners can act on

With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive.   • Build agentic capabilities for TeamViewer Tia and the Agentic Ecosystem, including orchestration, tool use, retrieval, memory, and multi-step task execution.

  • Engineer model context through retrieval strategy, chunking, ranking, caching, compaction, and prompt assembly.

  • Partner with product management, security, and platform teams to deliver secure, reliable AI-enabled features.

  • Apply fine-tuning or smaller specialized models where evaluation evidence supports it.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.

About the Role:


UKG is looking for a Lead Product Manager to help define and deliver the future of Workforce Planning within the Pro Workforce Management product suite. This individual contributor role will own key product areas that help customers anticipate labor demand, align staffing plans with business goals, and make confident workforce decisions.
The role spans forecasting and strategic workforce planning capabilities, with a focus on creating a more unified configuration and planning experience over time. You will partner closely with customers, engineering, design, architecture, services, support, sales, and go-to-market teams to shape product strategy, define solutions, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate has strong enterprise SaaS product management experience, workforce planning or labor forecasting domain knowledge, and a solid understanding of workforce management workflows such as scheduling, timekeeping, absence, compliance, and operational execution.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own product strategy and roadmap for assigned areas within Workforce Planning, aligning priorities with customer needs, business objectives, market opportunities, and the long-term direction toward a more unified planning experience.
• Lead customer and market discovery by synthesizing customer research, usage data, field feedback, support trends, and competitive insights into clear problem statements, product opportunities, and measurable outcomes.
• Serve as a Workforce Planning domain leader across concepts such as demand forecasting, labor modeling, headcount planning, staffing targets, coverage analysis, budget alignment, common configuration, schedule readiness, and variance tracking.
• Define and deliver product solutions by translating strategy and discovery insights into requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release-ready product decisions for agile development teams.
• Drive cross-functional execution and alignment by partnering with engineering, UX, architecture, QA, product marketing, services, support, sales, and leadership to communicate priorities, manage tradeoffs, and support successful delivery and adoption.
• Use data to measure and improve outcomes including adoption, engagement, forecasting accuracy, planning effectiveness, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business impact.
• Advance connected and AI/ML-enabled planning experiences that integrate effectively across forecasting, configuration, scheduling, timekeeping, absence, labor analytics, reporting, budgeting, and broader WFM and HCM workflows.

About you,

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ years of progressive product management experience, including ownership of product areas or major product initiatives in a SaaS environment.
• Experience with workforce planning, labor forecasting, labor planning, workforce management, operational planning, or a closely related domain.
• Demonstrated success delivering enterprise SaaS products from discovery through launch and iteration.
• Strong product management skills, including customer discovery, roadmap ownership, prioritization, requirements definition, agile delivery, and outcome measurement.
• Ability to translate complex customer and business problems into clear product requirements and practical SaaS solutions.
• Strong analytical skills, with experience using data, customer research, usage insights, and business cases to inform product decisions.
• Experience with AI/ML-enabled product capabilities, including a working understanding of machine learning concepts, predictive modeling, forecasting methods, model outputs, accuracy measurement, and practical application of ML-driven insights in customer-facing workflows.
• Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and present complex concepts clearly to technical, business, and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Workforce Management software, including scheduling, timekeeping, absence, labor planning, forecasting, analytics, or compliance workflows.
• Experience with forecasting and planning workflows such as demand drivers, labor standards, planning assumptions, staffing models, scenario modeling, budget alignment, forecast accuracy, common configuration, or plan-versus-actual analysis.

• Experience with product integrations, APIs, data pipelines, analytics platforms, planning models, optimization, predictive analytics, or recommendation systems.
