title: Systems Director – GEOINT Futures and Architecture
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The National Systems Group serves as the technical advisor to the Intelligence Community and its mission partners involved in the collection and distribution of national and tactical intelligence, including electronics programs, advanced technologies, ground and communications, imagery programs, and systems engineering and launch.

The National Geospatial Programs subdivision (NGP) serves as the technical and programmatic advisor to the National Geospatial-Intelligence (GEOINT) Agency (NGA) and other mission partners involved in the end-to-end GEOINT mission. Join us and become a leader charged with enabling NGA in its efforts to define the future of the GEOINT Enterprise and ensure NGA is postured to be the leader across the National System for Geospatial-Intelligence (NSG) and Allied System for Geospatial-Intelligence (ASG).

Aerospace is seeking an agile, motivated leader to serve as the Systems Director (Systems Director - Engineering Program Management and Systems Engineering) for our support to the NGA GEOINT Functional Manager and Source Directorate. This position manages all Aerospace technical and policy advice and support to senior intelligence officers and executives within these organizations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for assigning resources, determining staffing needs, and coordinating activities across the GEOINT enterprise. They will serve as the primary liaison between Aerospace, NGA leadership, and counterpart organizations across the Intelligence Community to ensure seamless coordination and mission success.

This position is located 100% on site with the customers in Springfield, VA.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead, develop and mentor a high-performing technical staff.
  • Liaison with senior customers, staff, Aerospace management, NRO program offices, and the Engineering & Technology Group (ETG) to identify and fulfill customer needs, consistent with the Aerospace FFRDC role.
  • Serve as the primary interface for the Aerospace NGP team with the customer and with Aerospace teams in other parts of the Intelligence Community.
  • Lead technical studies that will impact future space and ground architectures.
  • Collaborate with Aerospace subject matter experts, government, and SETA across the GEOINT enterprise to close end-to-end missions.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of both current and future GEOINT acquisitions programs including relevant advanced technology.
  • Build and maintain relationships with other intelligence community and national security space organizations and facilitate the exchange of information and analysis.
  • Identify and follow through on opportunities to inject Aerospace thought leadership and technology in support of customer mission needs.
  • Bring the best of Aerospace's engineering matrix to bear in support of the portfolio, oversee all efforts in your area of responsibility, and manage organizational resources including identifying, tasking, and tracking ETG support in a manner that meets customer needs, complies with customer and Aerospace policies, and fulfills contract requirements.

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Systems Director – Engineering Program Management and Systems Engineering:

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, or other relevant subjects.
  • 12 years of progressively more responsible experience in engineering or other technical roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong teams and lead multidisciplinary staff to meet customer needs.
  • Demonstrated knowledge regarding NGA, NRO, their common interfaces and lines of demarcation.
  • Familiarity with GEOINT architectures, satellite design, systems engineering, network architectures, and/or sensor integration technologies.
  • Demonstrated agility and ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced customer environment with a high degree of uncertainty.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, organization and planning skills along with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Understanding of the Aerospace role and the guidelines for appropriate use of an FFRDC.
  • Experience with modeling, simulation, and analysis of large-scale systems and systems of systems for developing architectures, evaluating concepts of operation, conducting analysis of alternatives, and defining requirements.
  • Occasional domestic travel required (approximately 10%).
  • This position requires a current and active TS/SCI security clearance and polygraph, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • An advanced degree in GEOINT-related disciplines, Science, Engineering, or Mathematics.
  • At least 5 years management experience and/or team leadership experience.
  • Expertise and experience in geospatial intelligence CONOPS, collection systems, architectures, operations, and the GEOINT user community.
  • Experience leading complex trade-study formulation and assessments for critical national programs.
  • Experience with supporting a space-related program office and facilitating reach back to obtain and coordinate technical support from the Aerospace Engineering & Technology Group and other Aerospace Program Offices.
  • Understanding of the national security space environment including people, organizations, infrastructure, and capabilities in IC organizations that produce space-related intelligence.

title: Quality Inspector - 2nd Shift
description:
A Quality Inspector in a heavy manufacturing setting. A Quality Inspector is responsible for reviewing products and materials during manufacturing to make sure they meet company requirements. The duties include measuring objects compared to intended physical specifications, running quality tests and identifying defects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Determines quality and reliability standards by studying drawings and formulas; verifying specifications with engineering staff.
  • Identifies raw material conditions by collecting samples; conducting inspections and physical test of materials.
  • Identifies in-process product condition by collecting samples during productions process; conducting in-process inspections and physical tests.
  • Determines disposition of finished product by collecting, classifying, analyzing, and interpreting production and quality data; judging product acceptability in comparison to specifications.
  • Determines acceptability of rework by conducting inspections and physical tests of reworked product.
  • Documents finished product status by recording and summarizing raw materials, in-process, and finished-product inspection and physical test data; updating quality assurance data base.
  • Maintains product quality documentation system by writing or rewriting quality assurance procedures.
  • Maintains quality assurance operations by following quality assurance policies and procedures; reporting needed changes.
  • Contributes to team effort by accomplishing relating results as needed. .

Education and Experience:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • Expert knowledge of quality expectations and standards.
  • Proven ability to read and interpret blue prints.
  • General understanding of hydraulic, electrical and air systems.
  • General understanding of welding and weld quality.
  • General understanding of paint process and quality.

title: Research Scientist , WW Sustainability
description:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements that support Amazon's long-term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join our growing Sustainability team to drive the science behind value chain decarbonization. This role will establish Amazon's scientific methodologies for sector- and cross-sectoral decarbonization mechanisms, and establish benchmarks for automated validation and risk assessment.

As a Research Scientist, you will be responsible for independently leading assessments of environmental issues across the full spectrum of Amazon businesses and evaluating sustainability impacts across the value chain. You will independently develop quality frameworks and methodologies that enable Amazon to scale procurement of high-quality environmental interventions while maintaining scientific rigor and environmental integrity.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop quality assessment frameworks for complex environmental interventions, baseline-setting approaches, and measurement methodologies

title: Director, M&A Operations
description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.

The Director, M&A Operations is responsible for leading the operational execution of the organization's book purchase and M&A initiatives from transaction close through successful integration.

Reporting to the SVP, Head of Business Operations, CI Wealth, this role owns the M&A operating framework, integration governance model, transaction execution process, and cross-functional delivery required to successfully onboard acquired advisor businesses into the organization. The Director serves as the central leader coordinating all execution activities, ensuring transactions progress efficiently, risks are mitigated, stakeholders remain aligned, and integration objectives are achieved.

Working in close partnership with the SVP, Business Development, who leads deal origination and transaction negotiations, and the SVP, Head of Business Operations, CI Wealth, who establishes the integration vision, strategic priorities, and future-state operating model, the Director is accountable for translating strategic direction into actionable plans and delivering successful outcomes.

This role will coordinate cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Sales, Managed Solutions, HR, etc.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operator who combines strong project leadership, M&A expertise, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and change leadership capabilities in a fast-paced growth environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

M&A Transaction Leadership & Execution

  • Own the execution framework supporting all book purchase and Canadian Wealth M&A transactions.
  • Lead transaction planning and execution from signed deal through integration completion.
  • Develop and manage integration roadmaps, project plans, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Drive execution across concurrent transactions, ensuring priorities remain aligned and deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Identify execution risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and escalate key decisions requiring executive direction.
  • Act as the primary operational leader responsible for ensuring successful transaction delivery.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Project manage cross-functional transaction teams consisting of Operations, Technology, HR, Finance, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and Advisor Transition stakeholders.
  • Establish clear ownership, timelines, deliverables, and success measures for each workstream.
  • Resolve execution challenges and remove barriers to delivery.
  • Influence leaders and stakeholders at all levels to ensure alignment and timely completion of commitments.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination across all integration activities.

Governance & Decision Support

  • Own governance structures supporting M&A and book purchase activities.
  • Lead steering committee meetings, integration reviews, and executive project updates.
  • Maintain enterprise visibility into all active transactions, including risks, issues, decisions, and key milestones.
  • Prepare concise executive reporting and provide recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
  • Escalate critical issues requiring SVP and President review and approval.

M&A Operating Model & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously enhance the organization's M&A execution playbook and governance framework.
  • Establish standardized methodologies, templates, checklists, and operating procedures.
  • Drive consistency and scalability across all acquisition and integration activities.
  • Incorporate lessons learned from completed transactions into future execution planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve transaction speed, integration effectiveness, and overall execution quality.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • University degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, integrations, business transformations, M&A transactions, or large-scale projects.
  • Experience within wealth management, financial services, or another regulated industry is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing acquisition, integration, or book purchase activities from planning through execution.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, manage risks, and drive results against demanding timelines.
  • Proven ability to influence and coordinate stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Technology, HR, and Sales without direct authority.
  • Experience developing and implementing governance frameworks, operating models, playbooks, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and change leadership capabilities.
  • Highly organized, accountable, and execution-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or other relevant project management or change management certifications are considered an asset.

CI Financial is an independent company offering global wealth management and asset management advisory services through diverse financial services firms. Since 1965, we have consistently anticipated and responded to the changing needs of investors. Our commitment to the highest levels of performance means that whatever their position, CI employees must be comfortable in a fast-paced environment that will stretch them to tap into their highest potential. title: Quality Assurance Engineer, AI
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

  • Own the quality strategy for teams shipping largely agent-generated code, ensuring software can be released safely and at speed through strong verification practices.

  • Build and maintain automated test infrastructure across unit, integration, end-to-end, contract, API, performance, and regression testing.

  • Define and operate evaluation frameworks for AI-powered features, including datasets, scoring systems, model-as-judge approaches, human calibration, regression tracking, and release gates.

  • Design testing strategies for non-deterministic and agentic systems where outputs may vary while still meeting expected quality standards.

  • Use AI coding agents to generate and maintain test suites, while ensuring coverage remains meaningful, risk-based, and aligned to business requirements.

  • Test agent behavior, including multi-step task execution, tool usage, failure recovery, safety enforcement, and human handoff workflows.

  • Instrument production quality signals and use real-world feedback to continuously improve evaluation and testing frameworks.

  • Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle, embedding quality from refinement through release.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of industry experience in test automation or quality engineering, with strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, Java, or C# and a track record of supporting complex software products.

  • Hands-on experience testing AI and model-based systems, including evaluation frameworks, model quality assessment, and the challenges of non-deterministic outputs.

  • Proven ability to build and scale automated testing platforms, including CI/CD integration, test data strategies, framework development, and flaky test management.

  • Strong understanding of how to evaluate agentic systems, including tool calling, multi-step workflows, safety mechanisms, and failure handling.

  • Regular use of AI coding agents, combined with a critical review mindset and accountability for the correctness and quality of generated software and test assets.

  • Experience with API testing, performance testing, and at least one of desktop, web, or distributed backend platforms.

  • Deep understanding of common AI failure modes, including hallucinations, prompt injection, context degradation, non-determinism, and silent regressions, along with effective mitigation strategies.

  • Practical experience with agentic development environments, MCP or comparable tooling, and repository-based management of prompts, instructions, and evaluation assets.

  • Strong communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams, and a passion for helping shape a modern AI-native.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and bonuses

  • Flexible PTO and paid holidays

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Comprehensive Health insurance package including 100% employer-paid medical coverage

  • Up to 12 weeks of Parental Leave

First, you will serve as the dedicated Enterprise Product Architecture strategist and liaison for one or more core business Pillars, working in close, day-to-day partnership with their technical and architectural leaders to co-author modern technical blueprints and actively reduce portfolio redundancy. Because you will collaborate across various organizational boundaries, your success will hinge on your exceptional ability to influence without authority, using outstanding stakeholder management and storytelling skills to align different technical leaders toward shared standards and a unified architectural goal.

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google.   • Drive the definition, establishment, and adoption of the Enterprise Architecture Toolkit (including standards, design patterns, approved technologies, and architectural guidelines).

title: Facilities Chief Technical Officer IRES - SSFB
description:
Position Title: Facilities Chief Technical Officer

Location: Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO

Relocation Assistance: None available at this time

Remote/Telework: NO - Not available for this position

Clearance Type: DoW Secret

Shift: Day shift

Travel Required: Up to 10% of the time

Description of Duties:

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategically minded Facilities Chief Technical Officer (Facilities CTO) to serve as the principal technical advisor for a MDA facility. The Facilities CTO will support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract.

This senior-level position does not focus on direct line-management of maintenance crews; rather, it is a dedicated advisory and technical oversight role to assist the Stakeholder and Task Integration Manager (STIM) and Deputy STIM in maintaining the facility.

Reporting directly to the Deputy STIM, the Facilities CTO serves as a trusted technical counselor on the ground. In this capacity, you will provide independent evaluations and recommendations to both the Deputy STIM and the STIM. Your primary mission is to advise leadership on the technical integrity, modernization, and maintenance strategies of the facility's mission-critical systems ensuring maximum resilience and zero downtime.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary advisor to the Deputy STIM on all matters related to maintenance of the facility.
  • Provide the Deputy STIM with independent, data-driven recommendations on complex facility challenges, equipment lifecycles, and engineering trade-offs.
  • Assist the Deputy STIM by synthesizing complex technical data, system metrics, and incident reports into clear, high-level executive briefings for government customers.
  • Serve as the technical sounding board for the Deputy STIM when evaluating proposed facility modifications, system integrations, or vendor proposals.
  • Provide the Deputy STIM with independent, data-driven recommendations on complex facility challenges, equipment lifecycles, and engineering trade-offs.
  • Assist the Deputy STIM by synthesizing complex technical data, system metrics, and incident reports into clear, high-level executive briefings for program and government leadership.
  • Continually assess the technical footprints of critical support systems—such as uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), backup generators, precision climate control, and environmental monitoring grids—and counsel leadership on contingency planning.
  • Effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, with a diverse group of external and internal associates within the organization.
  • Work independently to accomplish objectives with superior attention to detail.

Resumes, in month and year format, must be submitted with application in order to be considered for the position. The selected candidate may be assigned as an employee for one of our teammate companies.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must have a bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a highly related technical discipline.
  • Must have 10, or more, years of technical experience in critical facilities operations (e.g., defense mission centers, high-security data centers, or secure industrial plants)
  • Must have 5, or more, years of experience operating in a senior advisory, consulting, or technical oversight capacity.
  • Must have a proven track record of serving as a trusted technical advisor to senior program leadership (e.g., Deputy STIMs, STIMs, project directors, or military equivalents) on large-scale infrastructure systems.
  • Must have a deep theoretical and practical understanding of SCADA, BMS, HVAC/chiller systems, diesel generator systems, and automated switchgear.
  • Must have an active DoW Secret Security Clearance

Desired Requirements:

  • Have experience working within the Missile Defense Agency or other DOD departments/agencies
  • Have a Professional Engineer (PE) license or Certified Facility Manager (CFM) credential

This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

$175,000 – $190,000

title: Mission Engineering Research and Operations Project Engineer/Senior Project Engineer
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The National Systems Group serves as the technical advisor to the Intelligence Community and its mission partners involved in the collection and distribution of national and tactical intelligence, including electronics programs, advanced technologies, ground and communications, imagery programs, and systems engineering and launch.

The Mission Engineering Research and Operations Support Engineer (Project Engineer/Senior Project Engineer - Flight Mechanics) will serve as a senior technical authority and team leader for critical mission engineering, space domain awareness, and spacecraft operations projects. This position acts as principal technical representative to customers, coordinates large-scale technical efforts across program/project lines, and leads or organizes interfaces between customers' and Aerospace technical and management staff. The successful candidate will undertake major program segments, lead diverse technical teams, mentor less experienced staff, and demonstrate widely recognized expertise both internally and externally.

The selected candidate will be required to work full time, on-site at our facility in Chantilly, VA.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead teams that oversee major program segments such as system-level architectural analysis, conceptual design of new vehicles or major payloads, or comprehensive mission architecture development

  • Serve as principal technical representative to customer, coordinating efforts on several concurrent projects or major multi-phase/multi-disciplinary initiatives

  • As Aerospace representative in customer or contractor environment, provide nondirective advice, accept action items, and coordinate pertinent budgets, tasks, and priorities

  • Lead/coordinate teams comprised of diversely skilled engineers servicing major portions of large projects or working across multiple projects

  • Interface regularly with customer and contractor program management as senior technical authority

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements for the Project Engineer – Flight Mechanics

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field with 6+ years relevant experience

  • Proficiency in one or more languages (Python, MATLAB, and multiple programming languages for complex software development)

  • Experience in specialized aerospace engineering tools (STK, GMAT, Orekit) and mission planning/analysis software

  • Demonstrated expertise in spacecraft operations, astrodynamics, orbital mechanics, and space mission design

  • Extensive experience with data pipeline architectures, distributed computing, and big data technologies

  • Advanced knowledge of spacecraft subsystems, systems engineering principles, and model-based systems engineering

  • Willing to travel approx. 10-15%

  • This position requires a current and active TS/SBI/SCI security clearance and polygraph, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

In addition to the above, the minimum requirements for the Senior Project Engineer - Flight Mechanicsinclude:

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field with 10+ years relevant experience

  • Proven track record developing innovative analytical techniques and breakthrough technical solutions

  • Expert proficiency in one of the following (Python, MATLAB, JAVA, C/C++, and/or other programming languages for complex software development)

  • Mastery of specialized aerospace engineering tools (STK, GMAT, Orekit) and mission planning/analysis software

  • Deep understanding of space situational awareness architectures, sensor fusion, and space traffic management

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • Masters or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field

  • Expert proficiency in multiple programming languages (Python, MATLAB, and multiple programming languages for complex software development)

title: Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer (Spanish speaking)

Department: Engineering

Location: London

Compensation: £190K – £285K • Offers Equity

Employment Type: FullTime

About us

At Sierra, we’re creating a platform to help businesses build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices in Atlanta, New York, London, Paris, Madrid, Munich, Singapore, Tokyo, and Sydney.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What You'll Do:

As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer at Sierra, and a founding member of this function, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments, while helping define how Sierra’s AI platform is deployed and operated across enterprise environments. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to architect, deploy, upgrade, and manage Sierra's AI platform infrastructure — ensuring every deployment meets their security, compliance, and operational requirements. In addition, you’ll establish the standards, tooling, and processes that make deployments scalable and repeatable, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. This role will define how Sierra scales some of its most complex customer engagements.

  • Own deployment architecture conversations and execution — designing and implementing deployment strategies across customer environments, including VPC configuration, permissioning, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.

  • Manage the full infrastructure lifecycle for some of Sierra’s most critical customers: initial deployment, ongoing upgrades, scaling, and incident support.

  • Develop and maintain deployment runbooks, upgrade procedures, and automation tooling to make operations repeatable and reliable.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure Sierra's platform is deployable and operable across diverse customer requirements.

  • Work with customers' platform engineering, security, and DevOps teams to navigate their infrastructure constraints and compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to scope infrastructure requirements during pre-sales and onboarding, translating customer needs into concrete deployment plans.

What You'll Bring:

  • Language fluency - professional fluency in both Spanish and English.

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or solutions architecture roles — with significant time spent on customer-facing deployment work.

  • Deep experience with AWS services, Terraform, container orchestration, and cloud networking (VPCs, IAM, DNS, load balancing).

  • Track record of managing deployments in customer-owned cloud environments, including navigating security reviews, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with enterprise stakeholders — from platform engineers to CISOs — and turn infrastructure conversations into actionable deployment plans.

  • Strong operational instincts: you think about upgrades, rollbacks, monitoring, and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Even better...

  • Hands-on experience with Go services, GraphQL APIs, or LLM infrastructure in production environments.

  • Past experience at an early-stage company where you built deployment operations, playbooks, and tooling.

  • Familiarity with observability and incident management in distributed systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar).

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design, deployment automation, or infrastructure self-service tooling for enterprise customers.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

title: Facilities Supervisor
description:
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success.

Amentum is currently seeking for a Facilities Supervisor to support a government contract based in Kings Bay, Georgia.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Facilities Supervisor’s primary duty and responsibility is to serve as the subject matter expert and manage the total work effort associated with operation, sustainment, restoration, and modernization of the HVAC/R, Chiller, Air Compressor, DDC equipment and systems including review and approval of contractor plans and procedures. Duties also include managing the maintenance and plumbing teamwork execution requirements, and per contract requirements.

Essential Duties & Job Functions:

  • Acts as technical advisor to the Facilities Manager for all matters relating to assigned functional areas.
  • Provides day-to-day guidance and direction to others in the same department.
  • Leads a crew in the performance of skilled operation, maintenance, repair and installation work on HVAC/R, Chiller, Air Compressors, and DDC equipment and systems, to include mechanical and plumbing systems.
  • Acts as technical advisor to the Facilities Manager for all matters relating to assigned functional areas.
  • Collects data, prepares and submits periodic reports, and prepares and submits work schedules for all assigned work areas.
  • Reviews shop work orders for completeness, proper method and quality of accomplishment, and availability of materials both before and after work.
  • Establishes unique work standards, enforces commercial/industrial standards and priorities of work.
  • Inspect work to ensure compliance with plans, specifications, policies and regulations and standards.
  • Provides space, tools, test equipment, and materials for functional areas.
  • Implement methods and procedures to accomplish assigned tasks.
  • Supports the project Safety Plan through personal involvement in all aspects of safety, including training and attention to the adherence to safety requirements pertaining to particular trades or skills.
  • Ensure proper housekeeping practices are observed.
  • Ensures the subordinate employees’ time records reflect an accurate record of hours worked and job order numbers to which time is charged.
  • Makes recommendations to the Facilities Manager for long-range planning.
  • Supports, implements (where applicable), and enforces all project and corporate procedures, plans, regulations, and rules.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Accountable For:

  • Coordinating and directing the work of others.
  • Working from blueprints, plans, and sketches; estimate materials and time needed to complete jobs; use hand and power tools.
  • Knowledge of industry standard HVAC/R codes and regulations.
  • Communicating effectively orally and in writing.
  • Completing all mandated training requirements per government and management directives.
  • Timely and cost-effective performance of duties.
  • Timely completion and accuracy of all departmental work.
  • Ensuring compliance with company safety regulations.
  • Dealing with a variety of people in a professional, courteous manner in diversified situations.
  • Adherence to established company safety policies and good industrial and office safety practices.
  • Compliance with company Standard Operating Procedures and Personnel policies and procedures.
  • Effectively coordinating a number of projects simultaneously.
  • Having the ability to work well under pressure.
  • Being onsite during normal business hours and being able to report back within two hours after the Government’s normal working hours.

QUALIFICATIONS / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Mandatory

  • High school education or equivalent.
  • Skill in the use of MS Office Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint at an intermediate level.
  • Valid state driver’s license with acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET Security clearance.
  • Successful candidates will be subject to a government security investigation and must continually meet eligibility requirements for access to all areas of Naval Submarine Base Kings Bay.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or other related field; two (2) years of experience in related field may be substituted for each year of the four (4) years of college.
  • Five (5) years’ relative experience with HVAC/R and DDC Controls at a comparable level of responsibility in projects of similar size, scope and complexity.
  • Previous experience working on a Government Contract or on a Government Facility.
  • Licensed Journeyman HVAC/R.
  • Successful completion of an HVAC/R/DDC apprentice program or equivalent trade school training, education and experience that provides training and experience with maintenance, repair and operation of: DDC systems, cooling towers, fan coil systems, closed loop water treatment, industrial HVAC/R systems and air balancing.
  • EPA Universal refrigerant handling license (certified to work with all CFC, HCFC and HFC refrigerants).
  • Current Secret Security Clearance.

OTHER RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.
  • Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.
  • Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to job.

Compensation Details:

$115000

The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

  • Educational reimbursement

title: Product Specialist
description:
NBCUniversal's Product and AI Solutions team within the Content Core business builds AI-enabled products and provides solutions that help teams across departments work more effectively and make better-informed decisions. You are a curious, organized, and technically minded Product Specialist to support the development and delivery of these products. In this role, you will work within well-defined parameters and partner with Product Managers, engineers, data professionals, and business stakeholders to turn straightforward needs into clear product requirements, documentation, testing activities, and product updates. You will receive guidance and mentorship from experienced team members while building foundational product management, data, and AI skills. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone early in their product career who is eager to learn how enterprise data and AI products move from discovery through delivery and adoption.

Responsibilities:

  • Support Product Managers in gathering and documenting business needs, functional requirements, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria for data- and AI-enabled products.
  • Assist with maintaining product roadmaps, feature backlogs, status updates, release notes, process documentation, and other materials that keep product work clear and organized.
  • Partner with engineering, data, analytics, design, and business teams to support assigned product activities and help ensure requirements are understood.
  • Perform structured product testing, document results, verify straightforward data and workflow outcomes, and raise defects or concerns to the appropriate team members.
  • Review basic product usage, data-quality, and stakeholder feedback signals to help the team identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Support product demonstrations, working sessions, and stakeholder touchpoints by preparing materials, capturing decisions, and tracking follow-up actions.
  • Learn the capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use considerations of the data platforms, AI technologies, and products supported by the team.
  • Identify and escalate risks, roadblocks, data-quality concerns, privacy questions, or unclear requirements to Product Managers and other experienced team members.
  • Build stable working relationships across the team and exchange clear, timely information with colleagues, project leads, and immediate supervisors.
  • Contribute to product documentation and team practices that support consistent, secure, scalable, and user-centered delivery.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 1+ year of relevant professional, internship, academic, or project experience supporting product development, software delivery, data and analytics, AI, business analysis, or a related technical area.
  • Foundational knowledge of data concepts and modern technology environments
  • Ability to follow established processes, and execute assigned activities with guidance from more experienced team members.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to document work clearly, track follow-ups, and manage multiple assigned tasks.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Sound judgment to recognize issues, raise red flags, and escalate roadblocks appropriately.
  • Interest in learning and applying responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, and accessibility practices in product development.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience or demonstrated interest in media, entertainment, advertising, content operations, or enterprise technology.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted tools, generative AI applications, analytics products, data pipelines, data models, or workflow automation through professional, academic, or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Airtable, SharePoint, or similar product and collaboration platforms.
  • Ability to translate basic technical information into concise documentation, presentations, or demonstrations for different audiences.
  • Curiosity, a learning mindset, and a willingness to seek feedback and apply coaching.
  • A collaborative, user-centered approach and an interest in understanding how people use products in their day-to-day work.
  • Foundational understanding of product development concepts, including requirements, user stories, testing, prioritization, and iterative delivery.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $80,000 - $100,000.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with architecture, system integration, and industry compliance standards while supporting senior engineers through the new product development lifecycle. · A self-starter who isn't afraid to ask questions and dig into complex problems

title: Senior Delegated Authority Analyst
description:
INTL Senior Delegated Authority Analyst

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

This role will be based in London, UK and you are required to have the necessary right to work details prior to application.

Purpose of the Job
Support and strengthen the operation of the Delegated Authority Framework for The Hartford International (HIG), acting as a senior technical analyst and referral point across the DA lifecycle. The role supports the Delegated Authority Manager by coordinating approval, onboarding, monitoring, audit, reporting and regulatory activity, with a focus on robust governance, data quality, performance oversight and auditable control evidence.


Reporting Relationships

  • Reports to the Delegated Authority Manager.

  • Works closely with Delegated Authority Analyst, Administrators, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, Finance, Actuarial, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Internal Audit.

  • Acts as a technical referral and quality-control point for day-to-day DA activity, escalating material issues to the Delegated Authority Manager as required.

  • Supports and attends the Delegated Underwriting and Claims Committee (DUCC), and other governance forums, as required.

Job Responsibilities & Competence

  • Coordinate new, renewal and amended delegated arrangements, including binding authorities, lineslips, consortia, master policies and delegated claims arrangements, ensuring due diligence, approvals, sign-offs and evidence are completed in line with the DA Framework.

  • Review DA submissions for completeness, strategic rationale, underwriting appetite, authority scope, conduct considerations, delegated claims implications, operational readiness and required stakeholder input.

  • Maintain and monitor DA approval trackers, subjectivities, post-inception actions and outstanding items, ensuring clear ownership, target dates, escalation and closure evidence.

  • Support ongoing oversight of Coverholders, DCAs and delegated facilities, including annual and periodic due diligence, performance against business plans, risk appetite, complaints, conduct, claims trends, audit outcomes and data quality indicators.

  • Assist with renewal, remediation, suspension, termination or exit activity by collating evidence, preparing analysis and supporting recommendations for management and committee review.

  • Administer and support the risk-based Coverholder and DCA audit programme, including audit planning, scoping, scheduling, report review, recommendation challenge, action tracking and closure evidence.

  • Monitor and complete tasks in Lloyd’s delegated systems and tools, including Atlas, DCOM, DAM, Crystal+ and other relevant market systems, ensuring activities are accurate, timely and appropriately evidenced.

  • Prepare and enhance MI, KPI/KRI and exception reporting for DUCC and other governance forums, covering portfolio profile, approvals, audit findings, open actions, data gaps, control breaches, performance issues and emerging regulatory or reputational risks.

  • Work with Operations, bordereaux, Finance and Actuarial teams to improve timeliness, completeness and accuracy of delegated data, including bordereaux, exposure, premium, EPI and credit control information, and escalate late, incomplete or poor-quality submissions.

  • Support development of more structured, repeatable and auditable controls, including procedures, checklists, control evidence, dashboards, workflow improvements and enhancements to DA reporting.

  • Provide subject matter advice to underwriters and stakeholders on delegated underwriting requirements, Lloyd’s expectations, DA process requirements, documentation standards and regulatory considerations.

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including underwriters, claims teams, brokers, Coverholders, auditors, Lloyd’s and other market participants.

  • Coach and support Delegated Authority Analysts and Administrators, including peer review of work, knowledge sharing, technical guidance and identification of training or process improvement needs.

  • Support DA-related projects, transformation activity, audit remediation, market change and technology-enabled process improvements as required.

  • Attend relevant market forums, conferences and training, keeping up to date with developments in delegated authority, Lloyd’s oversight, regulatory requirements, data standards and market best practice.


Other Duties

  • Assist with other duties as reasonably required by the Delegated Authority Manager, International Product & Underwriting Quality Lead or Underwriting Performance Manager.

Qualifications and Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of general insurance, London Market and Lloyd’s delegated authority principles.

  • Good understanding of the DA lifecycle, including onboarding, due diligence, contract review, audit, ongoing monitoring, renewals, remediation and termination activity.

  • Strong analytical capability, attention to detail and ability to interpret data, MI and exception reporting to support governance and decision-making.

  • Ability to identify, document and implement process improvements and control enhancements.

  • Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, stakeholders and workstreams under pressure.

  • Confident communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and explain technical matters clearly.

  • Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel; Power BI or similar reporting capability desirable.

  • Knowledge of underwriting, workflow and document management systems such as Subscribe, ImageRight or equivalent platforms.

  • Knowledge of Lloyd’s delegated systems and tools, including Atlas, DCOM, DAM, Crystal+ and PBQA, preferred.

  • Progress towards ACII, CII or equivalent market qualification preferred.

Experience

  • Significant experience in delegated authority business, preferably within a Lloyd’s managing agency, insurance company, MGA, broker or delegated authority oversight function.

  • Experience supporting or managing DA approvals, Coverholder or DCA due diligence, audit recommendations, delegated contract review and ongoing monitoring.

  • Experience producing or supporting committee packs, governance reporting, regulatory returns, MI, KPI/KRI reporting or senior stakeholder updates.

  • Experience working with delegated data, bordereaux, EPI, exposure or premium information, and resolving data quality or process issues with stakeholders.

  • Experience operating in a regulated environment and maintaining evidence for audit, compliance or governance review.

title: Operations Associate
description:
About Clasp

We're a team of builders, united by our passion for simplifying the most complex industries. At Clasp, we're on a mission to transform the health insurance industry by modernizing and automating the entire benefits experience.

We started in 2023 backed by investors such as Base10 Partners, Terrain, Conversion Capital, and SemperVirens, firms that have led investments and helped grow companies like Ramp, Rippling, and Blend from the seed stage.

The problem we're solving:

Employers collectively spend over a trillion dollars on benefits every year, yet more than 85% of employees find their benefits confusing. This confusion stems from outdated systems and manual processes that lead to errors, delays, and widespread frustration.

Our vision is to create an ecosystem where everyone benefits:

  • Brokers eliminate busy work and enhance their advisory roles

  • Employers receive a tailored, efficient benefits experience with better coverage and service, often at lower costs

  • Employees gain clear, accessible information about their benefits, leading to higher satisfaction and engagement

  • Partners like HR and payroll platforms expand their offerings effortlessly with our embeddable solutions

About the role

This is a hands-on operations seat at the center of how Clasp delivers every day. You will own frontline execution across customer support, employer implementations, carrier connections, ACA compliance work, and other new verticals, partnering directly with our BizOps and R&D teams to keep the machine running and to make it run better.

Upon starting, you’ll embark on a crash course through our core implementations and product surface area and then become the primary lead on these functions across key client accounts. As we scale, you help hire and mentor the Operations team and help scale the Support / Implementation function at Clasp.

What you'll do

  • Customer support: own the support queue end to end: triage, investigate, resolve, and escalate issues across employers, partners, brokers, and carriers, hitting our SLA and quality targets

  • Implementations: onboard new employer groups: collect and validate censuses and plan documents, configure plans and rates, run enrollment data quality checks, and coordinate go-live with partners

  • Carrier connections: stand up and maintain EDI and API feeds: manage carrier and vendor build queues, work discrepancy reports to resolution, and keep connections healthy after go-live

  • ACA and compliance: run the ACA implementation process, data collection and reconciliation, and filing review cycles alongside our compliance tooling and vendors

  • Process building: document what you learn into runbooks and SOPs, spot the recurring failure modes, and work with BizOps and engineering to automate them away

  • Cross-functional support: be the operational voice into R&D: reproduce bugs, define edge cases, test fixes, and translate customer pain into product requirements

What we're looking for

  • 2-4 years in operations, support, implementations, or account management at a fintech, HR-tech, benefits, insurance, or similar operationally-intensive company

  • High ownership: you chase issues to resolution across email threads, carrier portals, and spreadsheets without being asked twice

  • Sharp written communication: you will spend much of your day writing to employers, partners, and carriers, and precision matters

  • Comfort with messy data: confident in spreadsheets (lookups, pivots, data cleaning); SQL or scripting is a plus, not a requirement

  • Process instinct: you notice when the third ticket looks like the first two and go fix the root cause

  • Thrives on volume and pace: this is a doing role at a fast-moving startup, and the work is concrete, daily, and measurable

What success looks like

  • By 30 days: independently resolving the majority of support tickets within SLA and running implementation checklists with light oversight

  • By 90 days: owning a slice of the connections or ACA book end to end, with updated processes you wrote yourself

  • By 6 months: operating as the go-to owner for support or implementations and ready to formally lead that function as it scales

Compensation & benefits

  • Base compensation ranges from $70,000 - $100,000; final offers depend on experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed

  • Competitive equity stock options

  • Health insurance 100% covered, a $5K office budget, unlimited PTO, and more

title: Server Engineer
description:
Server Engineer

Location: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Government Center

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Department: Innovation and Technology Department

Salary: $85,288.00 - $122,601.49 Commensurate with Experience

Welcome to the City of Charlotte

Charlotte is America’s Queen City, opening her arms to a diverse and inclusive community of residents, businesses and visitors alike. Here you will find a safe, family-oriented city where people work together to help everyone thrive. The mission of the City of Charlotte is to deliver quality public services and promote the safety, health, and quality of life for all residents.

Our guiding principles include:

  • Attracting and retaining a skilled and diverse workforce

  • Valuing teamwork, openness, accountability, productivity, and employee development

  • Providing all customers with courteous, responsive, accessible, and seamless quality services

  • Taking initiative to identify, analyze, and solve problems

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to make informed decisions

SUMMARY

This position is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and optimizing the City's enterprise private cloud infrastructure and Windows Server environment. Primary responsibilities include administering VMware vSphere virtualization platforms, Windows Server operating systems, Active Directory services, enterprise storage, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions supporting mission-critical applications across the organization.

The position provides advanced engineering, automation, lifecycle management, performance optimization, and technical leadership for the City's on-premises compute infrastructure while ensuring high availability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. Responsibilities include enterprise virtualization, storage administration, disaster recovery planning and testing, server lifecycle management, infrastructure automation, and advanced troubleshooting.

This position participates in an on-call rotation as needed to perform planned maintenance activities and respond to critical service-impacting incidents outside normal business hours.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Private Cloud & Windows Server

This position serves as the senior engineering resource responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and continuously improving the City's enterprise private cloud infrastructure and Windows Server environment. The engineer provides technical leadership for highly available, secure, and resilient compute platforms supporting critical business and public safety systems.

Primary responsibilities include administration of VMware vSphere enterprise virtualization environments; Windows Server operating systems; Active Directory Domain Services; enterprise storage platforms; server hardware; backup and disaster recovery technologies; and private cloud infrastructure supporting production, disaster recovery, development, and test environments.

The engineer is responsible for physical and virtual server provisioning, operating system deployment, patch management, performance tuning, capacity planning, lifecycle management, infrastructure modernization, advanced troubleshooting, and automation of administrative processes. The position develops enterprise standards, technical documentation, operational procedures, and engineering best practices while ensuring supported platforms remain secure, reliable, and fully supported throughout their lifecycle.

Additional responsibilities include administration of enterprise disaster recovery and business continuity technologies, including VMware Site Recovery Manager, Zerto, backup platforms, replication technologies, disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery validation. The engineer develops and maintains disaster recovery runbooks and participates in annual business continuity exercises.

The position administers enterprise storage infrastructure including Dell PowerStore storage arrays, SAN technologies, storage networking, replication, snapshots, storage provisioning, and performance optimization to ensure highly available enterprise storage services.

The engineer provides advanced administration of Microsoft Active Directory including Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, authentication services, identity integration, and supporting infrastructure required for secure enterprise operations.

Responsibilities include evaluating emerging technologies; developing infrastructure roadmaps; implementing infrastructure automation through PowerShell and Infrastructure-as-Code principles where appropriate; participating in architecture reviews; providing Tier III/IV escalation support; mentoring junior engineers; and collaborating with cybersecurity, networking, database, cloud, and application teams to deliver secure enterprise technology solutions.

This position participates in an enterprise on-call rotation and may be required to support planned maintenance windows and respond to major incidents outside normal business hours.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Graduate or Equivalent and five (5) years of related work experience

  • OR

  • 2 Year College Degree and three (3) years of related work experience

  • OR

  • Bachelor's Level Degree and one (1) year of related work experience

  • or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience that provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the essential job duties.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years administering enterprise Windows Server environments supporting mission-critical business systems.

  • 5+ years administering enterprise VMware virtualization environments.

  • Expert knowledge of VMware vSphere 8.

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server.

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services.

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise PowerShell automation.

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise disaster recovery methodologies.

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise storage platforms.

  • Expert knowledge of disaster recovery and replication technologies.

  • Experience administering enterprise backup and recovery platforms.

  • Experience supporting enterprise storage area networks (SAN).

  • Experience supporting high-availability clustered environments.

  • Experience administering enterprise server hardware platforms.

  • Experience supporting environments with hundreds of virtual servers and mission-critical workloads.

  • Experience participating in enterprise disaster recovery planning and testing.

  • Experience performing root cause analysis and complex enterprise troubleshooting.

  • Experience working within ITIL or mature enterprise operational processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV) or VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP)

  • 8+ years administering enterprise Windows Server environments supporting mission-critical business systems.

  • 8+ years administering enterprise VMware virtualization environments.

  • Experience with VMware vSphere 9

  • Expert knowledge of Dell PowerStore enterprise storage platforms.

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate

  • Expert knowledge of Zerto disaster recovery and replication technologies.

  • Experience administering hybrid cloud environments

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code

  • Experience with Ansible, Terraform, or similar automation platforms

  • Experience administering Microsoft Failover Clustering

  • Experience with SCOM or enterprise monitoring platforms

  • Experience administering enterprise PKI environments

  • Experience with CIS hardening and security baselines

  • Experience supporting CJIS, PCI or similar regulatory environment

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

The City’s Background Check Policy requires background checks to be conducted on final internal or external candidate(s) applying for any position with the City of Charlotte. The type of information that will be collected as part of a background check includes, but is not limited to: reference checks, social security verification, education verification, criminal conviction record check, and, if applicable, a credit history check, sex offender registry and motor vehicle records check.

title: Bridge Engineering Technical Lead
description:
Freese and Nichols is continuing to grow our bridge practice and is seeking a Bridge Engineering Technical Lead to help advance technical excellence, develop our people, and support delivery of complex transportation and public infrastructure projects.

While our preference is for this person to be based in our North Texas region, the position is open to candidates in the following Texas locations: Fort Worth, Frisco, Dallas, Denton, Austin, San Antonio, or Houston.

This is an opportunity for a strong technical leader who wants to shape bridge design solutions, mentor engineers, and play a key role in project success across a wide range of bridge and structural transportation applications. The ideal candidate brings deep bridge design experience, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to serve as Engineer of Record while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and public sector clients.

Why This Role Matters

  • Technical leadership – Influence bridge design quality, standards, and project execution across complex assignments.
  • Project delivery impact – Help deliver practical, innovative bridge solutions that meet client objectives, schedules, and budgets.
  • People development – Mentor developing engineers and help strengthen the next generation of bridge technical talent.
  • Client service – Support trusted relationships with public infrastructure clients, agencies, and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the planning, analysis, and design of bridge projects for public sector clients.
  • Serve as Engineer of Record for bridge projects and provide technical oversight throughout project development and delivery.
  • Direct and review design calculations, plans, specifications, reports, and other engineering deliverables.
  • Serve as a technical resource for complex bridge design challenges, multidisciplinary coordination efforts, and engineering decision-making
  • Provide practical, innovative engineering solutions that reflect sound judgment, constructability, and client needs.

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Support project managers with technical scope development, design decisions, and project execution.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes across multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Help ensure bridge projects meet client objectives, schedules, budgets, quality expectations, and applicable agency requirements.
  • Perform senior technical and quality reviews of bridge plans, specifications, calculations, and technical reports.
  • Support continuous improvement of bridge design practices, standards, workflows, and technical tools.

Team Development & Mentoring

  • Mentor and develop engineers while helping set expectations for technical quality, collaboration, and professional growth.
  • Support professional growth through project reviews, design guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Help less experienced engineers develop sound engineering judgment, technical capabilities, and confidence in bridge design delivery.
  • Foster a collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, accountability, and technical excellence.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices across the Bridge Team.

Client & Team Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with clients, agency representatives, project teams, and partners.
  • Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, project presentations, and design discussions.
  • Support client engagement and pursuits through technical input, qualifications content, proposal support, or presentations as needed.
  • Collaborate with bridge professionals across the firm to share expertise, strengthen best practices, and promote responsive service.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • 6+ years of experience in designing various types of bridges and retaining walls..
  • Experience leading bridge design projects from concept development through final design.
  • Experience serving as Engineer of Record or providing senior technical oversight on bridge projects.
  • Strong knowledge of AASHTO bridge design specifications and applicable agency standards.
  • Experience in delivering PS&E projects for TxDOT.
  • Experience mentoring and developing less experienced engineers.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.
  • Experience in bridge inspection, rehabilitation, condition assessment, and asset management.
  • Experience in delivering PS&E projects in region outside of Texas..
  • Project management experience.

We strive to be the firm of choice for clients and employees through innovative approaches, practical results, and outstanding service. title: Weekend Security Officer
description:
Job Title: Weekend Security Officer (SOC & Corporate Facility)
Location: Stamford, CT
Schedule: Weekend Shift (Saturday & Sunday)
Pay Rate: $19.50 per hour

About the Role
We’re looking for a Weekend Security Officer to support a corporate facility in Stamford, CT. This role combines Security Operations Center (SOC) duties with on-site physical security. You’ll monitor cameras and systems, manage access, respond to incidents, and interact with employees and visitors. Strong computer skills, Excel proficiency, and the ability to multi-task are essential.

Key Responsibilities

SOC / Control Room – Corporate Environment

  • Monitor CCTV, access control, and alarm systems covering offices, parking areas, and common spaces
  • Review and respond to badge access events, door alarms, and other system alerts according to corporate procedures
  • Dispatch on-site officers to investigate alarms, access issues, and service calls
  • Answer security-related phone calls and emails from employees, visitors, and building management
  • Maintain situational awareness of building occupancy, after-hours activity, and contractor work
  • Log incidents, alarms, and notable events in SOC systems and Excel-based trackers
  • Support corporate emergency procedures (fire alarms, medical incidents, workplace safety issues) by coordinating response and communication

Physical Security – Corporate Facility

  • Conduct interior and exterior patrols of office floors, lobbies, loading docks, and parking areas
  • Manage access control at entrances, including badge checks and visitor sign-in/verification
  • Assist with visitor management: issue badges, verify appointments, and direct visitors to the correct locations
  • Respond on-site to incidents (access problems, suspicious activity, safety hazards, employee assistance requests) and report findings back to the SOC
  • Enforce building rules and corporate security policies in a professional and customer-focused manner
  • Complete clear and accurate incident reports, daily activity reports, and other required documentation
  • Support building management and client representatives with security-related requests

Administrative & Computer-Based Responsibilities

  • Use computer systems and Microsoft Excel to maintain logs, incident records, and access reports
  • Update and maintain spreadsheets (incident logs, patrol logs, visitor logs, access exception reports) with accurate data entry
  • Multi-task between monitoring systems, handling calls, assisting employees/visitors, and completing documentation
  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with client contacts, building management, and the security team

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Strong computer skills, including:
    • Confident navigating Windows-based and web-based corporate systems
    • Ability to use Microsoft Excel (data entry, basic formulas, sorting/filtering, formatting)
  • Strong multi-tasking, prioritization, and time management skills
  • Professional communication skills and a strong customer service mindset
  • Ability to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods and respond quickly to incidents as required
  • Ability to pass required background checks and meet any Connecticut security officer licensing requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a corporate office security environment or Security Operations Center
  • Experience with electronic access control and CCTV systems
  • Previous experience in security, law enforcement, or emergency services
  • Experience working weekend or shift-based schedules


We help make your world a safer place.

Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.

They preserve order while enforcing regulations and directives for a client site pertaining to personnel, visitors, and the area. We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.

No experience necessary! If you have retail, food service or hospitality industry background you are a great fit for this role; if not, we will provide you with the training and everything you need for a great introduction to a career in the security industry.
