title: Account Director
description:
About Acast
Since 2014, Acast has been building the world’s most valuable podcast marketplace, creating the technology that connects podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. Its marketplace spans more than 140,000 podcasts, 3,300 advertisers, and one billion quarterly listens. Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen—across any podcast app or listening platform.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, driven Account Director to join Acast’s U.S. sales team as a quota-carrying seller.

In this role, you’ll own and grow a portfolio of key agency and brand-direct relationships while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships with decision-makers, uncovering client needs and developing creative, strategic solutions that drive meaningful results for advertisers—and revenue growth for Acast.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated and entrepreneurial seller with a proven track record of exceeding revenue goals, developing new business and building lasting client relationships. You understand how to navigate agencies and brands, create opportunities where they may not already exist, and confidently sell complex and integrated ideas.

Experience in podcasting or audio is a plus, but not a requirement. We’re equally interested in candidates with strong experience across digital media, video, social, branded content, creator marketing or other fast-moving areas of the advertising ecosystem.

You’ll represent Acast’s full suite of advertising capabilities - from audio and programmatic to creator-led sponsorships, branded content, and integrated partnerships - and help advertisers tap into the influence, creativity, and cultural relevance of podcast creators.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and ambitious seller to join one of the leading companies in podcasting and play a meaningful role in the continued growth of Acast’s U.S. business.

Salary range: $150,000 yearly + bonus

What you´ll do

  • Own and grow advertising revenue across an assigned portfolio of agency and brand-direct partners while actively developing new business.

  • Build and deepen relationships with key decision-makers across agencies and brands, from day-to-day teams through senior leadership.

  • Identify whitespace within your territory and proactively build a strong pipeline of new advertisers, campaigns and incremental revenue opportunities.

  • Develop strategic, insight-led solutions that address clients’ business and marketing objectives.

  • Sell across Acast’s full advertising ecosystem, including audio, sponsorships, programmatic, branded content, creator-led partnerships and integrated opportunities.

  • Lead the sales process from prospecting and ideation through proposal development, negotiation and close.

  • Deliver against individual revenue targets while maintaining a healthy and consistent pipeline.

  • Stay close to clients and the broader marketplace to understand evolving priorities, challenges and opportunities.

  • Partner closely with internal teams across Creative Strategy, Content, Marketing, Account Management, Operations and Finance to develop and deliver best-in-class client solutions.

  • Collaborate with sales counterparts across Acast’s global footprint to unlock opportunities across markets.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting and sales activity in Salesforce.

  • Represent Acast at industry events, client meetings and other marketplace opportunities, serving as a strong ambassador for the Acast brand.

Who you are

  • You have 7+ years of experience in media, advertising or digital sales, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • You have strong relationships across major media agencies and/or brands and know how to develop new relationships and open doors.

  • You’re a proactive seller who is comfortable prospecting, building pipeline and growing a book of business—not simply managing existing accounts.

  • You’re a strategic and consultative seller who can understand a client’s business objectives and translate them into compelling media and content solutions.

  • You have experience selling integrated media, digital, audio, video, social, creator/influencer or branded content solutions. Podcast and audio experience is a plus.

  • You understand the broader digital advertising ecosystem, including both direct and programmatic buying.

  • You’re an excellent communicator and storyteller who is confident presenting to clients and senior stakeholders.

  • You have strong negotiation and closing skills and are comfortable navigating complex deals and organizations.

  • You’re commercially minded, accountable and motivated by achieving ambitious goals.

  • You’re highly collaborative and know that the strongest client solutions often require bringing together teams and expertise from across an organization.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment and are comfortable adapting as the marketplace evolves.

  • You have a genuine enthusiasm for podcasts, creators and the changing media landscape.

Culture

Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.

Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome.

We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.

We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test, Digital Solutions

Location: Bedford, MA, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Introduction

Werfen

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Position Summary:

The Senior Software Engineer in Test within the Digital Factory is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks, tools, and processes to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of clinical decision support solutions. This role leads test automation initiatives across the product lifecycle, while also supporting manual, exploratory, integration, and regression testing activities as needed.

The Senior Software Engineer in Test is accountable for ensuring comprehensive test coverage, requirements traceability, and efficient validation of software features and system behaviors. Working closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders in an Agile environment, this role drives scalable and sustainable test strategies that support multiple product releases and continuous delivery objectives.

This position plays a key role in establishing and advancing the System Testing function, influencing quality engineering practices and contributing to the successful development and delivery of Werfen digital products.

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

Essential Functions:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks, tools, and processes to improve software quality, test efficiency, and productivity for cloud-based solutions.
  • Define and implement scalable test automation strategies supporting functional, integration, system, end-to-end, and regression testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites, ensuring seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines and continuous delivery processes.
  • Review and analyze automated test execution results, communicate issues and risks to the team, and log and track defects as required.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams to implement user stories, develop test solutions, and deliver high-quality software.
  • Write and maintain automation code, including reusable components and step definitions, and participate in the review of test scenarios to ensure appropriate quality, coverage, and maintainability.
  • Review and approve code changes and pull requests, ensuring adherence to coding standards, testability, and quality engineering best practices.
  • Define, maintain, and monitor requirements traceability and test coverage metrics to ensure comprehensive verification and validation of software requirements.
  • Perform and support testing activities beyond automation, including exploratory, integration, system, workflow, qualification, and regression testing, as needed.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement testing tools, frameworks, and technologies; lead proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new solutions and improve testing capabilities.
  • Document, track, and verify defects, communicate testing progress and quality metrics, and support verification and release activities.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, and documentation to promote continuous improvement, effective use of testing tools and frameworks, and adoption of quality engineering best practices across the organization.

Networking/Key Relationships:

  • Collaborate regularly with cross-functional teams, including Digital Solutions, Software Engineering, R&D, Clinical Software, Product Management, DevOps, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and other stakeholders to support product development, testing, quality, and release objectives.

Preferred Experience:

  • Proven experience in software verification, validation, and test automation, including the design and maintenance of enterprise-grade automated testing frameworks and solutions.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, supporting CI/CD-based software delivery, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) development and testing following ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR Part 820 is highly desirable.

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience Required for the Position:

  • Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum of 5-10 years related experience or Master's De­gree plus 3-5 years of related experience or waiver based on experience
  • Experience in Software Medical Devices development that follows ISO 13485, IEC 62304 / 21 CFR Part 820.30 highly desired

Skills & Capabilities:

  • Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript, and Python, with hands-on experience developing scalable automated test solutions.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber/BDD, Gherkin, Squish, REST Assured, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining UI, API, integration, system, and regression test automation for complex software applications.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, cloud-native applications, and front-end/back-end testing methodologies.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, and Artifactory.
  • Strong knowledge of test design techniques, verification methodologies, SDLC processes, requirements traceability, and test coverage practices.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including database validation and testing activities.
  • Experience testing cloud-based solutions and working with AWS services such as Lambda, Cognito, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and AWS SDK.
  • Experience with performance and scalability testing, and familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern test execution infrastructure.
  • Ability to evaluate, select, and implement testing tools, develop proof-of-concepts, and assess emerging technologies to improve quality and testing efficiency.
  • Experience with SaaS-based automation frameworks, test management, defect tracking tools, and automation reporting solutions.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ability to work effectively in Agile teams and leverage modern AI-assisted engineering tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cursor.

Agile/Digital Experience:

  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and continuous delivery methodologies, with experience supporting software development throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Experience participating in requirements reviews, test planning, test execution, verification activities, release readiness assessments, and maintaining requirements traceability and test coverage.
  • Experience using Jira and Jama for test management and requirements traceability, and performing exploratory, integration, system, qualification, workflow, and regression testing as required.

Individual Skills:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts and work across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly evaluate complex information and develop practical, innovative solutions.
  • Broad understanding of software testing activities, methodologies, and quality engineering practices, with the flexibility to support various testing functions and initiatives as needed.

Mindset and Behaviors:

  • Passion for technology, quality engineering, automation, and the adoption of emerging technologies and innovative solutions.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable, with a continuous learning mindset and willingness to explore new ideas and approaches.
  • Demonstrates integrity, transparency, accountability, and a collaborative approach to achieving team and organizational objectives.

Travel Requirements:

  • 0%

The annual base salary range for this role is currently $130,000 to $160,000. Individual employee compensation will ultimately depend on factors including education, relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, and particular business needs.

This role is eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan retirement benefits with an employer match, as well as paid vacation and sick leave. Our sales roles are eligible for participation in a commission plan and our management, and select professional roles, are eligible for a performance-based bonus.

Closing

If you are interested in constantly learning and being challenged on a daily basis we encourage you to submit your resume or CV.

Werfen is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse workplace. Werfen strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination, harassment or retaliation based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable state or federal law. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact NAtalentacquisition@werfen.com for assistance.

We operate directly in over 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Annual revenue is approximately $2 billion and more than 7,000 employees around the world comprise our Werfen team.

title: Informatics and Data Services Unit Head
description:
Informatics & Data Services Unit Head

Location: Madison, WI

Remote Type: Partially Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Current Employees: If you are currently employed at any of the Universities of Wisconsin, log in to Workday to apply through the internal application process.

Job Category:

Academic Staff

Employment Type:

Regular

Job Profile:

Software Engineer/Developer IV

Job Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the Informatics and Data Services (IDS) team at the Wisconsin National Primate Research Center (WNPRC)! Reporting to the WNPRC Information Technology Director, the Software Engineer/Developer IV supervises a team of 2-3 software developers responsible for supporting, updating, and improving the Electronic Health Records (EHR) server upon which the WNPRC relies for animal care and research. The EHR server is based on the LabKey platform, and the production EHR server is hosted and maintained by LabKey with a support contract. The IDS team collaborates with stakeholders across the Primate Center to understand their EHR requirements and improve the utility of the system. The successful candidate will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Design & develop code: Analyze and write code to troubleshoot, diagnose, and improve EHR systems

  • Lead technical projects: Manage multiple concurrent projects to improve and expand the functionality of the EHR server

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the WNPRC: Work with leadership and colleagues to discuss project progress, manage expectations, and solve technical issues

  • Oversee testing: Manage the creation and execution of thorough testing plans for system updates and rollout of new applications

  • Optimize Performance: Create strategies to keep the EHR system running fast and reliably

  • Mentor Staff: Train and provide technical guidance to junior IDS team members, as well as assist in training WNPRC in using the EHR system

The EHR system is built upon code base has been developed for more than a decade and is publicly reviewable here: https://github.com/LabKey/wnprc-modules This position requires the technological skills to design data structures, connect different technologies, and develop code to improve and expand on the EHR system to streamline animal care and enable research with the 60+ years of records contained in the system.

The Wisconsin National Primate Research Center (WNPRC) was founded in 1961 and is a part of the National Primate Research Centers program funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH). The WNPRC’s mission is to increase our understanding of basic primate biology and to improve human and animal health and quality of life through research. Notable discoveries include the world’s first in vitro-fertilized monkey in 1984 and the first pluripotent stem cells (first monkey, then human) in the 1990s. WNPRC research has helped advance therapies for people with HIV, kidney disease, glaucoma, developmental disorders, autoimmune diseases, Parkinson’s disease (PD), as well as a host of new studies at the forefront of scientific and biological research.

  • University sponsorship is not available for this position, including transfers of sponsorship. The selected applicant will be responsible for ensuring their continuous eligibility to work in the United States (i.e. a citizen or national of the United States, a lawful permanent resident, a foreign national authorized to work in the United States without the need of an employer sponsorship) on or before the effective date of appointment. This position is an ongoing position that will require continuous work eligibility. UW-Madison is not an E-Verify employer, and therefore, is not eligible to employ F1 STEM OPT Extension participants. If you are selected for this position, you must provide proof of work authorization and eligibility to work.

  • Employees are expected to act in the best interest of the University and to protect the University from both actual conflicts of interest and the appearance of conflicts of interest

  • The WNPRC is a tuberculosis free environment

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Exercises supervisory authority, including hiring, suspending, promoting, managing conduct and performance, discharging, assigning, rewarding, disciplining, and/or approving hours worked for the WNPRC IDS team
  • Designs complex information architectures, user flows, interfaces, prototypes, design patterns/systems, content strategies, and services
  • Conducts system analysis, reviews, and interprets system requirements, and develops detailed system design specifications for system integration and upgrades
  • May supervise unit staff and resolve routine personnel issues
  • Reviews systems requirements, design, and business processes to ensure the alignment with IT and business strategies
  • Leads application development, integration upgrades, and maintenance projects
  • Provides expertise on the resolution and technical approach of complex technical design and system integration problems

Department:

Wisconsin National Primate Research Center

Starting salary will be based on experience and qualifications. This position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including generous paid time off, competitively priced health/dental/vision/life insurance, tax-advantaged savings accounts, and participation in the nationally recognized Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS) pension fund. For a summary of benefits, please see: https://www.wisconsin.edu/ohrwd/benefits/download/fasl.pdf.

  • At least one year of supervisory experience

  • Demonstrated project management skills, including the ability to transform requirements from stakeholders into actionable plans

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience managing software developers

How to Apply:

title: Pediatric ECMO Specialist- Part Time, Weekend Nights
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

***LOCATION: CHILDREN'S MEMORIAL HERMANN HOSPITAL***

The Extracorporeal Life Support (ECMO) Specialist utilizes validated skills acquired through specialized training and certification to assess and manage any patient on ECMO as well as the ECMO pump. The ECMO Specialist provides safe, effective care for the patient utilizing the ECMO MPP orders with assistance and supervision being provided by the ECMO Coordinator, Primer and ECMO trained Physicians.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Graduate of an accredited School of Professional Nursing or a CoArc accredited School of Respiratory Care required; Bachelors preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Current Texas RN or RRT or CCP license

  • BLS required

  • PALS or NRP required

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Minimum two (2) years of Pediatric or Neonatal critical care experience required.

  • Ability to foster a collaborative, team-oriented environment

  • Ability to accomplish multiple tasks and prioritize activities

  • Ability to work collaboratively and cooperatively with an interdisciplinary team

  • Effective communication skills

  • Effective interpersonal skills

  • Ability to adapt to multiple and changing priorities in a high stress environment

  • Exceptional critical thinking skills

  • Ability to work flexible hours to meet patient care needs required

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Maintains ECMO pump and assists in patient care while patient is on ECMO.

  • Demonstrates knowledge of ECMO physiology.

  • Completes circuit assessment hourly as evidenced by documentation on the patient record.

  • Assesses the clinical status of the patient, lab data, and vital signs to make appropriate changes in patient care while utilizing the patient parameters and the ECMO orders.

  • Demonstrates the ability to communicate plan of the day, patient status, laboratory data and vital signs to the ECMO attending, ECMO Primer and Leadership team.

  • Executes medical orders within a time frame appropriate to the order.

  • Administers medications, IV therapy and blood products as ordered.

  • Performs scheduled and PRN bedside anticoagulation lab work, utilizing correct procedure and correlates results with patients’ status and relevant coagulation studies, making appropriate changes in anticoagulation therapy as evidenced by documentation in the patient record.

  • Implements appropriate interventions for emergency situations.

  • Evaluates patient for desired or adverse effects of medications, treatments and procedures.

  • Provides accurate and concise verbal report to health care team members.

  • Ensures that patient family members are aware of current status by relaying appropriate information.

  • Documents ECMO and patient care according to policy in eMHR.

  • Utilizes available communication tools to remain informed.

  • Utilizes ECMO Physicians, experienced Specialists, Primers, and the coordinator in decision-making and management of the ECMO patient.

  • Attends monthly ECMO Simulation Labs.

  • Successfully passes annual written ECMO Specialist exam with a passing score of 85%

  • Follows all Pediatric and Neonatal unit performance guidelines.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as a resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards of providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and our workforce.

  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Product Manager, Regology
description:
Senior Product Managers at Regology own a customer outcome end to end and lead the cross-functional work to deliver it. In this role you will own the strategy, roadmap, and results for our regulatory change and compliance product: helping regulated customers stay continuously compliant as the rules change, with far less manual effort and an evidence trail they can trust. Working in the Product Operating Model, you measure success by customer and business outcomes, not a feature list. You partner closely with designers, engineers, and legal subject-matter experts to discover and deliver AI-powered workflows customers trust, and you influence teams and product owners through clear thinking, data, and evidence rather than formal authority. You bring sound product judgment for AI and human-in-the-loop systems, ramp quickly in unfamiliar domains, and do your best work navigating ambiguity and building advantage that is hard to copy.

What you will do: ​

  • Owns the strategy, roadmap, and results for a complex, high-impact product area spanning regulatory change and compliance. Sets direction from customer and business outcomes, and sequences delivery across the regulatory change and compliance teams so the pieces come together as one experience for the customer.
  • Mentors product managers and contributes to team development, coaching on best practices, stakeholder management, and product thinking to elevate team performance. As one of Regology's senior product managers helping establish the Product Operating Model, models strong product thinking and shares practices that lift the wider team.
  • Owns the end-to-end product lifecycle, from validating the customer problem through launch and iteration. Builds feedback loops with customers and legal SMEs to refine the product and steadily earn the trust that lets more of the workflow run automatically.
  • Partners with Regology leadership to align product goals with company strategy, and secures the cross-functional commitment, including engineering capacity, to deliver them. Translates strategy into clear plans and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Uses product performance data and customer insight to drive decisions. Validates hypotheses with evidence and defines the metrics, such as reduced manual effort and adoption of automated steps, that show the product is working.
  • Drives cross-functional initiatives and resolves complex trade-offs. Protects the roadmap against competing pulls with a clear framework for what to prioritize and why, building agreement that holds without escalation.
  • Champions the voice of the regulated customer, including the compliance and legal teams who use the product. Turns subject-matter expertise and customer feedback into product decisions, and designs for trust: transparency, evidence, and knowing when a human must stay in the loop.
  • Develops business cases for new investment in the product. Quantifies customer value, market impact, and the resources needed, and frames the durable, hard-to-copy advantage the investment builds.

You need to have:

  • 7–10 years building and shipping successful technology-powered products as either a product manager, product designer, product delivery manager, engineer, data analyst, data scientist, or user researcher OR as a subject matter expert with product or technical proficiency.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery.
  • Experience driving product vision, building product roadmaps aligned with business goals, and defining and owning KPIs.
  • Experience with testing, product metrics, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience designing and delivering impactful demos/prototypes to showcase vision to stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgement to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative.
  • Strong communication skills and emotional intelligence.
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, stakeholders, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship.

Compensation Range:

$150,000.00-$180,000.00

Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process. Salary determination will be determined based on factors including but not limited to relevant experience, demonstrated skills related to the requirements of the role, education, certifications, and geographic location.


Equal Opportunity


Bloomberg Industry Group maintains a continuing policy of non-discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg Industry Group’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy or maternity/parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (“Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics (“Discrimination”).

title: Facilities Attendant - Closing August 26, 2026
description:
Port Hope is a uniquely attractive place to work, highlighted by the potential future development of the world's largest nuclear plant, which promises cutting-edge infrastructure and economic stability. This potential diversification into nuclear energy complements the area's strong economic base in agriculture and manufacturing, securing a stable job market. Employees will engage with advanced technology and industry experts, enhancing professional development. The community's warmth promotes work-life balance, supported by cultural festivals and heritage sites. Proximity to Toronto/GTA provides urban access, while the area's natural beauty invites outdoor recreation. High-quality education and healthcare, low crime rates, and a commitment to environmental sustainability make Port Hope an exceptional place to live and work, fostering both professional and personal growth.

The Facilities Attendant is responsible to assist with the maintenance of the facilities at the Jack Burger Sports Complex, including but not limited to general building custodial and maintenance duties. Responsible to address and respond to inquiries from the public and facility users and to ensure compliance with health and safety requirements in all aspects of their work.

  • High school diploma would be preferred.

  • Assist the Facilities Operator with ice flooding by moving nets, sweeping and shoveling snow and cleaning and filling ice resurfacer with water.

title: Vice President, Real Estate & Workplace Services
description:
When you join the team at Unum, you become part of an organization committed to helping you thrive.

Here, we work to provide the employee benefits and service solutions that enable employees at our client companies to thrive throughout life’s moments. And this starts with ensuring that every one of our team members enjoys opportunities to succeed both professionally and personally. To enable this, we provide:

  • Award-winning culture

  • Inclusion and diversity as a priority

  • Performance Based Incentive Plans

  • Competitive benefits package that includes: Health, Vision, Dental, Short & Long-Term Disability

  • Generous PTO (including paid time to volunteer!)

  • Mental health support

  • Career advancement opportunities

  • Student loan repayment options

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Flexible work environments

*All the benefits listed above are subject to the terms of their individual Plans.

And that’s just the beginning…

With 10,000 employees helping more than 39 million people worldwide, every role at Unum is meaningful and impacts the lives of our customers. Whether you’re directly supporting a growing family, or developing online tools to help navigate a difficult loss, customers are counting on the combined talents of our entire team. Help us help others, and join Team Unum today!

General Summary:

Unum is a leading international provider of workplace benefits and services, helping workers and their families thrive for more than 175 years. With more than 10,000 employees across the U.S. and abroad, we are driven by innovation, integrity, customer focus, and a commitment to creating a workplace where people can grow, contribute, and do meaningful work.

We are seeking a strategic, enterprise-minded Vice President of Real Estate & Workplace Services to lead the evolution of Unum’s physical workplace, real estate portfolio, facilities operations, workplace services, corporate security, environmental health and safety, hospitality, and related workplace technology platforms. This is a highly visible leadership role for a modern real estate and workplace executive who can connect business strategy, employee experience, operational resiliency, financial performance, and long-term portfolio value.

This leader will shape how Unum’s workplaces enable business performance, collaboration, productivity, safety, and belonging. The role oversees a diverse portfolio that includes offices, campuses, data centers, leased spaces, tenant-occupied spaces, and specialized environments, with primary focus on the U.S. portfolio and selected support for the global portfolio. The VP will partner closely with senior leaders across People, Finance, Legal, Technology, Operations, Risk, Sustainability, and business leadership to build workplace and real estate solutions that are practical, data-informed, financially disciplined, and future-ready.

What You’ll Lead

  • A multi-year real estate and workplace services strategy aligned to enterprise priorities, talent needs, employee experience, and financial objectives.

  • Portfolio strategy and optimization across owned, leased, tenant-occupied, and specialized environments, including site strategy, leasing, acquisitions, dispositions, consolidations, and capital investments.

  • Facilities and workplace operations that deliver safe, reliable, compliant, efficient, and employee-centered environments.

  • Workplace planning, design, construction, renovation, relocation, and capital project delivery grounded in business requirements and user experience.

  • Corporate security, emergency preparedness, critical event monitoring, incident response, access control, and duty of care programs.

  • Environmental health and safety programs, regulatory compliance, sustainability initiatives, energy and utilities management, and building performance reporting.

  • Hospitality and workplace experience services that support productivity, connection, wellbeing, and service excellence.

  • Technology, data, analytics, and reporting capabilities that improve occupancy insights, asset management, service delivery, cost transparency, resiliency, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • A forward-looking workplace and real estate strategy that supports business priorities and enhances the employee experience.

  • Clear governance, service standards, metrics, and reporting across the portfolio.

  • Improved portfolio utilization, cost discipline, operational reliability, and capital planning.

  • Strong vendor partnerships and service delivery models that are scalable, accountable, and cost-effective.

  • A high-performing, customer-centric team known for collaboration, operational excellence, and trusted partnership with senior leaders.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be a seasoned real estate and workplace services executive with the judgment, influence, and operating discipline to lead at enterprise scale. They will bring strong business and financial acumen, a customer-focused mindset, and experience translating complex operational, financial, risk, and workplace matters into clear recommendations for senior leaders.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, real estate, facilities management, business, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification preferred.

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience across corporate real estate, facilities, workplace services, construction, portfolio management, security, or related operational functions.

  • Experience leading complex teams and partner ecosystems, including service providers, brokers, landlords, contractors, consultants, security partners, and regulatory stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated financial leadership, including capital and operating budgets, business cases, P&L accountability, vendor economics, and portfolio cost optimization.

  • Strong executive presence, communication, influence, and change leadership skills.

  • Comfort using data, analytics, workplace technology, occupancy insights, and service metrics to drive better decisions and measurable outcomes.

Why Join Unum

At Unum, you’ll join a collaborative and inclusive workplace with a strong sense of purpose: helping the working world thrive. We invest in our people through development opportunities, competitive rewards, wellbeing programs, flexible benefits, paid time away, volunteer opportunities, and a culture that values innovation, accountability, integrity, and care for one another.

This is an opportunity to lead a function that directly shapes how employees experience work every day—and to build workplaces that are safe, resilient, efficient, welcoming, and ready for the future.

title: Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field. You’re part engineer, part technical advisor, and wholly accountable for making the mission succeed. The position requires a current or active U.S. Secret clearance.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure within customer and air-gapped environments.

  • Support RHEL/Linux-based platforms using Kubernetes, Podman, Docker, and Helm in operational environments.

  • Partner directly with customer engineering teams to integrate, test, and resolve infrastructure issues.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed to support deployments, upgrades, and mission execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Linux system administration, and Podman.

  • Experience deploying and managing containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Podman.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps, including GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

  • Active Secret clearance required

Nice to have

· Experience supporting classified DoD or Navy environments.

· Experience deploying infrastructure into air-gapped environments.

· Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or SigNoz.

· Experience supporting edge computing, maritime systems, or sensor platforms.

· Experience with AWS GovCloud or other secure cloud environments.

· Experience working directly with government customers in operational environments.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).


We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Project Manager I - Electrical
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for providing leadership and management to assigned projects in a safe, profitable, and timely manner. Manages the work in a manner consistent with standards of quality and integrity. Participates as requested in the marketing, estimating, bidding, and contract negotiation phases of the projects assigned. Primary function is to serve as champion for the execution of the work, preconstruction (when assigned) and construction. This position includes two "steps" (I, II), which provide for a progression of skill and experience. The Step I level is capable of less complex projects of $20 million and under in size and typically with 3 to 5 years of experience in this position. The Step II level is capable of medium scale projects of $20 - $50 million in size with typically 5 to 10 years of experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Champions the orderly, timely transition of projects from the estimating phase to the field. This transition shall include project review meetings, which encompass a review of contract requirements, general conditions, schedules, budgets, subcontracts, and purchase order agreements.
2. Completes close-out requirements and punch lists in a timely manner. Manages warranty callbacks quickly to maintain owner/client relationships.
3. Coordinates with the Project Superintendent the means and methods required for the successful and profitable execution of the work. Reviews and monitors manpower, equipment, and material resources to accomplish this goal.
4. Establishes the project charter and a comprehensive project management plan (PMP) including the project scope management plan, procurement plan, environmental plan, time management plan, financial plan, quality management and safety plans and risk management plan to ensure successful project execution. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of the change management process.
5. Has overall responsibility for project success, including profitability, safety, schedule, quality and customer satisfaction as well as responsibility for personnel decisions that impact the project. Plans, acquires, reviews, develops and manages the project
6. Manages all billings to ensure timely submission of payment applications and collection of payments from the owner in order to maintain a positive cash flow position. Manages the overall payment process and follows all prompt pay laws with the subcontractors.
7. Manages the development of the overall CPM schedule and assures coordination with the Project Superintendent and the procurement schedule with the Project Engineer. Ensures that as many levels of detailed schedules are prepared and distributed as required to support the project schedule. Pays special attention to prevention and documentation of delays or changes. Ensures that the Lean process is effectively utilized for all scheduling activities.
8. Participates in preparation and review of estimates with attention to the following: adherence to cost control system, equipment requirements and utilization, constructability, formwork, materials, manpower, general conditions, schedule, insurance, etc.
9. Participates in the business development process including client contacts, relationships, proposals, presentations, and negotiations for selected projects.
10. Prevents claims, identify potential claims, quantify, mitigate/resolve the effects of those that do occur on a timely basis.
11. Responsible for the preparation of Monthly Progress Report including accurate cost projections.
12. Responsible for the timely preparation and execution of purchase order agreements and subcontracts with respect to insurance certificates, bonds, and the appropriate lien waivers.
13. Responsible for understanding and administering prime contract terms and conditions, contract documents, subcontract agreements, purchase order agreements, insurance, etc. Oversees and ensures all the processes involved in budgeting and controlling costs so that the project can be completed within the approved budget. Demonstrates business acumen within area of responsibility.
14. Reviews, negotiates, and executes all change orders, supplements, and cost control budget adjustments.

Minimum Job Requirements

1. Experience in preconstruction and in managing construction projects.
2. Four-year construction-related degree or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience.
3. Proficient use of all Microsoft Office Suite programs
4. Thorough knowledge of contract documents, materials, equipment utilization, scheduling systems, productivity analysis, construction operations, and cash flow procedures is essential.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

1. Ability to wear personal protective equipment is required (including but not limited to; steel toed shoes, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, hardhat, vest, etc.)
2. May reach above shoulder heights and below the waist on a frequent basis
3. May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis
4. May use telephone, computer system, email, or other electronic devices on a limited basis to communicate with internal and external customers or vendors
5. Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures
6. Occasionally will climb stairs, ladders, etc.
7. Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis
8. Will interact with people frequently during a shift/work day
9. Will lift, push or pull objects on an occasional basis
10. Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift/work day.

Safety Level

Safety-Sensitive

Note: Jobs with the Safety-Sensitive designation are those that include tasks or duties that the employer reasonably believes could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others such as operating a vehicle, operating equipment, operating machinery or power tools, repairing/maintaining the operation of any vehicle/equipment, the handling/disposal/transport of hazardous materials, or the handling/treatment/disposal of potentially flammable/combustible materials.

About Type One Energy

Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. Established in 2019 and venture-backed in 2023, the company is led by a team of globally recognized fusion scientists with a strong track record of building state-of-the-art stellarator fusion machines, together with veteran business leaders experienced in scaling companies and commercializing energy technologies.

If you are searching for the best new ideas and share our vision, join us as a “Software Engineer- Embedded/Firmware”.

Type One Energy is committed to community engagement in the development and deployment of its clean energy technology. For more information, visit www.typeoneenergy.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Responsibilities

Your role in the mission:

The Software Engineer – Embedded / Firmware will design and develop low-level software and firmware for instrumentation and control (I&C) systems supporting stellarator devices and associated equipment. This role focuses on embedded platforms, FPGA-based systems, real-time operating environments, and hardware integration.

The successful candidate will work closely with electrical, controls, and systems engineers to enable reliable operation of safety-critical and high-performance hardware. You will:

  • Develop low-level embedded software and firmware, including I&C device drivers
  • Design and implement FPGA control software using hardware description languages
  • Develop, customize, and maintain embedded operating systems such as real-time Linux and PetaLinux
  • Support printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) development in collaboration with hardware teams
  • Perform hardware bring-up, validation, and debugging of new embedded platforms
  • Implement and maintain software build systems, testing, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Integrate firmware with higher-level control systems and applications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in embedded software or firmware development

  • FPGA development experience using VHDL and/or Verilog
  • Experience with standard embedded peripherals and communication protocols, including:
    • ADC, DAC
    • I²C, SPI
    • Ethernet / TCP/IP
    • Serial interfaces and low-level hardware communication

title: Registered Nurse (RN) Quality Analyst (QA)
description:
Registered Nurse (RN), Quality Analyst (QA)

Job Type: Full-Time | Days

Your experience matters

Southern Tennessee Regional Health System - Lawrenceburg is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a Quality Analyst RN joining our team, you're embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

More about our team

How you'll contribute

An Quality Analyst RN who excels in this role:

  • Assists with developing specific departmental goals, standards, and objectives which directly support the strategic plan and vision of the organization.
  • Assists the director in managing staff relations including performance management, staff satisfaction, and conflict management.
  • Performs and oversees scheduling, staff development, recruitment, payroll, and student engagements.
  • Assists the director by making presentations at various meetings including Quality and Safety Committee, New Employee Orientation, and others.
  • May assist the director in monitoring departmental budgets, regulatory compliance, departmental contracts, and vendor relations.
  • Determines and justifies needs for systems/equipment/supplies purchases, monitors usage, and oversees proper working order and/or stock supplies.
  • Assesses the quality of patient care delivered and coordinates patient care services with patients, staff, physicians, and other departments.
  • May provide patient care when necessary.
  • Creates and fosters an environment that encourages professional growth.
  • Integrates evidence-based practices into operations and clinical protocols.

Why join us

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.
  • Financial Protection & PTO: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.
  • Financial & Career Growth: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.
  • Employee Well-being: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).
  • Professional Development: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

What we're looking for

Applicants should have a current Tennessee or compact state RN license and possess an associate’s degree from an accredited nursing school. Additional requirements include:

  • Certifications: Basic Life Support (BLS) within 30 days of hire, Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) within 30 days of hire, Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) within 30 days of hire.

  • Required Skills: Requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgment and the ability to work with minimal supervision. Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action.

  • Experience: Three (3) to five (5) years diverse clinical practice in an acute care environment required. Previous performance improvement and/or large scale project management experience required. Demonstrated progressive leadership skills required.

  • Licenses: Must be a licensed Registered Nurse with the State of Tennessee or a licensed Registered Nurse from a Compact State with the proper Tennessee paperwork filed within 30 days of hire.

  • Education: BSN preferred. Baccalaureate degree in nursing (BSN) required. Master's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Management, or Quality strongly preferred

More about Southern Tennessee Regional Health System - Lawrenceburg

STRHS-Lawrenceburg, formerly Crockett Hospital, is a 99-bed, acute care facility located in Lawrenceburg, Tennessee, 85 miles south of Nashville.

We have been providing the best healthcare in Lawrence County and surrounding counties in Southern Middle Tennessee since 1974. We expanded the facility and services in 1991 with the addition of an Outpatient Surgery Unit, a state-of-the-art 24-hour physician-staffed Emergency Department, and an Intensive Care Unit. The hospital opened a 10-bed Physical Rehabilitation Unit in 1997, and a Women's Health Center in 1999. Diagnostic imaging services include in-house MRI, Nuclear Medicine, CT, X-ray, Digital Mammography and Ultrasound. The Rehabilitation Unit provides Physical, Occupational and Speech Therapies. In 2009, a $5.6 million construction was completed which expanded the Emergency Department, Outpatient Surgery Unit and Registration area.

STRHS-Lawrenceburg is dedicated to providing our friends and neighbors with the healthcare they need close to home. What makes us special is our staff Our healthcare professionals are well-trained, dedicated, and above all else, caring. STRHS-Lawrenceburg is fully accredited by the Joint Commission and the Society of Chest Pain Centers.

title: Senior Product Manager, Product Services & Integrations
description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.


As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.


Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Senior Product Manager, Product Services, plays a key role in defining and delivering customer-driven enhancements, fintech integrations, and implementation commitments across Alkami’s Digital Banking platform. Operating within a fast-paced Product Services environment, this role partners directly with Financial Institutions, sales teams, third-party vendors, and engineering teams to evaluate opportunities, define solutions, and drive successful delivery of client and prospect commitments.

Working within established Product Services processes and delivery frameworks, you are responsible for translating business needs into clear product and technical requirements, managing priorities across a diverse portfolio of initiatives, and driving execution from discovery through delivery. Unlike traditional product management roles focused on strategic product roadmaps, this role is centered on customer-requested enhancements, third-party integrations, implementation commitments, and delivery of solutions that support customer success and business growth.

Success in this role requires strong technical acumen, customer engagement skills, and a broad understanding of the digital banking ecosystem. You will work across multiple product areas and fintech partners, collaborating with clients, vendors, and engineering teams to remove blockers, accelerate decision-making, and deliver high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, urgency, and accountability, consistently driving customer commitments to successful outcomes in a high-velocity environment.



Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and define customer-requested enhancements, fintech integrations, and sales commitments, partnering with clients, vendors, sales teams, and internal stakeholders to determine scope, feasibility, technical approach, and business value.

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Product Services initiatives, from requirements gathering and solution definition through development, testing, implementation, and launch.

  • Drive delivery velocity by maintaining momentum across customer, vendor, and engineering stakeholders, ensuring decisions are made quickly and execution remains focused on customer commitments.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer commitments, proactively driving alignment, resolving ambiguity, escalating issues when necessary, and ensuring successful outcomes.

  • Manage and prioritize a portfolio of client commitments, sales gap commitments, and strategic product support initiatives, balancing customer needs, contractual obligations, business priorities, and engineering capacity.

  • Identify, communicate, and proactively remove delivery blockers related to vendor readiness, environment setup, test data availability, technical specifications, integration dependencies, and implementation processes.

  • Serve as the product lead for customer-facing integrations involving APIs, single sign-on (SSO), eDocs, check images, Remote Deposit Capture (RDC), authentication providers, and other third-party fintech solutions.

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to translate business requirements into clear functional and technical requirements, ensuring successful execution and delivery quality.

  • Work directly with Financial Institutions, fintech partners, and third-party technology vendors to gather requirements, validate technical capabilities, resolve implementation challenges, and drive rapid decision-making throughout the delivery lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with strategic product teams to support delivery of customer commitments and provide product expertise across a broad range of digital banking capabilities and integrations.

  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to customers, sales teams, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and informed decision-making.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Alkami’s Digital Banking ecosystem, integration patterns, fintech partner landscape, and implementation best practices to support effective solution design and delivery decisions.

  • Continuously improve Product Services processes, integration delivery practices, and implementation approaches to improve speed, predictability, and customer outcomes.

Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience

5–8 years of experience in Product Management, Product Services, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Implementation Management, Business Analysis, or a closely related customer-facing software delivery role.

Candidates should demonstrate experience:

  • Operating in fast-paced, customer-facing delivery environments where execution, urgency, and accountability are critical to success.

  • Leading customer-facing software initiatives involving engineering teams, third-party vendors, and enterprise customers.

  • Managing complex integrations, implementation commitments, feature enhancements, or software delivery projects from concept through production.

  • Gathering and documenting business and technical requirements.

  • Managing competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder relationships.

Education Level

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus but not required.

Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications

Required

  • Product Services & Delivery Leadership: Proven success leading customer-facing integrations, implementation commitments, enhancement delivery, or professional services initiatives. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, drive execution, and deliver customer outcomes in fast-paced environments.

  • Technical Integration Acumen: Strong understanding of APIs, authentication technologies, single sign-on (SSO), data exchange frameworks, and enterprise software integrations. Able to engage directly with customer technical teams, fintech vendors, and engineers to identify issues, evaluate solutions, and accelerate delivery.

  • Customer & Vendor Engagement: Experience working directly with customers, Financial Institutions, and third-party technology vendors to gather requirements, validate solutions, manage expectations, and resolve implementation challenges.

  • Requirements Gathering & Solution Definition: Skilled at eliciting business needs, documenting requirements, identifying dependencies, and defining practical solutions that balance customer value, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

  • Digital Banking & Fintech Ecosystem Knowledge: Broad understanding of digital banking products, fintech integrations, and third-party service providers. Able to quickly learn and support multiple product areas and integration patterns.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Communicates effectively with customers, vendors, engineering teams, sales teams, and leadership. Builds trust, drives alignment, and facilitates informed decision-making across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Urgency, Ownership & Agency: Demonstrates a strong bias for action and accountability. Comfortable making informed decisions, driving alignment, escalating issues, and maintaining delivery momentum in situations involving ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple stakeholders.

  • Problem Solving & Delivery Focus: Comfortable navigating complex delivery challenges involving multiple teams, vendors, and dependencies. Demonstrates strong ownership and persistence in resolving issues and achieving customer commitments.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses qualitative and quantitative information to prioritize work, evaluate tradeoffs, assess risks, and improve delivery outcomes.

Preferred

  • Experience with digital banking platforms, fintech products, financial services, or enterprise SaaS solutions.

  • Experience supporting integrations involving SSO providers, eDocs, check image providers, RDC solutions, payment platforms, authentication providers, financial data exchange technologies, or similar fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience with SSO technologies such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication frameworks.

  • Experience working directly with third-party technology vendors and external engineering teams.

  • Experience in Product Services, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Technical Consulting, or implementation-focused organizations.

  • Familiarity with vendor onboarding, certification processes, sandbox testing, implementation planning, and production readiness activities.

  • Experience managing contractual customer commitments, implementation milestones, or delivery-based customer engagements.

  • Experience driving process improvements that improve delivery speed, predictability, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

The salary range for this position is: $100,000 - $126,000

Cool Things to Know

Not Just Any Company: Alkami has an awesome diverse and inclusive environment. We have a FUN culture and offer great benefits, including remote-first environment, unlimited paid time off, 401(k) with employer match, and more.

title: Operator-Hvy Eq Journeyperson
description:

Safely operates a variety of heavy equipment, not limited to; backhoes, excavators, dozers, loaders, graders, haul trucks, dump trucks, water trucks. Will be responsible for preventative maintenance and pre-shift walk around of the assigned equipment to assure safe operation.

Safety-Sensitive
