title: Robotics Test Engineer
description:
Aescape is a New York-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes-driven practice.

Powered by real-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. 

Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. 

Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.

Aescape is looking for a Robotics Test Engineer to be the technical conscience of Aescape's reliability and manufacturing test program, owning test protocols for bench and life testing on complex robotic mechatronic systems through EVT, DVT and PVT and into mass production, spanning mechanical, electrical and software interfaces. You will build on the existing reliability lab at Aescape HQ and partner directly with our contract manufacturer and key suppliers to implement and project manage tests, fixtures and test software on the factory floor. You will sit within Operations, working closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical and Software Engineering. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

This role is hybrid, based out of our NYC office in Chelsea.

What You’ll Do

  • Reliability & Manufacturing Test Program Ownership: Own the end-to-end reliability and manufacturing test program through NPI and into mass production. Define what gets tested and write the test SOPs, protocols and specifications (scope, equipment requirements, sampling rates, pass/fail criteria), validating against the Engineering Requirements Document (ERD). Manage the test fixture build process with suppliers or a third party, and coordinate and run or oversee testing across HQ, the CM and third-party facilities, ensuring test data is uploaded and reviewed promptly, with failures triaged immediately in partnership with the supplier. Analyze the data and report results to Engineering and Operations for approval.

  • HQ Reliability Lab & Environmental/Life Testing: Maintain and develop the existing Aescape HQ reliability lab, commissioning equipment and fixtures as needed and ensuring calibration and lab discipline. Plan and execute environmental and life testing in-house or co-ordinate via a third-party lab, aligned to standards such as MIL-STD-810, IEC 60068, IPC and HALT/HASS where appropriate.

  • Factory & Supplier Test Implementation: Define and deploy reliability and manufacturing tests and test scripts at our contract manufacturer and key suppliers, project managing test fixture development by the CM and suppliers through to implementation.

  • Failure Analysis & Root Cause: Lead failure analysis on parts and assemblies from HQ, third-party lab, and supplier testing; work with Mechanical, Electrical and Software Engineering to drive issues to root cause and close out corrective actions back into the design and test protocol.

  • International Travel: ~10% international travel required (to CM and supplier sites).

What You’ll Bring

  • Education & Experience: BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Test or a related engineering discipline with a minimum of 5 years of reliability and test engineering experience in a hardware product environment (robotics, consumer electronics, or similar).

  • Reliability Test Mindset: You approach every test with a clear question in mind, what could fail, how, and when, and hunt failures to root cause, staying with them until corrective actions are verified, not just identified.

  • Coding Fluency: Strong Python (or equivalent) for test automation, data parsing and analysis; able to write production-quality test scripts and data-processing pipelines independently.

  • Process-Driven & Detail-Oriented: Highly disciplined about following, documenting and improving processes; writes clear procedures, test SOPs, specifications and reports, and validates tests against engineering requirements documentation; adheres precisely to established test protocols and catches inconsistencies others miss.

  • Hands-On Lab Engineering: Comfortable specifying, commissioning and operating reliability test equipment including life rigs, data acquisition systems, oscilloscopes and electrical loads. Able to build or oversee the build of test fixtures.

  • Contract Manufacturer & Supplier Partnership: Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to implement and project manage tests, test fixtures and test software on the factory floor.

  • Statistical Rigour & Sampling: Strong grasp of statistical analysis including distributions, control limits, capability studies (Cpk), Gauge R&R, DOE, hypothesis testing, sampling rates/plans (AQL) and accelerated-life models (Weibull). Working knowledge of reliability test standards (e.g. MIL-STD-810, IEC 60068, HALT/HASS). Use data rather than opinion to make pass/fail and design decisions.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong verbal and written skills for presenting test findings and providing clear documentation of work.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast-moving startup; willing to take on tasks outside your core role when required.

  • 3D Modelling: Experience with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD tool for fixture and test rig design review.

  • LabVIEW: Proficiency preferred (CLAD or higher).

  • Work Onsite: Ability to work in our NYC office 3 days a week.

  • International Travel: Ability to travel internationally to CM and supplier sites (~10%)

What’s In It For You

  • Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery

  • The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living

  • Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun!

  • 100% employer-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents

  • Flexible time off

  • Quarterly Wellness Days - everyone fully unplugs

  • Generous parental leave

  • Complimentary OneMedical membership

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Home office budget

  • Annual stipend for professional development

  • Working late? Dinner is on us

  • Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends & family

Compensation: Base salary range of $140,000 - $170,000 annually, plus discretionary annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law.

Begin Your Aescape Career Journey

At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team.

YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.

title: Associate Director, Acceleration & Insights Operations
description:
Job Description

Serves as the day-to-day bridge between brand teams and the Patient Support CoE for assigned therapeutic areas, owning TA-specific insight generation, patient journey mapping, and implementation support for critical capabilities. Accountable for translating designs and patient-facing capability concepts into operational and scalable solutions — ensuring new capabilities fit into the broader architecture or new capabilities deploy without disrupting live patient support operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Understand and pressure test TA-specific patient support designs, including workflow assumptions, operational feasibility, and implementation sequencing
  • Serve as day-to-day bridge between brand and CoE teams, enabling integration and one-voice execution across assigned TA
  • Support end-to-end patient strategy execution along with the Patient Support Strategy Lead and interaction models across Access, Affordability, and Adherence, supporting agile pod delivery through input gathering, execution follow-through, issue tracking and resolution
  • Support end-to-end implementation process for capabilities, including scoping, sequencing, and operational configuration — translating documentation (design intent, success criteria, technical requirements) into operational specs for hub vendors and internal teams
  • Identify and resolve implementation blockers — including vendor capacity constraints, data integration gaps, CRM configuration issues, and compliance requirements — and escalate to the right stakeholders for resolution
  • Maintain implementation playbooks that codify repeatable deployment processes, reducing time and risk of future capability rollouts
  • Conduct TA-specific insight generation, including patient-specific market research and HCP feedback as needed along with the brand patient strategy team

Points of Collaboration:

  • Patient Experience and Acceleration Lead: Reporting line; aligning TA-level insights and implementation priorities to vertical strategy and CoE roadmap
  • Patient Access, Affordability, and Adherence Operations Leads: Coordinating deployment timing, vendor impact, and capability sequencing across operational verticals
  • Direct-to-Patient Platform Lead: Thinking through integration with DTP and other emerging channel capabilities as relevant
  • BU Patient Support Strategy lead (SP&ID, Oncology, Rare Disease): Receiving graduated capabilities and brand-specific configuration needs; aligning implementation timing to launch milestones
  • DHH (Data, Hub and Hub Technology): Data integration, CRM configuration, and platform changes required by new capability deployments
  • Hub and Technology Vendors: Translating capability requirements into vendor SOW amendments, configuration changes, and testing protocols
  • Legal, Privacy, and Compliance: Identifying and resolving compliance requirements that create implementation blockers

Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) and 5+ years in biopharma patient services, program implementation, or operations, with experience deploying new capabilities across hub, access, affordability, and adherence
  • Prior experience supporting patient support design and execution, including insight generation, pressure-testing, and implementation support across brand and CoE functions
  • Strong understanding of patient support ecosystems, including hub, specialty pharmacy, access, CRM, and patient journey interactions; familiarity with where new capability deployments could create operational disruption
  • Strong understanding of primary care, specialty care and complex therapy archetypes, including patient needs, access barriers, and support-model differences
  • Experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative inputs into actionable recommendations, including patient, HCP, operational, and program insights; ability to translate findings into operational specs that vendors and hub partners can act on
  • Experience working with hub vendors on SOW amendments, configuration changes, and testing protocols; comfort managing a small, execution-focused team measured by what gets deployed, not designed

title: Project Leader I – R&D Fabric Care OEM Products
description:
Job Description

Apply by August 23rd

Power a world of ideas.

Curitiba-PR

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

About the role:

For more than one hundred years now, the Electrolux Group has been working at shaping living for the better, developing products that meet people’s demands in terms of taste, care and wellbeing. But as consumer needs and wants continue to evolve, we have even more work to do. It's our R&D teams that ensure our company stays at the forefront of innovation, investigating and making use of the latest technology in order to enable our company to keep delivering outstanding experiences.

What you’ll do:

The Project Leader I will work in the development of low complexity OEM projects and technical solutions with the right cost, quality and time to market within organization of Latin America Fabric Care R&D. The Project Leader role includes bringing technical specification based on consumer needs and combine that with the industrial design requirements into a cost-efficient product easy to manufacture with the required quality level. To do this Project Leader needs to cooperate closely with international suppliers, Quality, Laboratory, Sourcing, Design, Marketing, After Sales, Supply Chain and other project functions.

In detail, you will:

• Plan and follow up developing activities. (time and resource plans, product cost, action plans, system description etc.)

• Report progress, risks and deviation from project plan.

• Assure that technically feasible, well-verified and defined solutions are chosen for the product.

• Assure that appropriate activities are performed according to EPM gate.

• Lead cross-functional teams through influence and project management, without direct people management responsibility.

• Create technical documentation (labels artworks, user manual, product specification) and ensure it is updated and available for other functions.

• Evaluate test results and implement actions to fulfill specifications.

• Approve technical documentation and archive them correctly in PLM system.

• Support Marketing, Design, supplier, Laboratory, Sourcing, Quality and other functions involved in the project with product know-how.

• Prepare, consolidate and present project Check Points material to Steering Committee.

As part of the culture of continuous improvement, you will be involved in Lean Thinking projects and activities (EMS/EAI).

Who you are:

• University degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Production or related area)

• Solid product development experience, mainly mechanical design

• Able to balance proactive planning with quick response to emerging issues, you work efficiently

and flexibly to deliver results

• Knowledge of product development processes, product lifecycle management, and project management methodologies

• Understanding of engineering principles, product validation processes, manufacturing methods, and quality systems

• Advanced English is a must

• Spanish is a plus

Where you’ll be:

You will be based at the Guabirotuba plant in Curitiba. One of the focal points for all Latin American Electrolux operations, this plant is the base for over 3200 collaborators, all focused on transforming the way the world lives by shaping lives for the better with their work.

In order to create a culture of inclusion and care for everyone's wellbeing, we offer the following benefits:

  • Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment (4x1);
  • Profit share bonus;
  • Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services;
  • Family-friendly benefits such as extended paternity leave (4 weeks);
  • Insurance policy plan;
  • Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path.

As part of Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Sentris Engineer- Classified Services
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Enterprise Information Services is responsible for Aerospace’s classified and unclassified enterprise IT environment. As a Sentris Engineer- Classified Services (Systems Administration Staff V), you will oversee server and endpoint infrastructure that supports some of the company’s most critical missions. You will join a company that develops cutting edge solutions for our nation’s most complex space enterprise and mission assurance challenges. You will become part of the Classified Services Department, which is responsible for the development and sustainment of classified networks for the Aerospace Corporation.

Work Model

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, onsite at our location in Chantilly, VA.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Deploy, sustain, and tune enterprise Microsoft Windows and Linux servers
  • Support and apply best practices for critical enterprise infrastructure systems
  • Coordinate with customers in pursuit of continuous service improvement
  • Ensure the overall health, performance, and capacity of critical enterprise infrastructure services
  • Implement and sustain automation to improve service operability and reduce Mean Time to Repair
  • Harden, scan, and remediate infrastructure to ensure compliance with security best practices including the application of DISA STIGs where appropriate
  • Provide enterprise Windows and Linux server troubleshooting, tier 2 and 3 support

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 10 or more years of relevant experience with, Master’s Degree with 8 or more years of relevant experience
  • Current TS/SCI clearance with SSBI and CI polygraph
  • Current DoD 8570 compliant certification
  • Extensive experience with Windows and Linux systems administration, including provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and security hardening for classified enterprise environments
  • Experience automating repetitive tasks with scripting or DevOps tools
  • Experience implementing and maintaining Active Directory and MS Exchange
  • Knowledgeable of DISA STIGs and experience implementing security controls
  • Strong written/oral communication, team player, organized, good time management, and flexible to changing needs

description:

description:
Amentum is seeking a Psychological Operations (PYSOP) Planner to provide research, planning and analysis support to U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM).

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Conduct research, both unclassified and classified, on various topics supporting ongoing and emerging operational concepts and plans, distilling that research into recommendations for PSYOP integration into OPLANS, CONPLANS and contingency planning.

The Leo Network Observability team designs, implements, and operates network visualization, monitoring, and analytics services for Leo Network Operations. Our scope spans satellites, customer terminals, gateways, and terrestrial network infrastructure that connects into public and private networks. We deliver user interfaces, agentic AI agents, temporal graph neural network outage prediction, and data streaming solutions.

As a front-end engineer on this team, you will collaborate with a mix of software and network engineers and scientists to create user experiences that increase our end-to-end ability to deliver high quality, secure and fault tolerant software used in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites, ground gateways, and Consumer/Enterprise class customer terminals. - Work with peer teams and customers to design and develop visualization solutions that fulfill the business needs.
- Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to deliver highly-available solutions.
- Build and contribute to reusable UI components and design-system patterns that keep the experience consistent across surfaces.
- Own the end-to-end quality of the features you deliver: write unit, component, and integration tests, and validate behavior across browsers and devices.
- Participate actively in code and design reviews, and contribute to technical design discussions within your team.
- Provide operational support for your team's services, helping identify and resolve the root cause of issues.
- Lead and mentor other Front-End Engineers with design planning, implementation, and maintenance.

A day in the life
You will collaborate with various stakeholders to create the world’s most innovative products. You will understand operational challenges and existing blind-spots for network observability and be part of a team of scientists and engineers developing tools that fill these gaps. You will join our development and integration efforts and deliver high qualify software for production environments.

title: Applied Scientist II, Sponsored Products Deep Research Agent
description:
We are looking for a passionate Applied Scientist to help pioneer the next generation of agentic AI applications for Amazon advertisers. In this role, you will design agentic architectures, develop tools and datasets, and contribute to building systems that can autonomously research advertiser portfolios, reason over campaign performance data, and produce actionable optimization strategies without human direction. You will work at the forefront of applied AI, developing methods for multi-step analytical reasoning, ML-backed bid simulation, and preference optimization, while helping create evaluation frameworks that ensure accuracy, reliability, and trust at scale.

You will work backwards from the needs of advertisers—delivering customer-facing products that directly help them create, optimize, and grow their campaigns. Beyond building models, you will advance the agent ecosystem by experimenting with and applying core primitives such as tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning, and adaptive preference-driven behavior. This role requires working independently on ambiguous technical problems, collaborating closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers to bring innovative solutions into production.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build agents for the Sponsored Products campaign research.
- Design and implement advanced model and agent optimization techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, instruction tuning and preference optimization (e.g., DPO/IPO).
- Curate datasets for model training and evaluation, and develop tools for agentic workflows (e.g., MCP tool definitions, data retrieval, simulation endpoints).
- Build evaluation pipelines for agent workflows, including automated benchmarks, multi-step reasoning tests, and safety guardrails.
- Develop agentic architectures (e.g., CoT, ToT, ReAct) that integrate planning, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning.
- Prototype and iterate on multi-agent orchestration frameworks and workflows.
- Collaborate with peers across engineering and product to bring scientific innovations into production.
- Stay current with the latest research in LLMs, RL, and agent-based AI, and translate findings into practical applications.

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

The Campaign Research Agent team within Sponsored Products and Brands is building an autonomous deep-research agent that investigates Sponsored Products advertisers end-to-end — synthesizing campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and market dynamics into actionable strategic briefs. At the scale of 1.6MM advertisers, the complexity of diverse business contexts, product portfolios, and competitive landscapes creates both a massive technical challenge and a transformative opportunity: a research agent that can reason deeply and produce grounded, evidence-backed analysis can have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon's retail ecosystem.

Our vision is to build a highly personalized, context-aware research system that leverages LLMs together with tools such as bid simulation models, competitive intelligence pipelines, and multi-source data retrieval to autonomously investigate advertisers and surface prioritized opportunities. This agentic framework operates a structured reasoning loop, querying heterogeneous data sources, forming and validating hypotheses using ML-backed simulation models, and synthesizing findings into a prioritized action brief where every claim is grounded in evidence. We collaborate closely with stakeholders across Ad Console, Sales, and Marketing to deliver data-grounded analytical briefs spanning portfolio-level strategy to granular keyword and targeting recommendations. Our work is grounded in state-of-the-art agent architectures, tool integration, multi-step reasoning frameworks, and model customization (including fine-tuning, MCP, and preference optimization)

title: AVP, Claims Quality Assurance & Performance Management
description:
Company

Farm Family

Farm Family specializes in farm and ranch protection with a wide range of products including flexible farm packages, business owner policies, commercial package, workers compensation, commercial auto and select personal auto coverage. Farm Family is a leader in serving the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic markets and is pursuing growth across the U.S. The Farm Family entities are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Group Holdings Inc.


Job Description

Business Title(s): AVP, Claims Quality Assurance & Performance Management

Employment Type: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: In-Office | Any employee, in any Clearbrook office, can apply for this opportunity and stay in their current location.

Summary:

Clearbrook is looking to align the Quality Assurance function across both Argo and Farm Family, while keeping the function aligned with the individual lines of business underwritten by each business. The Quality Assurance function is referred to as Quality Improvement in Farm Family currently.

The AVP, Claims Quality Assurance & Performance Management is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Farm Family’s claims QA program. The role reports to the Clearbrook QA Lead, with a dotted-line to the Chief Claims Officer, Farm Family at the enterprise level. The AVP will work closely with Farm Family and Clearbrook senior leadership to align Farm Family’s QA program with other Clearbrook entities while positioning Farm Family as a leading example of data-driven claims QA. The role’s core function is claims quality assurance, including file audit methodology, claim handling evaluation, scoring, governance, feedback, and corrective action. In addition, the role will expand QA output into a broader claims performance management capability by linking QA findings to Guidewire data, KPI trends, process assessment analytics, adjuster and manager performance evaluation, and senior leadership reporting across Farm Family’s claims organization. We are looking to fill this role in either our Albany, Omaha, or Springfield office.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of Quality Assurance professionals (currently referred to as the Quality Improvement team) to administer the Quality Assurance Program at Farm Family. This involves:
    • Create and maintain a positive working relationship with all direct reports, peers, and other department managers to ensure the Quality Assurance Team adds value and meets or exceeds the needs of internal stakeholders and are compliant with set expectations.
    • Support the Quality Assurance selection process to retain Quality Assurance professionals that consistently demonstrate exceptional customer service and appropriate technical expertise, maturity and a professional commitment to excellence.
    • Conduct Development Reviews and engage direct reports in developmental and skill building opportunities.
    • Train and mentor staff.
    • Act as a role model demonstrating belief in, and commitment to, the aspiration values of Clearbrook, continuing to build and lead a value-based organization committed to long-term success.
  • QA Strategy, Governance & Compliance
    • Partner with the Farm Family’s Chief Claims Officer and Clearbrook enterprise QA leadership to align Farm Family’s QA program with enterprise standards.
    • Design and implement QA audit methodology, scoring models, and sampling strategies.
    • Evaluate claim handling quality, including coverage, reserving, documentation, and claim strategy.
    • Develop structured feedback loops to claims handlers and leadership.
    • Ensure QA supports compliance, governance, and audit readiness requirements.
  • Claims Performance Intelligence & Analytics
    • Partner with leadership to define and align claims KPIs.
    • Build reporting and analytics that use QA results as the foundation for evaluating claim quality, operational effectiveness, and KPI performance.
    • Serve as a key claims performance intelligence link for senior leadership by connecting QA audit results, claims data, KPI reporting, and process assessment findings.
    • Translate audit findings into training, process improvements, performance actions, and leadership decision-making support.
    • Deliver executive-level reporting on claim quality, claim adjuster performance, operational trends, and overall Farm Family business performance indicators.
  • Operational Excellence, Technology & Continuous Improvement
    • Oversee Guidewire system utilization audits and data integrity assessments.
    • Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend corrective actions.
    • Lead integration of AI-enabled QA tools and automation solutions.
    • Drive continuous improvement through enhanced audit processes, technology-enabled insights, and operational effectiveness initiatives.

Qualifications / Experience Required:

  • A specialized knowledge of managing Quality Assurance programs typically achieved through:
    • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, advanced degree, CPCU, AIC, SCLA, Six Sigma/Lean, PMP, Prosci, Guidewire certification, or similar insurance, claims, audit, process improvement, project management, or change management credential preferred.
    • 7 years of progressive P&C claims experience, with strong technical claim handling, coverage, reserving, litigation management, and claim strategy expertise. Prior leadership experience building, rebuilding, or materially enhancing a claims quality assurance, claim file audit, or claims performance management program
  • Must have good business acumen (i.e. understand how an insurance company works and makes money, including how this role impacts both Farm Family and our customers’ ability to be profitable).
  • Recognized as a leader within the organization that provides advice and guidance to others.
  • A team builder, someone who understands that success is dependent upon the performance of the team and not individual team members. Creates strong morale and spirit within the team: shares wins and celebrates success as a team
  • Ability to establish mentoring relationships with key employees and participates in the development of succession and training plans for critical positions.
  • Ability to identify and resolve conflicts in a timely, objective manner, using sound judgment to reach a solution.
  • Strong focus on selection – determined to have the right people who do the best job.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate QA findings into measurable claim quality improvements, operational changes, training priorities, and performance management actions
  • Strong understanding of claims KPIs, audit scoring models, sampling methodologies, performance analytics, and executive-level claims reporting
  • Significant experience with Guidewire ClaimsCenter, including system utilization, data integrity, claim documentation standards, and reporting requirements
  • Proven ability to use data-driven insights to evaluate claim adjuster performance and identify broader claim operational and business performance trends
  • Experience developing structured feedback loops to LOB leaders, claims management, and claim handlers to ensure QA findings result in timely corrective action and sustained improvement
  • Experience developing and presenting training materials based on QA audit results, claim handling trends, system utilization gaps, and identified performance opportunities
  • Experience partnering with senior claims leadership, LOB leaders, business leaders, compliance, operations, IT/data teams, and training resources to implement enterprise-wide improvements
  • Strong change management skills, including the ability to reestablish governance, drive adoption, influence stakeholders, and improve consistency across claim teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear executive summaries, dashboards, findings reports, and leadership presentations,
  • A strong focus on execution in getting things done right. Proven ability to consistently produce and deliver expected results to all stakeholders by:
    • Finding a way to achieve success through adversity.
    • Being solution (not problem) focused
    • Thinking with a global mindset first.
  • Successful traits (flexibility, ability to thrive in change, being resourceful on your own) necessary to work in a fast paced environment that is evolving constantly.
  • Must work independently and demonstrate the ability to exercise sound judgment.
  • Exhibit natural and intellectual curiosity. Consistently considers all options and is not governed by conventional thinking.
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite and other business-related software.
  • The ability to read and write English fluently is required.
  • Must demonstrate a desire for continued professional development through continuing education and self-development opportunities.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for generous benefits package.

  • Albany Pay Range: $136,986 - $167,280

About Working in Claims at Farm Family

  • Farm Family does not treat our claims or our claims professionals as a commodity. The work we offer is challenging, diverse, and impactful.
  • Our Adjusters and Managers are empowered to exercise their independent discretion and, within broad limits and authority, be creative in developing solutions and treat each case as the unique situation it is.
  • We have a very flat organizational structure, enabling our employees have more interaction with our senior management team, especially when it relates to reviewing large losses.
  • Our entire claims team works in a collaborative nature to expeditiously resolve claims. We offer a work environment that inspires innovation and is open to employee suggestions. We even offer rewards for creative and innovative ideas.
  • We believe in building an inclusive and diverse team, and we strive to make our office a welcoming space for everyone. We encourage talented people from all backgrounds to apply.

PLEASE NOTE:

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.


If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.


Benefits and Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.


Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we apsire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

title: Principal Architect — Security, Privacy and Governance in Large-scale Enterprise Agentic-AI Solutions
description:
ADOBE - Enterprise Customer Experience Platform

Principal Architect — Security, Privacy and Governance in Large-scale Enterprise Agentic-AI Solutions

San Jose, CA (Hybrid, min. 3-4 days/week onsite) · Level: Principal · Full-time

Summary

At Adobe, we are building enterprise-grade Agentic-AI systems that automate large-scale data access and workflow execution for business processes. These systems not only embody foundational enterprise security and privacy considerations but also provide robust and safety-preserving capabilities in the emerging world of agent identity, delegated access control and human-in-the-loop execution models.

This is a multi-fluency role: you need the distributed systems and Agentic-AI depth to architect how agents reason, plan, and act at scale, and the security-and-compliance mechanisms that manage safe and trustworthy execution. You will partner with engineering, product, legal/privacy, and security leadership to turn fast-moving agentic AI capabilities into a governed, enterprise-ready platform.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Architecture

  • Define and drive the end-to-end reference architecture for how AI agents are authenticated and authorized to access enterprise data, tools, and systems across Adobe's Customer Experience Platform — covering agent lifecycle management, interaction protocols, memory/context handling, and action-execution frameworks.

  • Evaluate and select frameworks, protocols, and platforms (e.g., agentic orchestration frameworks, MCP-style tool systems, policy engines such as OPA/Cedar-class authorization) that best support secure, governed multi-agent systems at Adobe's scale.

Security, Compliance & Privacy by Design

  • Own the security architecture for agent-to-system and agent-to-agent interactions: identity and workload authentication, least-privilege authorization, secrets and credential mediation, network egress controls, runtime isolation, and telemetry/audit evidence sufficient to satisfy internal audit and external regulators.

  • Embed privacy-by-design and compliance requirements (data governance, consent, data residency, retention) directly into the agent architecture rather than bolting them on after the fact; partner with Legal/Privacy to keep architecture decisions ahead of regulatory expectations for autonomous AI systems.

Cross-Organizational Leadership & Standards

  • Lead architectural reviews and set standards for scalability, resiliency, observability, and cost efficiency — with security and compliance treated as first-class, non-negotiable design constraints rather than downstream signoffs.

  • Contribute to or lead an Architecture Review Board function for agentic AI, ensuring new capabilities are evaluated consistently against Adobe's governance bar before they ship.

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Evangelism

  • Serve as Adobe's senior technical authority and encouraging leader on secure agentic AI architecture. Mentor senior engineers and architects. Elevate security and privacy proficiency across the broader engineering organization.

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and threat models that are equally useful to implementation teams and to senior leadership.

Executive & Customer Engagement

  • Represent Adobe's agentic AI security and governance posture to executive leadership, enterprise customers, and — where relevant — regulators and standards bodies, with clear, bounded claims about maturity, open risks, and the evidence required before broader rollout.

  • Provide thought leadership across the organization where agentic AI access governance is heading, and shape Adobe's roadmap accordingly.

Basic Qualifications

  • 20+ years of experience in software engineering or security architecture, with a strong focus on distributed systems, platform engineering, and enterprise-scale access control.

  • Deep understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns: agent orchestration, tool/function calling, reasoning and planning loops, and multi-agent coordination, along with the risks specific to each.

  • Expert-level knowledge of identity and access management, authorization models, and credential/secrets management (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, SAML, workload identity, policy-as-code approaches such as OPA/Rego or Cedar-class engines).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous initiatives involving multiple functions across security, product, legal/privacy, and infrastructure teams, and to influence org-wide standards without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience with agent-lifecycle governance, including audit evidence generation and anomaly/incident response for autonomous systems.

  • Familiarity with privacy and compliance frameworks relevant to AI systems (e.g., data residency, consent management, and sectoral regulatory expectations for automated decision-making).

  • Experience building or governing developer platforms, cloud-native services, or streaming data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Spark) at enterprise scale.

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Security, or related technical field.

  • Experience standing up or contributing to an enterprise Architecture Review Board or equivalent governance function.

Success Profile

  • Strong systems thinker who can simplify genuinely hard problems — you make governance transparent without making it burdensome.

  • Comfortable operating at both hands-on technical depth and strategic, executive-facing leadership.

  • High ownership, high bias for execution, and a track record of turning a working draft into a production-grade, adopted standard.

Why This Role Is Different

Most “agentic AI architect” roles ask you to build agent capability. Most “security architect” roles ask you to review someone else's designs and implementations. This role asks you to do both at once, for one of the largest enterprise software platforms in the world — defining not just what Adobe's agents can do, but proving, to auditors and customers alike, that what they do is safe, governed and trustworthy. You will shape the security standard for enterprise Agentic AI solutions that other companies benchmark against, not just implement one.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

description:

  • Assegurar a conformidade das medições e informações relacionadas ao faturamento com os procedimentos internos da empresa e requisitos contratuais.
  • Apoiar os processos de fechamento mensal dos projetos, assegurando a correta consolidação das medições, apropriações e informações de avanço físico-financeiro.

title: Aircraft Worker
description:
Makes repairs to aircraft following orders of higher grade worker. Removes, cleans, reinstalls, or replaces defective parts, accessories, and components such as worn gaskets, couplings, and fittings; bad actuators, accumulators, gauges, sections of corroded fuel and oil lines, worn cable pulleys, frayed spark plug cables, and burned-out landing lights, using hand tools. Makes adjustments and settings such as cable tension and seat movement settings and adjustments. Obtains standard parts such as fuel and oil line connections and fittings, cable linkage, and spark plug cables and harnesses by referring to parts manuals and by making comparisons with samples. Services engines and aircraft components at line station making repairs, short of overhaul, required to keep aircraft in safe operating condition.

description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the Team

This opening is for the Software Test Development Engineer I on the V&V team within Dexcom's Research & Development Validation and Verification (V&V) organization. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a software development and/or quality engineering background to help advance the frameworks and tools that support software quality and automation best practices across Dexcom. You will contribute to the development of solutions that enable efficient validation of Dexcom CGM products while helping drive innovation in test automation, infrastructure optimization, and quality engineering. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team focused on establishing best-in-class test engineering practices that improve product quality, accelerate testing, and support life-changing technology for our customers.

  • You develop and maintain automated backend and UI test solutions for web-based applications.
  • You design and implement APIs and service endpoints to support automated updates to web portals, notifications, reporting, and documentation generation.
  • You create integrations between enterprise tools such as Jira, TestRail, Slack, GitHub, and Datadog to streamline workflows and automate data transfers.

  • You partner with Software Development, Quality Assurance, Product Management, Product Owners, and Regulatory teams to define project scope and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • You demonstrate proficiency integrating tools such as Jira, TestRail, GitHub, databases, web portals, and cloud-based services.

title: Engineering Applications Software Engineer I
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Responsibilities:

The JPL Power Systems & Electrical Engineering Group is responsible for architecting, generating requirements, performing subsystem design and analysis, verifying functionality and performance, delivering, and operating flight power systems to meet the needs of current and future missions. Within this group are leaders in project execution and subject matter experts driving technical development of mission enabling technology.

The Power Systems & Electrical Engineering Group is expanding its capability to perform advanced modelling, prediction, and simulation of spacecraft and power system elements (solar arrays, batteries, radioisotope thermoelectric generators, power electronics). These advance simulation and modelling tools are used both during spacecraft development to inform vehicle architecture and sizing, as well as in operations to support inflight activities.

As an Engineering Applications Software Engineer within the Power Systems & Electrical Engineering Group (345A), you will design, develop, and modify engineering applications for highly complex and specialized capabilities within spacecraft, instruments, electronic ground support equipment, planning, and mission software systems. You will also support the operations of inflight vehicles such as landers, rovers, orbiters, and probes.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Utilize power, electronics, and spacecraft domain-specific engineering expertise to understand the needs of customers, translate those needs into requirements, develop prototype applications, iterate with customers and then deliver quality applications.

  • Involved in entire life-cycle of system, including planning, development, deployment and maintenance.

  • Responsible for understanding and meeting software operational and engineering requirements.

  • Participate on spacecraft operational teams and provide power system focused engineering support.

  • Participate in power subsystem design engineering teams to support technical design and performance trades, perform analyses, and provide recommendations.

  • Present power system concepts to line management and other technical personnel.

  • Seek out new tools and techniques that improve the performance of Software Quality, Reliability, and Safety Engineering, and that enable better risk analysis and detection of defects and vulnerabilities early in the project life cycle.

  • Explore promising new areas of software development and assurance, including model-based assurance, static code analysis, independent verification of systems, AIs, and LLMs.

  • Operate in a team environment focused on continual improvement

  • Work both tactically and strategically to keep up with near term needs, but also support long term growth in our software products

  • Perform complex and wide-ranging job functions and activities across multiple disciplines.

  • Work independently on key projects and assignments with only limited direction.

  • Support the team leads on various projects and assignments

  • Serve as a team member on teams inside or outside organization, project, activity or function.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related technical disciplines with 1 year of related experience; or Master's degree in similar disciplines with 0 years of related experience.

  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Modelling and Simulation, Algorithm and code development, Analog Electronics, Controls, Power Systems Design, Systems Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Integration and Test

  • Understanding and application of advanced principles, theories, concepts and techniques in Systems Engineering

  • Experience in programming in the C, C++, Java and/or Python programming languages in a UNIX/Linux or real-time (e.g. VxWorks) operating system environment.

  • Experience with software engineering tools such as Integrated Development Environments (IDEs), compilers, and static analyzers.

  • The capability to analyze modern systems and software requirements, architecture, and test procedures and results.

  • Experience with software engineering tools such as Github, and JIRA

  • Ability to learn technical knowledge quickly and independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communications skills.

This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. description:
LA Baton Rouge-Perkins Rd - 132035

We put our team members first. You’ll receive a great salary and benefits, and experience the support and opportunity you deserve. You’re empowered to make decisions. You control your future.

Job Description:

The Parts Coordinator’s primary responsibility and accountability is to provide an exceptional and successful customer experience while proactively managing the process of ordering, receiving, storing, dispatching and returning parts for each repair order. The Parts Coordinator plays a pivotal role in the success of the customer’s experience by verifying the accuracy and quality of parts received in a timely manner as per the production schedule and vehicle needs.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistent execution of WOW (Wow Operating Way) plan.

  • Communicate all customer requests and needs to appropriate team members.

  • Work with vendors to order and receive all parts as indicated on the repair orders confirming the quality, correctness and quantity of parts received, accurately identifying parts necessary to complete repairs in the shop.

  • Ensure timely parts distribution to the shop in accordance with the production schedule.

  • Enter all parts invoices into the recommended Management Information System (MIS).

  • Label and track all parts by the R.O.# and store them with the vehicle and/or scheduled repairs; Communicate all Parts Price Changes (also known as Parts Price Increases - PPI) to all required team members.

  • Order and receive supplemental Parts in the MIS, monitor performance of parts, materials and sublet vendors. Ensure daily reconciliation of the parts vendor invoice history report (e.g. 043 Report).

  • Ensure invoices and credit memos are posted and filed/scanned in a timely manner.

  • Ensure vendor invoices have the correct negotiated discount to maintain proper profit margins.

Education and/or Experience Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 1-3+ years of experience working with automotive parts (auto body parts is a bonus)

  • Customer Service Oriented and strong organizational ability to manage pressure and conflicting demands and prioritize tasks takes initiative in problem solving situations

Required Skills/Abilities ​

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing

  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.

  • Effectively manage a fast-paced environment, demonstrating multi-tasking ability while working under pressure

  • Working Knowledge of: Mitchell, Audatex

  • Solid problem-solving abilities

  • Above average computer proficiency

  • Above average organizational skills

  • Ability to keep up and succeed in a fast-paced working environment

  • Ability to work well with others and achieve common goals

  • Other duties as assigned

  • Frequently required to bend, crouch, reach, handle tools

title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer - Offboard Training & Inference
description:
About Applied Intuition

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at .

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments.

About the Role

We are looking for a performance engineer who specializes in making large-scale machine learning workloads fast and cost-efficient in the datacenter. This role is focused on distributed training runs spanning many nodes, and high-throughput batch inference sweeping petabytes of real-world autonomy logs for auto-labeling, data mining, ground-truth generation, and evaluation.

The optimization target here is not tail latency on a vehicle - it is throughput, cluster goodput, and cost per unit of data processed. A training run that wastes 30% of its GPU-hours on stalled data loaders, or an offline inference sweep that takes a week instead of a day, directly slows down how fast the whole company can iterate. You will own the gap between what our fleet of accelerators is theoretically capable of and what our workloads actually achieve: profiling across the stack, finding where the compute and the wall-clock time actually go, and closing the difference.

You will work at the intersection of accelerators, ML frameworks, and large-scale data infrastructure, partnering with the teams who own each layer to land wins that show up in training time-to-result and offline processing cost. At Applied, we encourage all engineers to take ownership over technical and product decisions, closely interact with users to collect feedback, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.

At Applied, you will:

  • Profile and optimize distributed training end to end - data loading and preprocessing, augmentation, kernel execution, gradient communication, and checkpointing

  • Optimize large-scale offline and batch inference over petabyte-scale sensor logs: batching and scheduling strategies, quantization and low-precision execution, graph optimization, and accelerator saturation across long-running sweeps

  • Establish roofline and performance models for our workloads, quantify the gap between achieved and theoretical performance, and stack-rank optimization opportunities by impact and effort

  • Improve multi-node scaling efficiency: sharding and parallelism strategies, collective communication, interconnect utilization, and memory-bandwidth and kernel-fusion bottlenecks

  • Drive cluster goodput - reduce GPU idle time from input pipeline stalls, storage and network I/O, scheduling gaps, stragglers, and failure recovery on long-running jobs

  • Build the benchmarking, observability, and regression-detection tooling that keeps performance from silently degrading as models and code evolve

  • Collaborate with engineers across functions to solve complex data and compute problems at scale

  • Contribute to a team culture that values effective collaboration, technical excellence, and innovation

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Hands-on ML performance engineering experience: profiling, roofline analysis, throughput optimization, and root-cause investigation in production systems

  • Experience with distributed multi-node training at scale (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, NCCL, or equivalent), including diagnosing scaling inefficiency as node count grows

  • Deep familiarity with GPU or accelerator performance concepts - memory bandwidth, kernel launch overhead, occupancy, quantization, collective communication

  • Experience with high-throughput or batch inference systems (NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Ray, or similar)

  • Fluency in Python and proficiency in C++ or another systems language

  • Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • A deep understanding of machine learning foundations, and the ability to develop technical solutions for problems with no established playbook

Nice to have:

  • GPU kernel development experience: CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or hand-tuned attention implementations

  • Experience with profiling toolchains such as Nsight Systems/Compute, PyTorch Profiler, or perf

  • Experience with GPU scheduling and orchestration on Kubernetes, Slurm, or Ray, including multi-tenant cluster utilization

  • Experience with fault tolerance and elastic training for long-running jobs - checkpointing strategy, straggler mitigation, preemption recovery

  • Familiarity with autonomy or robotics data (ROS, OpenCV, multi-sensor log formats)

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Senior Product Manager, Certification
description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely. Vincent is the AI engine at the center of that mission, and the quality, breadth, and trustworthiness of the legal content and case-law signal it draws on is what separates a genuinely useful legal AI from a plausible-sounding one.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two connected problems: how fast and how well Vincent's content library expands into new jurisdictions, and how Vincent understands the relationships between legal cases, what's still good law, what's been overruled, what a court's actually relied on.

This is a build-from-scratch problem space with real ambiguity, a fast-moving competitive bar, and a mandate to move quickly without cutting corners on legal trust. This role can be worked from remote US or Remote Canada, or twice per week from our HUB offices (Vancouver, NYC, Toronto, Calgary or London).

What You'll Work On

Own Vincent's Legal Content Strategy: Set and evolve the quality bar for what "gold standard" content coverage means jurisdiction by jurisdiction, and drive the roadmap for expanding coverage rapidly, including new sourcing approaches (AI-driven content sourcing and indexing across multiple content modalities) that let Clio bring on jurisdictions and content sources much faster than before, while still meeting a bar we're proud to stand behind.

Reimagine the Citator for an AI Consumer: Design what we're calling "Certification," the signal layer that tells Vincent (and, through it, the lawyer) how cases relate to one another: what's been overruled, what's still good law, what's been relied on and why. You'll define what needs to be pre-labeled, how granular the signal needs to be, and how it should be structured to actually improve what Vincent tells a lawyer.

Drive Product Strategy End-to-End: Develop a roadmap for your area in conjunction with your Director and peers, build the business case for where to invest, and be willing to pivot as new information comes to light. Ship and launch features end-to-end in close partnership with Engineering, Design, and legal SMEs.

Ramp Fast, Not Locally: You won't need jurisdiction-specific legal expertise, Clio's country managers and local legal experts own that depth and will support you directly. What you do need is enough legal fluency to move fast on this problem, ask the right questions, and get up to speed on the specifics within weeks, not months.

What You Bring

Real Legal Fluency: This role requires more hands-on legal substance than a typical Clio PM role. You should understand, or be able to quickly and confidently get to grips with, what a citator is, why case relationships (overruling, following, distinguishing) matter, and how citation has historically worked as a compression mechanism that let lawyers avoid reading every underlying case. A background as a practicing lawyer, legal researcher, or in legal tech is a strong asset.

AI Product Experience: Proven experience building or managing AI-driven products, with a strong point of view on how AI changes what a "signal" or "trust layer" needs to look like versus how it worked for a human-only audience.

Product Management Acumen: At least 6 years of product management experience in a SaaS or B2B software environment, with a track record of owning and shipping mission-critical products at scale.

Comfort with Ambiguity: This space is being defined in real time. You're someone who can form a strong, well-reasoned point of view quickly, act on it, and adjust as new information comes in, rather than waiting for the problem to be fully scoped for you.

Fast, Independent Learner: You pick up new, complex domains quickly and form your own opinionated take rather than needing everything spelled out. You'll ramp with the existing team but should be self-directed from early on.

Strategic & Data-Driven Thinking: You use both qualitative and quantitative input to drive product strategy, define requirements, and measure impact, and you're comfortable making decisions under uncertainty.

Strong Communicator: You work effectively across Product, Design, Engineering, and legal SME stakeholders, with the humility to seek input and the conviction to make a call.

Product at Clio

Our market opportunity is rare in its scale and powered by a strong business model, Silicon Valley–based investors and advisors, and a product management team that is global and world-class. Clio is growing rapidly, with massive growth opportunities for Product Managers. We've worked hard to build an excellent product management culture with empowered PMs who are highly regarded and influential across the organization. Clio invests heavily in developing Product Managers, growing leaders, and the broader Product communities we operate in.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary

  • Clio offers a flexible hybrid work environment

  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays

  • Private Healthcare with Life Insurance & Critical Illness cover

  • Pension contribution

  • Professional development and growth options

  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $157,300 to $212,800 USD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

title: Power Platform Administrator
description:
Primary Purpose

The Power Platform Administrator is responsible for the administration, governance, and strategic enablement of the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps,Power Automate, Power Pages, CopilotStudio, and related AI capabilities. This role partners across IT, FinOps, compliance, and business teams to ensure the platform is secure, scalable, cost effective, and aligned with organizational objectives while enabling innovation, automation, and data driven decision making.

Bright Horizons is a leading education and care company that helps employees thrive at work and at home by partnering with employers to offer high-quality child care, elder care, and educational support. Our workplace reflects this commitment—with collaborative environments, meaningful benefits, and a culture that supports both career growth and personal well-being. Essential Functions/Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end administration of the Power Platform tenant, including development, test, user acceptance, and production environments

  • Manage the environment provisioning lifecycle and drive continuous improvements in operations efficiency and service delivery
  • Administer on-premises data gateway patching, monitoring, and security controls
  • Maintain the Center of Excellence (CoE) toolkit and reporting framework to support platform governance and adoption

  • Bachelor’s degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience administering Dynamics 365 environments and Power Platform–D365 integrations

  • Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory, Azure integration services, or on-premises data gateways
  • Experience with FinOps principles and Microsoft licensing optimization (capacity vs. PAYGO models)

  • High school diploma or GED (Certain client projects or contractual requirements may require an Associate degree from a two - year college or technical school).

  • 2-4 years of experience in experience in utility power distribution engineering or related craft work.

Other Abilities:

  • Valid driver's license and vehicle suitable for business use (mileage reimbursement may apply)

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

This role involves primarily office-based work with regular sitting and frequent use of hands for computer and tool handling, and talking and hearing throughout the day. The position also includes occasional standing, walking, reaching, climbing or balancing, and stooping or kneeling during field activities. We may require employees to lift up to 10 pounds regularly. The job also requires visual abilities, including close and distance vision, color distinction, peripheral vision, and depth perception. Reasonable accommodations can be made for individuals with disabilities.

Your work will involve a mix of office and field work. title: Business Analyst, Risk Evaluation & Mitigation Strategies (REMS) - Remote
description:
About MMS
Are you looking to join a company where your contributions truly matter, and where you'll be part of a supportive, innovative team? MMS is a award-winning, data-focused clinical research organization (CRO). We pride ourselves on being a Great Place to Work certified organization, recognized for our exceptional culture and industry best employee retention rate. We support the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries with our proven, scientific approach to complex trial data and regulatory submission challenges. With a global footprint across four continents, MMS not only maintains an industry-leading customer satisfaction rating but also fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment where employees can thrive.
